Game.Name: Another World: 20th Anniversary Edition
Game.Overview:
This is an updated version of Another World for the 20th anniversary of the original game, five years after the updated 15th anniversary edition. It is adapted for mobile devices offering both touch controls and a virtual D-pad. The backgrounds are reworked for higher resolutions with subtler shades of light, and crisper detail and edges to the polygons and animations. It is still possible to switch to the original graphics. This version also contains remastered sound effects and three difficulty modes.
Two to three years later it was also ported to PC and a variety of console platforms with platform-specific tweaks. On the GOG distribution portal 15th Anniversary Edition was replaced with this version, but both versions are still accessible as a single package.

Game.Name: Another World: Thought Taboo
Game.Overview: "Another World - Thought Taboo" is a different world adventure game, you will explore this mysterious and dangerous world alone, and gradually discover the truth hidden in it.

Game.Name: An Outcry
Game.Overview:
Harass your neighbours. Debate with birds. Smoke to survive.
On the fourth floor of an apartment complex in Vienna, five people lead their lonely lives.
Behind door #3 lives the Unnamed, a 25-year-old shut-in: A smoker, interested in bikes, books and music, in the grip of heavy anxiety and poverty.
By complete chance, the Unnamed would lock themself out of their apartment one fateful night, and be placed in your hands.
The night of the 14th of October 2017 was no ordinary night- A heavy beating of strange wings filled the air with the scent of smoke, and covered the stars in an ink-like rot.
It is your mission to ensure the Unnamed's safety as the shadows close around them. Make certain they survive; choose their path carefully.
---
An Outcry is a narrative, text-heavy horror RPG made in RPG Maker 2003.
Features: ~4 hours of gameplay with 2 major, impactful routes to choose from and 5 endings to find Almost 100 fully illustrated cutscene images A haunting soundtrack made up of drone music, post rock, and other eclectic sounds Talking with birds

Game.Name: Anoxemia
Game.Overview: Anoxemia is a story-driven exploration game that puts you in control of the scientist Dr. Bailey and his operations drone, ATMA. Search the ocean floor as you discover and extract samples from the bowels of the underwater caves.

Game.Name: Anpfiff: Der RTL Fussball-Manager
Game.Overview:
Anpfiff: Der RTL-Fussballmanager is a managerial soccer simulation with a catch: instead of a whole team the player only takes care of one player and, similar to an RPG, increases his stats with matches and training. When he is retired he takes the traditional role as coach or manager. Then the player has all the usual options available: setting the training, buying and selling players, searching sponsors and so on.
The in real-time calculated matches are shown in a isometric perspective and the player can give orders like tactical changes or substituting players. The game features 54 leagues with ca. 20.000 players but without a license.

Game.Name: AnShi
Game.Overview: Grab your hoverboard and explore the ancient, mysterious world of AnShi as you glide across caves, large deserts and old temple ruins to discover its secrets. Featuring stunning visuals and an original soundtrack, AnShi delivers a unique, breathtaking experience.

Game.Name: Ansiolisis
Game.Overview: Ansiolisis (or Anxiolysis) is a short interactive narrative text-based adventure over a dream of someone with anxiety.

Game.Name: Anstoss
Game.Overview: The economic simulation for real soccer enthusiasts. Make your way through a successful career as the manager of your own soccer team by always giving your club everything you have got. Act as both trainer and manager, call the right shots and earn the support of the board of directors. There is only one way to become national coach!

Game.Name: Anstoss 2: Der FuÃŸballmanager
Game.Overview:
Anstoss 2: Der FuÃŸballmanager is a soccer management simulation for 1-4 players. You are in charge of a club, participating in one of the 13 featured leagues. Start to design a training concept, implement a revolutionary tactical system and you might be on the right way. The goal is simple: reach for gold, participate in national and international competitions and win 'em all. Additionally you are responsible for the financial aspects, e.g. by building a better stadium, hiring employees, betting on other games, etc.
The matches are presented in 3D cutscenes. You can exchange players, adapt tactics to new situations or weather conditions, but don't participate directly.

Game.Name: Anstoss 2 Gold: Der FuÃŸballmanager
Game.Overview:
Anstoss 2 Gold: Der FuÃŸballmanager combines Anstoss 2: Der FuÃŸballmanager and its add-on VerlÃ¤ngerung!. However, it is not a mere compilation; the game adds various new features of its own.
The main new feature of this version is the manager career. Here the player negotiates his own contracts, has a reputation and gains (or loses) levels after fulfilling a certain set of conditions (or failures). With better levels come points which are divided into abilities like "press work" or "training" which improve the results in those areas. Other additions include speeches directly before matches, expanded merchandising options, updated rules for national and international championships or more statistics.
Also included is a 100-page strategy manual and a brief history of the series, explaining various steps during development and a section with humorous or bizarre calls at the hint-line.

Game.Name: ANSTOSS 3: Der FuÃŸballmanager
Game.Overview:
ANSTOSS 3: Der FuÃŸballmanager is the third main game in the German ANSTOSS series. The player takes care of the financial and athletic success of his soccer club. For this purpose, most time is spent in menus (the player can switch between the menu bar known from predecessor, a text menu or an office) to work on the various possibilities, e.g. training, tactics, transfers, merchandising, and so on. The player also can take the role of a national coach. The matches are either watched in a full 3D representation or in the text mode in which all interesting match situations are described in text form.
This installment is based on ANSTOSS 2 and adds new features and possibilities for practically every menu point. Examples are the simulated private life of the athletes with about 200 individual character abilities, relationships between players or more possibilities for managing youth teams. The player also has total control over the club compound; he can construct many buildings which may or may not have a relationship to soccer or a financial gain, including up to three stadiums.

Game.Name: Anstoss Action: Die FuÃŸballsimulation
Game.Overview:
Anstoss Action: Die FuÃŸballsimulation is a spin-off of the Anstoss soccer manager series that allows the player to actively participate in soccer matches. In comparison to its main competitor, the EA FIFA series, it tries to capture a soccer match more realistically.
The legacy of its developers shows in the simulation of the athlete's abilities and the possibilities outside the grass: there are expansive tactical options and a basic transfer system. Players can set a focus for seven training sessions per week which has clear effects on the matches. The game features various playing modes, e.g. competitions, tournaments or leagues; all with their own victory celebrations. Successes unlock historical matches with goals to complete, e.g. turning the 0:2 score in the 1954 World Cup match between Germany and Hungary.
This game can be linked to the soccer manager Anstoss 3, allowing to play the matches instead of watching them (either the whole team or one player). All the decisions regarding tactics and team development made in Anstoss 3 affect the action-part considerably. Even if players don't wish to actively participate in matches, Anstoss 3 still profits from graphical enhancements.

Game.Name: Answered Prayers
Game.Overview: Answered Prayers is a Yume Nikki fangame made by Klaufir. One of the more well-known English fangames, Answered Prayers is also one of the 'lighter' Yume Nikki fangames. This game has plenty of exploration value, with little gore/blood compared to many other Yume Nikki deriatives. At Version 0.03, the game has been put on hiatus, according to the official website.

Game.Name: Answer Knot
Game.Overview: A short narrative and exploration game about Zach, June, and a strange phenomenon. You're Zach and, stuck in your home, you will do everything to keep hearing June's voice messages. What is happening out there?

Game.Name: Antadin DX
Game.Overview: A dark jrpg with tough choices that change the story. You play as the last of the antadins, the protector of the queen of your colony. You have to traverse bleak, corrupted caverns, inhabitated by a myriad of different insects. Trying to protect your ward.

Game.Name: Antagonist
Game.Overview: Play as Dâ€™Vil, the Dark Lordâ€¦ and rising star at Evil Productions. Team up with Hero of Light, Ralph, and unleash devastating combos on your foes. Will you work together to uncover the conspiracy behind the video game cutscene industry or clash like true hero and villain?

Game.Name: Antarctica 88
Game.Overview: Challenge yourself in an amazing and terrible story in the Antarctic ice!

Game.Name: Antarctic Heritage Trust
Game.Overview: Step inside Sir Edmund Hillaryâ€™s Antarctic hut.

Game.Name: Antares
Game.Overview: Grab your gun and blast your way through the infested horde as you try to save humanity from the ultimate doom! Gather resources, upgrade your weapon and explore the story of why you are the only one left alive. Or are you?

Game.Name: Antaria Online
Game.Overview: Antaria Online is a Cross-Platform MMORPG being developed with community feedback.

Game.Name: Antecrypt
Game.Overview:
Shoot corrupting monsters and save mankind's last hard drive with your rechargeable laser beam! ... But your aiming has a mind of its own, so you'll have to make do!
This is a tight arcade single-stick arena shooter! Were you looking for a tough-but-fair retro-styled challenge?
This game features:
ðŸ”« tight top-down shooting action ðŸ’¾ 40 levels ðŸ’€ 2 additional difficulty modes ðŸ”’ 30+ unlockable unique upgrades to help you through the levels ðŸ‘©â€ðŸ’» 6 skills to improve strategically âš¡ a lot of explosions and sparks â± a timer for time-attack / speedrunning purposes âš¡âš¡âš¡âš¡âš¡
Controls:
This game can be played either with a keyboard or a game controller! There can be some confusion as to the actual controls as we don't have an in-game tutorial, so here they are:
the arrows, or WASD, or the left stick of a controller, or the D-pad to move around [X] or (A) to use the laser-beam [C] or (B) to use the bomb Additionally, here's a little tip: after selecting a level, and after you've unlocked some upgrades, you can select unlocked upgrades by pressing down instead of confirming the [restore file] prompt. We're sorry we didn't manage to communicate this better in-game, we'll do better next time!

Game.Name: Antenna
Game.Overview: A machine ponders its loneliness. It scans the radio spectrum for an answer to its question.

Game.Name: Antenna Dilemma
Game.Overview: Antenna Dilemma is a short and witty point&click in which you'll follow the story of C432632, a finicky grey cube that sure doesn't want to miss his favorite TV show.

Game.Name: Ant Force
Game.Overview: Playing ant you will have an unbelievable fight with AI.

Game.Name: Antguy: Ant Route Puzzler!!
Game.Overview:
Antguy is a doodle based physical puzzler.
Easy control, Dynamic puzzles. 5 worlds, 50 levels. w/ little animation parts Some unique gadgets. Unlockable extra items. 16 in game achievements. Peaceful mood & tracks
Ant wants cakes!

Game.Name: Antharion
Game.Overview: Antharion is an epic old-school fantasy RPG that combines tactical turn-based combat with the freedom of a huge living-breathing open world.

Game.Name: Anthelion
Game.Overview: Super simple mechanic, but highly challenging game play with endless levels that will keep you entertained for hours!

Game.Name: Anthem
Game.Overview:
Anthem is an online multiplayer action role-playing video game developed by BioWare and published by Electronic Arts. The game was released worldwide for Microsoft Windows, PlayStation 4 and Xbox One on February 22, 2019.
Team with up to three other players in cooperative adventures that reward both combined effort and individual skill. Each playerâ€™s choice of javelin exosuit will shape their contribution and strategic role. As you explore, you will discover a gripping story filled with unique and memorable characters. Seamless and intelligent matchmaking will ensure you can quickly and easily find other players to adventure alongside.
Every time you enter the world as a Freelancer, youâ€™ll select a powerful javelin exosuit â€“ armor designed to provide its pilot with incredible offensive and defensive capabilities. Move at incredible speed, rocket across the skies, or safely roam watery depths. As you play, you will constantly progress both your own abilities as a javelin pilot and the combat and traversal capabilities of your growing collection of exosuits.
The javelin exosuits â€“ and accompanying gear, weapons, and equipment â€“ can be extensively customized and personalized. As you rank up and defeat enemies, youâ€™ll gather gear and complete milestones that unlock amazing personalization options and turn your javelins into testaments to your ability and achievement.
Anthemâ€™s vast, ever-changing world features unpredictable conditions, hazards, and enemies. Over time, Anthem will develop and expand â€“ introducing unique stories, challenges, and world-shaking events. This world is both beautiful and deadly â€“ and will test you on each expedition you embark on with your Freelancer team.

Game.Name: Anthology of Fear
Game.Overview: Take part in a one-man investigation and solve the mystery of your brotherâ€™s disappearance. Find out the truth by exploring unsettling liminal locations. Discover the story chapter by chapter, with each one unveiling their common tragedy.

Game.Name: Anthology of Fear: Prologue
Game.Overview: Anthology of Fear is the first-person psychological horror, focusing on the story and solving the secrets of the game world. Discover the beginning of the first of three completely unique dark stories in this climatic prologue.

Game.Name: Anthophobia
Game.Overview: Anthophobia is a side-scrolling action survival horror. In the wake of a global plant-based pandemic, the protagonist has kept hidden in her apartment for three months. Now that her water supplies have run dry, it is time to brave the floral armageddon and seek new shelter.

Game.Name: Antichamber
Game.Overview: Antichamber is a mind-bending psychological exploration game where nothing can be taken for granted. Discover an Escher-like world where hallways wrap around upon each other, spaces reconfigure themselves, and accomplishing the impossible may just be the only way forward.

Game.Name: Antigas ConstelaÃ§Ãµes
Game.Overview:
In 2011, after years of dispute, the SÃ£o Paulo government removed the last families from the place. The village had been expropriated to become a cultural center. The cement statues and buildings with exotic architecture remained, empty of people, as listed heritage sites.
But there still hangs over the town an impression of events that do not fit into this collection. The memorabilia of former residents tell other stories. Ancient Constellations evokes this universe through testimonials and digital replicas, reanimated in a virtual reality experience through the skies above the institution.

Game.Name: Antigraviator
Game.Overview: Antigraviator is a sleek new take on the anti-gravity racing genre. Use traps, power-ups and boosts to overtake your opponents and dominate the track in single player or multiplayer mode. With no speed limit holding you back, Antigraviator delivers the fastest racing experience of the future.

Game.Name: Antihero
Game.Overview: Run a Thieves Guild in a gas-lit Victorian city! Antihero is a fast-paced digital board game with an (Oliver) Twist. Recruit street urchins, hire thugs, start a gang, upgrade your guild, steal everything... and bribe, blackmail, and assassinate your way to victory.

Game.Name: Antihero: Deluxe Edition
Game.Overview:
The Antihero Deluxe Edition includes both the game and the original soundtrack.
RUN A THIEVES' GUILD IN A GAS-LIT VICTORIAN CITY.
Antihero is a fast turn-based strategy game with an (Oliver) Twist. Recruit street urchins, hire thugs, start a gang, upgrade your guild, steal everything... and bribe, blackmail, and assassinate your way to victory. Includes a story-driven campaign, AI skirmishes, and intense online and offline PvP.
ONE GOAL. MANY FOES. Play through the story-driven campaign, skirmish against the AI, and jump online in casual and ranked PvP multiplayer. CHALLENGE YOUR FRIENDS. Invite friends to play asynchronously or increase the pressure in a Live Match. Set up custom â€œHouse Rulesâ€ and tailor the game to your tastes! TAKE OVER THE CITY. PROTECT WHATâ€™S YOURS. Infiltrate businesses, sneak into estates, set traps, and steal everything. The cityâ€™s riches are yours â€“ if your opponent doesnâ€™t take them first. SNEAKERY, STABBERY & SKULLDUGGERY! Upgrade your guild, recruit street urchins, hire thugs, start a gangâ€¦ and bribe, blackmail and assassinate the opposition. There are many paths to the top. MANAGE A HEALTHY ECONOMY. Spend your ill-gotten riches to hire new recruits, upgrade your thieving skills, and acquire deadly weapons. Gold is a thiefâ€™s best friend! RISE TO THE TOP. See how you rank among all Master Thieves in the in-game leaderboards.

Game.Name: Antihorror
Game.Overview: Strange coincidence brought traveler in unfamiliar places. It would be fine, except sinister desolation is starting to embrace the surroundings. There is no another soul around for the tens of kilometers. Or thatâ€™s what it seems like? I should probably go deal with that.

Game.Name: Antimatter Dimensions
Game.Overview: Earn antimatter through dimensions! Gain Infinite antimatter to collapse the universe!

Game.Name: Antimatter Elevator
Game.Overview: Connect non-matching pieces to reach level 99.

Game.Name: Antioch: Scarlet Bay
Game.Overview: Antioch: Scarlet Bay is an online cooperative narrative adventure. Play as two detectives working together to solve a murder in the shadowy city of Antioch. Wander in a city filled with characters with their own agendas and attitudes, all your decisions change the story and lead to multi endings.

Game.Name: Antiquia Lost
Game.Overview: An authentic RPG of a journey with a girl made of slime! Enjoy fluid 2D turn-based battles! Bine is a young man who lives in a small rural village. One day, he is asked by Lunaria, a girl who lives near the village, to go with her to the royal capital...

Game.Name: Antirocketh
Game.Overview: Antirocketh is a fast, arcade-style game about a laser-cannon morphing swarms of missiles into improbable stuff!

Game.Name: Antisphere
Game.Overview: Antisphere is a PvP competitive twin-stick shooter where you compete against other players from around the world.

Game.Name: Antisquad
Game.Overview: Widely known in small circles as AntiSquad, they are a military tactical response unit. These hardened military professionals, tired of bureaucracy, politics and serving the armed forces, have established a private paramilitary formation located in south United States.

Game.Name: Antistatic
Game.Overview: Antistatic is a crisp, uncompromising indie platform fighter.

Game.Name: Antiterror Strike
Game.Overview:
Antiterror Strike is a Tactical First Person Shooter, where you play as a member of an elite special force, tasked with fighting terrorist groups in the city.
Antiterror Strike is a Tactical First Person Shooter, where you play as a member of an elite special force, tasked with fighting terrorist groups in the city. Complete missions, storm the houses with terrorists with them and then defend it after enemy waves. After every mission you get a money reward, on which you can buy different weapons and armor upgrade.

Game.Name: Anti Zombie Defense
Game.Overview: Defend your base from zombie monsters! Use construction shop to your advantage. Buy extra defense towers and upgrades. Defend your land at any cost! Enjoy this tower defense / crimsonland type of game. Put your strategy and reaction skill on the table. It's do or die time!

Game.Name: Antonball Deluxe
Game.Overview:
The breakout title from Summitsphere, Antonball Deluxe is a retro, high-octane smorgasbord of ballbusting arcade action! Starring a little red man named Anton - Boiler Cityâ€™s top exterminator - Antonball Deluxe quite literally turns the breakout genre on its head, blending traditional brick-breaking gameplay with tight, intense platforming.
No slouch on content, Antonball Deluxe truly lives up to its name in including three separate games:
- ANTONBALL is an enhanced low-definition remake of Summitsphereâ€™s legendary game jam title! After a long night on the town, Anton, Boiler City's resident exterminator and overconsumer of fizzy libation, is struggling to find his way back home from Brulo's Casino. Using his trusty Antonball, Anton decides to take the most direct path home after an unfortunate trip into the sewers: breaking straight through every single wall between the sewers and the city he calls home in 30 stages of brick-smashing fun!
- PUNCHBALL is the tale of Anton's building-mate Annie, and her indefatigable need to be the absolute best. When Annie discovers the Punchball Tourney being held at Brulo's Casino, with the grand prize being a lifetime supply of Ballble Tea, she sets out to win first place! You'll need to help her defeat all of the trickster beasts that have volunteered to take part in Brulo's wild game. Use the Punchball to slam enemies, then kick 'em off the stage! Do you have what it takes to be the Punchball Champion?
- VS. ANTONBALL is Antonball but competitive! Each team has their own brick wall and aims to break the other team's wall first. Defeat the other team by destroying their wall! Play 1v1, 2v2, or even 2v1 (if you're into that)! Many power-ups are in play, with some twists and turns depending on which arena you're having your ball-based blitz in! You can even pick some up and throw them!
Features: - Brick-breakin', ball-bustin' gameplay with a platformin' twist! - Includes THREE games: Antonball, Punchball, and VS. Antonball! - 69 levels of stimulating mole-mashin' action! - 21 different characters to unlock and play as! - Share your balls with friends or foes online and offline with up to four players! (Gamepad required for local multiplayer) - Online leaderboards for Antonball and Punchball! - A ballin', 100% original retro soundtrack! - 18 baller Steam Achievements to show off to your friends!

Game.Name: Antonblast
Game.Overview:
ANTONBLAST is a fast-paced explosive action platformer that's all about destruction. Play as the enraged Dynamite Anton (or his cranked-out coworker Annie) and use your Mighty Fâ€™n Hammer to demolish bizarre worlds, tussle with screen-filling bosses, and steal your Spirits back from Satan!
Thankfully, the local disgraced casino owner, Brulo, has his own beef with Satan, and he's willing to put aside his differences with Anton to make that devil pay.
Your mission in every level is simple: SET Brulo's Detonators, FIND Anton's Spirit, and ESCAPE before Happy Hour ends! â€¢ BLAST through a unique powertrip of a platformer! â€¢ INDULGE in an urban graffiti-inspired art style! â€¢ DEMOLISH massive destructible environments! â€¢ BATTLE brutal, earthshaking bosses! â€¢ EXPERIMENT with a totally dynamic playstyle; rush through for the best time or explore at your own pace!

Game.Name: AntQueen 3D
Game.Overview: Experience a game where you live through the cycle of an ant colony. You can dig your own tunnels, organize your colony, customize your army, but you need to survive every wave of attack!

Game.Name: Antrum
Game.Overview: Antrum is a procedural generated dungeon where you have to collect as many relics as possible and sell them, but there is a catch, in your path you will encounter creatures that will try to defend those relics but some of them have not seen a human in a long time so they may treat you in an unexpected way.

Game.Name: Ants
Game.Overview: In this family-friendly 2-d puzzle game, you'll place arrows and tunnels to help guide the ants to their new anthills, avoiding obstacles such as rocks, water, ant traps, and spiders. Over 240 levels range from easy to mind-bendingly difficult.

Game.Name: Ants of Duty
Game.Overview: Ants of Duty is a strategy game about managing a small colony of ants that find themselves in an unknown territory.

Game.Name: Ants Took My Eyeball
Game.Overview: Ants Took My Eyeball is a 2D action platformer roguelite. Descend into an ever-changing ant hill, fight your way through hordes of insects with a variety of weapons, face formidable bosses and ultimately find your stolen eyeball.

Game.Name: AntVentor
Game.Overview: AntVentor is a point & click adventure game. You find yourself in a photorealistic macroworld where you immediately manage to ruin the life of the main character, ant, and foil all his plans for making his dream come true. Can you help get everything back in order?

Game.Name: Ant War: Domination
Game.Overview: Emerge from the ant hill with a handful of ants and a dream... to conquer the world. Train your ants with new skills, manage their daily work load, and travel across the town in search of new land. Sharpen your pincers and be ready for a fight because everyone from beetles and slugs, to the town police and the army will try to stop your...

Game.Name: Antz Extreme Racing
Game.Overview: Antz Extreme Racing is set in each of the four temperate seasons and has four different types of races: driving, flying on the backs of insects, running, and snowboarding or surfing. The game features both a single-player and multiplayer mode; the split screen multiplayer mode supports up to four players

Game.Name: Antz: Panic in the Anthill!
Game.Overview: An army of rebellious ants have invaded the anthill. You are Z, a hero in spite himself, who will have to save the inhabitants of the anthill from this terrible threat. To save it, you must place explosive mushrooms to destroy their underground bases... Up to 2 Players 50 levels Gold coins, mosquitoes, magic mushrooms... And many more surprises!

Game.Name: Anubis II
Game.Overview:
EU release
A long time ago, an evil spirit known as Mumm'hotep sank the land of Egypt into eternal darkness. A deadly curse was spread across the once peaceful civilisation. The Gods had to send one man to deal with this threat, the warrior of the sand... Anubis. The player is armed with an arsenal consisting of the scepter of Ra and the Kanopic bombs of fury, with this, Anubis sets off to save Egypt once and for all! In this game, the player will have to face off with legions of evil enemies across nine playable levels of gameplay.
The player controls Anubis from a third-person perspective through levels with platform puzzles and enemies that are taken out by swinging his staff or locking on to them and shooting energy balls. In each level Anubis needs to find eight pyramids that open up the portal to end the stage. Contrary to the title, this is not the sequel to an earlier game.

Game.Name: Anuchard
Game.Overview:
Anuchard. It was known as a place of wonder and peace, a land of limitless bounty suspended in the heavens above. Five ancient Guardians kept it safe from all harm... Until they turned on the kingdom and its denizens. The Anuchardian paradise fell from the skies, crashing onto the surface of the world below. Only a tiny speck of an island survived the fall intact. The rest coalesced into a twisted mass of winding passages, wild magic, and vicious monsters, known simply as The Dungeon. Somewhere within, the five treasonous Guardians lay asleep.
Generations passed as the few survivors eked out an existence in the Orchard, the sole village on the island, maintaining what little remains of Anuchardian magic. Farmers tend to the fields, scavengers try to pick the bones of the kingdom in the Dungeon. All await the Chosen One, the Bellwielder who will take up the Audros Bell, enter the Dungeon, and wake the Guardians from their slumber, and bring back the paradise lost: Return Anuchard to the heavens.
Finally, you were judged worthy to take up the mantle of the Bellwielder. The Dungeon awaits!

Game.Name: Anunna-Ki: Katabasis
Game.Overview: Anunna-Ki: Katabasis is a multiplayer online role-playing game inspired by Helbreath. Players choose between the rival cities of Babylon and Uruk, hunt monsters, develop their characters and equipment, and take part in player-versus-player combat between the cities.

Game.Name: ANVIL
Game.Overview: Take on the role of a Vault Breaker in search of alien artifacts called â€œVaultsâ€ and fight against monsters and powerful bosses. You can strengthen your Breakers to explore far-away galaxies that no one has ever reached!

Game.Name: Anvil Life
Game.Overview: In this game that offers unlimited fun in Singleplayer, Sandbox game type; You will be able to upgrade your items, expand your military, win loot with quests, and try many combinations to bring the characters to the state you want.

Game.Name: Anvil Saga
Game.Overview:
Anvil Saga is a management sim with RPG elements where you take control of a blacksmith shop amidst the Hundred Years' War. Each decision you make impacts the story and gameplay.
Turn a ramshackle blacksmith shop into a successful enterprise in a challenging and endlessly varied world! Deal with local bandits, lords, priests, as well as French and English soldiers. Manage workers with various quirks, improve facilities and tools to create better merchandise, decorate your smithy to attract high-paying customers and most importantly â€“ try not to get yourself beheaded.

Game.Name: Anxiety: Lost Night
Game.Overview:
This game was originally made in Ludum dare 33
Anxiety : Lost Night is a 2D puzzle horror game, which player are trapped in a car in middle of nowhere. Solve the mystery beneath the character's anxiety and what caused it to occurr.

Game.Name: ANXRacers: Drift Space
Game.Overview: ANXRacers is a 2D top-down time-attack spaceship racing game. As a racing pilot, your goal is to get the spaceship from start to finish, in the least amount of time, while passing checkpoints in correct order. Inspired By TrackmaniaÂ® and Elite DangerousÂ®

Game.Name: ANYKEY
Game.Overview: ANYKEY is a game for people with lots of friends and just one keyboard. Play with up to 60 simultaneous players in local multiplayer and see who can get the best score with just one button!

Game.Name: Anykey Simulator
Game.Overview: Anykey Simulator allows you to feel the hardship of computer designing. In this game you are faced with solving simple puzzles - you have to move available computer module to appointed place in the field of 5x5 squares, in the way that modules won't suffer, preferably all of them, but your aim is to complete the plan.

Game.Name: ANYU
Game.Overview:
ANYU is a 3D third-person narrative exploration game, set in a frozen wasteland where an ancient civilization fell. Centered around movement puzzles and dealing with environment mechanics.
Ikku will face an arctic world and must reach the top of the mountain to finally get a glimpse of the northern lights. During the journey, he will encounter some helpful friends and the remnants of an ancient civilization.
This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

Game.Name: AnyWay: Reborn
Game.Overview: Do you like parkour? Dashing retro times? AnyWay! Try yourself on an unsuccessful journey in the role of Joy, feel the burden of parkour! A small, but exciting adventure Joy will not make you relax, not for you, not for your friends!

Game.Name: AOD: Art Of Defense
Game.Overview: AOD is a new gameplay in the traditional tower defence genre. You must protect your base from waves of approaching enemies. Build and improve your towers and units and destroy your enemies in any way you can. Don't be weak, destroy them all, show who's in charge!

Game.Name: AO International Tennis
Game.Overview: AO International Tennis is the most authentic, community-focused tennis game ever. Make use of comprehensive PlayFaceâ„¢, Stadium Creator, and other customisation features to put a photo-realistic version of yourself in your local tennis competition, up against the greats, including Rafael Nadal.

Game.Name: Aoi Shiro
Game.Overview:
The Seijou Girlsâ€™ Academy Kendo Club is traveling to Shoushinji for a Summer training camp. Near there is an island, Urashima, where legend has it a demon extermination took place long ago.
They arrive around the time of a festival which honors a god that is worshipped by the people of Urashima; it celebrates the onitaiji and ensure another year of health for the people. Around the time of the festival, the weather around Urashima worsens and storms will come.
A few days into their training, Osanai Shouko finds a girl washed up on the shores near the location of the training camp. She cannot speak and doesnâ€™t seem to know much about herself...

Game.Name: Aokana: EXTRA1
Game.Overview: EXTRA1 is set after the game "Aokana - Four Rhythms Across the Blue". It is the after story for Mashiro, one of the two highest voted in the Aokana character popularity poll.

Game.Name: Aoki Ookami to Shiroki Mejika
Game.Overview: Aoki Ookami to Shiroki Mejika was first released in 1985. Players become Temujin, who has just become 20, and fight to unify the Mongolian plains. After uniting the plains, you are renamed Genghis Khan and proceed to conquer Eurasia. Grow rich and conquer all you come across.

Game.Name: Ao no Kanata no Four Rhythm
Game.Overview: Ao no Kanata no Four Rhythm, the story tells of a sophomore, Masaya Hinata, in a world where flying is possible thanks to the invention of anti-gravity shoes (known as "Grash" which was coin-up term for "Gravity Shoes") that anyone can afford. With the new ability, the world has invented a new sport known as "Flying Circus". Masaya participated in that sport some time ago, but after repeated defeats and constant frustration he got fed up with it and left the team. But after meeting Asuka Kurashina, a transfer student, his fire to experience the glory days got lit again. But his feelings for sport aren't the only thing that brought him joy. It was his feelings for Asuka, and their participation in this sport together, side by side, facing the opponents.

Game.Name: Ao no Kanata no Four Rhythm: EXTRA 2
Ao Oni
Game.Overview: Ao Oni is a japanese horror/puzzle game made in the RPG XP engine. The story revovles around a group of friends, investigating a deserted mansion that is rumored to be haunted. Upon entering the mansion you and your friends discover that the mansion is haunted by a mysterious creature named the Ao Oni (?? in Japanese) a tall creature with a deformed face that proceeds to chase you and your friends through out the mansion. Sealing all exits.

Game.Name: AO Tennis 2
Game.Overview: Get ready for AO Tennis 2 with the incredible AO Tennis 2 Tools. Through this, give yourself a head start by creating all your players, venues and much more!

Game.Name: Apache
Game.Overview:
Fly the most fearsome helicopter to ever grace the skies - the AH-64 Apache. The core gameplay is simulator oriented featuring missions in 4 distinct combat theatres. Enemy threats are fully featured and include a myriad of Russian tanks, anti-aircraft systems, surface to air missiles, and aircraft. For novice users there is an 'arcade' flight model with simplified controls and flight mechanics, in addition to a training mode.
Apache originally came out for DOS in 1995 and was later upgraded to Windows 9x in 1996, featuring a different box and a few minor in-game changes.

Game.Name: Apache: Air Assault
Game.Overview: Apache Air Assault is a helicopter flight simulation. The player takes control of an AH-64 combat helicopter and fulfills a variety of missions in three different scenarios. The settings include Eastern Europe, Africa and South America. Each scenario has a different storyline, revolving around the pilot and the gunner of each battleship.

Game.Name: A Pact With Me
Game.Overview: Belial is a mischievous demon who's looking for humans to make a pact with. In exchange for granting their wishes, he will take their souls after 20 years. One day, he meets three mortals with different backgrounds who seek his help for their own reasons. While assisting them, will Belial grow fond of these humans or corrupt them instead?

Game.Name: A Park Full of Cats
Game.Overview:
Welcome to 'A Park Full of Cats,' a hidden object game that invites you to revel in the enchanting world of amusement parks! Experience the thrill and excitement of the rides and give those cats the fun they truly deserve!
At the center of the park, FofiÃ±o takes the stage! Search for the cats that'll join him in making this an unforgettable show! Explore every nook and cranny, from the Roller Coasters to the Bumper Cars and the towering Ferris Wheels, to find these playful cats!

Game.Name: Apartment 666
Game.Overview: One day you wake up and realise that nobody is home. You try to exit the apartment only to wake up again in your room.You are stuck in an endless cycle of loops with only one way out.

Game.Name: Apartment of Love
Game.Overview: This is a original Galgame with a fascinating storyline. What happened in this apartment, stays in this apartment. Konna Azusa is a pretty girl with a lot of energy in her. She's the same age as the MC and in highschool.

Game.Name: APB Reloaded
Game.Overview: The worldâ€™s first and premier Action MMO Third Person Shooter allows you to choose between two sides of the law. Play as Enforcer or Criminal, customize your gear for the task at hand and hit the streets and play how you want in a city filled with more action this side of a Hollywood blockbuster.

Game.Name: Ape Escape Recomp
Game.Overview: Ape Escape statically recompiled to a native PC executable with PSXRecomp. The game's MIPS code is machine-translated ("recompiled") ahead of time into native C, then compiled into a real Windows program that runs the game's own logic on a faithful simulation of the PS1 hardware (GPU, SPU, GTE, memory cards) plus the real, recompiled PS1 BIOS â€” no high-level emulation shims.

Game.Name: Ape Out
Game.Overview:
APE OUT is a wildly intense and colorfully stylized smash â€˜em up about primal escape, rhythmic violence, and frenetic jazz. Build up nearly unstoppable momentum and use your captors as both weapons and shields to crush everyone on your procedurally generated path to freedom.
Stylish Escape: Embrace bold colors and a dazzling perspective as you rush through tight corridors, open areas, and twisting labyrinths on a mad dash for freedom. Overcome all manner of human opposition, nefarious traps, and breakable obstacles to find each exit and escape captivity.
Grab and Smash: Unleash your primal instincts and incredible strength to overpower your captors. Hold them steady to create a human shield, smash their feeble bodies into walls, or throw one into another in a violent explosion of humanity.
Dynamic Soundtrack: Find your rhythm in the chaos as a dynamic soundtrack of drums, cymbals, and decapitations drive the action to the edge of mayhem.

Game.Name: A Percent of a Pirate
Game.Overview: A captivating pirate adventure to learn math while having fun. Available in some schools, this game will teach you different ways to manipulate percentages and ratios.

Game.Name: A Perfect Day
Game.Overview: Revisit and repeat the final moments of China's turn of the century in this narrative puzzle adventure. Play a 6th-grade student and greet classmates, explore secrets, play mini-4WD, or just wander around town. Make your choices to create a perfect day for everyone!

Game.Name: Aperture Desk Job
Game.Overview: Introducing Aperture Desk Job â€” a free playable short made for the Steam Deck, set in the universe of the modestly popular Portal games.

Game.Name: Aperture Hand Lab
Game.Overview: Experience the high fidelity virtual reality of your own hands like never before.

Game.Name: Aperture Tag: The Paint Gun Testing Initiative
Game.Overview: Aperture Tag: The Paint Gun Testing Initiative is a 2014 first-person puzzle-platform video game developed by the Aperture Tag Team. Originally made as a modification of the Valve Corporation's Portal series, it was officially approved for sale by Valve and released on the software distribution platform Steam on July 15, 2014. The game lacks the iconic portal gun of the series and instead utilizes a newly created paint gun that fires two kinds of gel with different properties. The game features new characters and voice acting, along with twenty-seven levels and a co-op mode that also includes a level editor.[1]

Game.Name: A Petal Among Thorns
Game.Overview:
Flavors: Male Protagonist Daddy / Daughter type story with Incest, Mild Femdom, Mild Pet Play, optional Foot Fetish, romance, build up, teasing, blowjobs, titjobs, vaginal sex, bondage.
~~ Animations and Lewd Sound Effects ~~
Can you indulge in the forbidden fruit without falling prey to the consequences of surrendering to something society considers to be taboo? A Petal Among Thorns takes you through a situation where you and your ward (title changes available in game) fall in love with each other and begin exploring each other sexually.
You're a middle-aged man on a winter retreat with your ward Petal after your failed comedy tour. A relaxing vacation soon presents new feelings of lust towards her. As she begins to show affection towards you in a more sexual manor, you begin to give in to her.
Things begin to heat up as Petal becomes more and more interested in exploring her sexual desires with you. But how far does she want to go?

Game.Name: a pet shop after dark
Game.Overview: PETSITTER WANTED. A horror point-and-click adventure game. Water the plants, feed the pets, and DON'T turn off the lights.

Game.Name: Apewar
Game.Overview: Apewar is an online tactical and action FPS/TPS monkey war game adapted from real life. Build your monkey team and fight against your enemies. Defend the bananas! By playing the game in a coordinated way, you can have fun and win with a good strategy. You can have fun moments in the game with many map options. Remember the saying: Monkeys are strong together!

Game.Name: Apex Aim Trainer
Game.Overview: Improve Your Aim in Apex Legends

Game.Name: Apex Armor Swap Trainer
Game.Overview: The 100% accurate representation of the Armor Swap system from Apex Legends. Use your real game Mouse Sensitivity and Field of View parameters and choose your training mode. Now you're ready to become the best Armor Swapper in the world.

Game.Name: Apex Legends
Game.Overview:
Apex Legends is a battle royale, first-person shooter spin-off of the Titanfall series, developed by Respawn Entertainment. The game is set in a gritty sci-fi world, centered around the in-lore event, the Apex Games, where combatants fight for glory and wealth using an arsenal of weapons, as well as their own tools and abilities.
The player characters available in the game, called legends, have unique abilities and traits, as well as a trait from their categorization within the roster. In most cases, the various weapons the players find during the course of a round are handled equally by all legends, though some have traits that allow for faster handling, i.e. Rampart with her bonus to handling light machine guns.
As of August 2023, the legend roster includes 24 characters: Ash, Ballistic, Bangalore, Bloodhound, Catalyst, Caustic, Crypto, Fuse, Gibraltar, Horizon, Lifeline, Loba, Mad Maggie, Mirage, Newcastle, Octane, Pathfinder, Rampart, Revenant, Seer, Valkyrie, Vantage, Wattson, and Wraith. Some have been featured in previous Titanfall main series games.
The game offers multiple modes, including the main "battle royale" mode and the "control" mode. In the battle royale mode, the players have to fight up to 60 other players to be the last player or squad remaining. The standard squad sizes are two and three, which are queued separately.

Game.Name: Apex Point
Game.Overview: Apex Point is an open world game that aims to immerge you into the Japanese car culture by providing a huge variety of customizations and race types so you can choose your own path

Game.Name: Apico
Game.Overview:
APICO is a laid-back beekeeping sim game about breeding, collecting, & conserving bees! Leave your boring city job behind to return to your family home in Port APICO and get back to your beekeeping roots.
Set in a series of lush environments, APICO uniquely combines resource gathering, biology, and beekeeping minigames, taking ideas from a mix of real-life and fantasy apiculture & floriculture.
On your journey you'll rediscover lost species, cross-breed new bees, and help repopulate the islands.
Features: - Live out your wildest beekeeping fantasies â€“ sting free! -Unique crafting & beekeeping minigames that drive gameplay progression - Cross-breed different bees to discover over 30 new species - Make and sell honey, Apicola, and other beekeeping products - Repopulate lost species and release them back into the wild - Multiple biomes to explore, each with their own unique bee species - Uncover the forgotten secrets of the APICO islands - Play together with friends in 4 player online co-op! - Completed the game but buzzing for more? Try modding!

Game.Name: Apidya' Special
Game.Overview: Apidya' Special is an authentic, 24-bit pixel remake of the legendary 1992 Amiga horizontal scrolling shooter, rebuilt from the ground up by its original creators and published by ININ Games on August 25, 2026.

Game.Name: A Pirate Quartermaster
Game.Overview: Did you think you'd win with a snap of your fingers? Did you think you'd see a crew as a number? Did you think you'd gorge without fear of judgements? But, sir, you're not in the Royal Navy. The pirate's life is a life of dreams. And it's precisely because we have a shitty life that we have dreams.

Game.Name: A Pirate's Legend
Game.Overview: Sail the shores of the amazing southern isles as you go in search of Crimson Jones's treasures. Raise your Jolly Roger flag on each of the 150 puzzle packed levels to master the Pirate Frenzy and earn great rewards! Make chain matches from more than 80 pieces to unlock your pirate achievements and pillage mega loot! Choose from Story Mode or Scavenger Mode to amass a fortune in booty!

Game.Name: A Pixel Story
Game.Overview: A Pixel Story is a devious 2D puzzle platformer that charts the evolution of video games. You must use your Magical Teleportation Hat to explore 6 increasingly detailed zones on your quest to reach the core of The System to stop the evil OS and save the world.

Game.Name: A Place, Forbidden
Game.Overview: A Place, Forbidden is a first-person, lo-fi horror-puzzle game set in the Library of Ouroboros, a seemingly innocuous library that, rumor has it, contains knowledge not meant for the eyes of mortal man. We hope you enjoy your visit.

Game.Name: A Plague Tale: Innocence
Game.Overview:
A Plague Tale: Innocence is a single-player stealth-based action game. The story takes place in 14th-century France during the Hundred Yearsâ€™ War, where the land is devastated by both armed conflict and the spread of a mysterious plague. The player controls Amicia de Rune, a young noble forced to flee her home with her younger brother Hugo after their family is attacked by the Inquisition. Amicia must guide Hugo across villages, battlefields, and ruined countryside, all while uncovering the secret behind his unusual illness and its link to the swarms of rats overwhelming the land.
The gameplay combines stealth, environmental navigation, and light puzzle-solving. Amicia is lightly armed, relying primarily on her sling to distract guards, break objects, and defend herself in limited situations. Combat is not the focus: instead, players are encouraged to avoid direct confrontation by sneaking past patrols, using cover, and manipulating the environment to create opportunities for escape. The sling can be upgraded over time, allowing for more precise shots, faster reloads, and enhanced utility against armored enemies.

Game.Name: A Plague Tale: Requiem
Game.Overview:
Embark on a heartrending journey into a brutal, breathtaking world, and discover the cost of saving those you love in a desperate struggle for survival. Strike from the shadows or unleash hell with a variety of weapons, tools and unearthly powers.
Far across the sea, an island callsâ€¦ Embark on a heartrending journey into a brutal, breathtaking world twisted by supernatural forces.
After escaping their devastated homeland, Amicia and Hugo travel far south, to new regions and vibrant cities. There, they attempt to start a new life and control Hugoâ€™s curse.
But, when Hugoâ€™s powers reawaken, death and destruction return in a flood of devouring rats. Forced to flee once more, the siblings place their hopes in a prophesized island that may hold the key to saving Hugo.
Discover the cost of saving those you love in a desperate struggle for survival. Strike from the shadows or unleash hell, overcoming foes and challenges with a variety of weapons, tools and unearthly powers.
â— Sequel to the award-winning adventure A Plague Tale: Innocence â— A spectacular grounded tale twisted by supernatural forces â— Use a variety of tools, sneak, fight, or unleash hell and rats â— Stunning visuals combine with an enthralling score

Game.Name: A Planet of Mine
Game.Overview: A Planet of Mine is a mini procedural 4X. Starting from a single and unique planet, survive, gather and combine resources, develop your technologies and start the conquest of space.

Game.Name: A Plot Story
Game.Overview: Learn how a girl Lily managed to frustrate the plans of mean Duchess and to save the Crown Prince.

Game.Name: Aplowcalypse
Game.Overview: Snow Plows vs Aliens: 4 player, local co-op chaos

Game.Name: A Plunge into Darkness
Game.Overview: What happens when a group of friends decides to visit a mysterious, haunted castle? What started as a bit of fun is about to become a life-changing event for them. But the real question is: can they make it out of the castle alive?

Game.Name: Apocalipsis: Harry at the End of the World
Game.Overview:
Apocalipsis: Harry at the End of the World is a traditional point-and-click adventure game, in the vain of Samorost and Machinarium, where solving puzzles comes with a sense of discovery and accomplishment. This gameplay style, merged with unique artstyle inspired by 15th century engravings, creates the perfect backdrop for a story about heartbreak, redemption and, quite literally, the end of the world.
In Apocalipsis you play as Harry, for whom the loss of his beloved was the end of his world. Now he has to venture out into the strange, unwelcoming lands to get her back. On his journey he will meet fantastical creatures, straight from the minds of artists from the 15th century Europe, and ultimately conquer his own, personal demons. Featuring the narration by Nergal, leader of the band Behemoth, with the added atmospheric new rendition of Behemoth's music, it will be a journey to remember.
Apocalipsis shares with the Middle Ages its artstyle and the gameâ€™s world itself is inspired by Book of Revelation and steeped in medieval philosophy and beliefs, with the story taking cues from Dante Alighieriâ€™s â€œDivine Comedyâ€. Every location and character in Apocalipsis was inspired by classical woodcuts by 15th and 16th century artists such as Hans Holbein, Michael Wolgemut, and Albrecht DÃ¼rer. This pairing of medieval art and philosophy with video games creates something unique, like youâ€™ve never seen before.

Game.Name: Apocalipsis: Wormwood Edition
Game.Overview: Apocalipsis: Wormwood Edition is the first release on the Nintendo Switch of the base game Apocalipsis: Harry at the End of the World and its DLC, Apocalipsis: One Night in the Woods.

Game.Name: Apocalive
Game.Overview: Apocalive is a third-person wave based zombie shooter, which comes with several different maps. Collect guns, ammo, health packs and use grenades and shoot at explosive barrels to stop the upcoming hordes. Use your rolling, flipping skills to confuse zombies and avoid their attacks.

Game.Name: Apocalypse: Floodgates
Game.Overview: Herd 'em up, Mow 'em Down! Mindless Carnage, fast-paced action. Apocalypse: Floodgates is a Third-Person Zombie Horde Shooter featuring post-apocalyptic weapons and deadly traps. Play online with up to four friends or play alone and see how many zombie waves you can take down.

Game.Name: Apocalypse Hotel: The Post-Apocalyptic Hotel Simulator!
Game.Overview: Can you run a successful hotel even though the world has ended? Repair, renovate, and decorate the â€˜Apocalypse Hotelâ€™ while fending off zombies, mutants and the alien Gogfang!

Game.Name: Apocalypse Lovers
Game.Overview: Apocalypse Lovers is an adult video game series based on the interactive virtual story model. But also includes different gameplay elements such as inventory management or resources gathering. The game will be divided into episodes and chapters during which very different themes and topics will be addressed. What will remain constant, however, is the fact that in this game, you, the player, will be at the center of the action all along. This means that you will have a direct impact on how the story unfolds and on the world in which you will evolve!

Game.Name: Apocalypse Never
Game.Overview: Lazy shut-in Seryozha is always late to everything, no matter what. Although it seems his friend has finally had enough, so if heâ€™s late one more time, Seryozhaâ€™s very life could be on the line. Good thing he woke up in time, but thereâ€™s one little problemâ€¦heâ€™s locked in his house and canâ€™t get out.

Game.Name: Apocalypse Party
Game.Overview: Apocalypse Party is a 3D top-down action Roguelike game. In this game, you will embark on a new mission to traverse through the Middle Ages and gradually master abilities, and arm yourself to become the strongest survivor through numerous choices.

Game.Name: Apocalypse: Party's Over
Game.Overview: Well, to sum this mess up, you will make the APOCALYPSE happen by hiting people in the face using your own JOHNSON. ThatÂ´s right, your own dick. THAT because JESUS realize that the world is hopeless, so he reschedule the apocalypse for NOW, and you can choose up to 3 soldiers to cleanse the humanity! You can be a guy with a impressive erection, a mercenary priest or a psycho killer, each one has their own special skills and atributes. This game is inspired in the classic arcade beat 'em up games mixed with the unfamous Brazilian politicaly-wrong humour. You can make the Apocalypse happen alone or with a friend, or just train your skills in the endless CHUQ CHALLENGE!

Game.Name: Apocalyptica
Game.Overview: Apocalyptica is a third-person shooter computer game that was developed by Extreme FX and published by Konami on October 24, 2003.

Game.Name: Apocryph
Game.Overview: Apocryph is an old-school fantasy shooter inspired by Hexen, Heretic, Painkiller and Strife.

Game.Name: Apocryphauna
Game.Overview:
Content Warning: contains depictions of transphobia, homophobia, religious extremism, and child abuse, along with brief violent and tryphopobic imagery.
There's something wrong with you. You've been sent away to a private boarding school so they can fix you. If that weren't bad enough, they took away your entire collection of Apocryphauna trading cards. If you want to rebuild your collection, you'll have to be careful. If they catch you again, the punishment will be so much worse.
After all, the nuns think this game is evil â€” that playing with these cards can summon Discordia, the mother of all demons. But that's not true. It's just a game... right?

Game.Name: Apokalypsis
Game.Overview: The Alpha-Draconian army to which you belong is one of the most powerful of the Galaxy, and you are one of the most capable pilots of this army having fought in countless battles...

Game.Name: Apollo 11 VR
Game.Overview: Apollo 11 VR is the story of the greatest journey ever taken by humankind. This VR experience is a recreation of the events which took place between July 16th and July 24th 1969. Now for the first time ever you get to experience this historic event through the eyes of those who lived through it.

Game.Name: Apollo 11 VR HD
Game.Overview: Apollo 11 VR HD is the story of the greatest journey ever taken by humankind. Now you get to experience this historic event through the eyes of those who lived through it.

Game.Name: Apollo 18: The Moon Missions
Game.Overview:
Apollo 18: The Moon Missions is an attempt at creating a realistic simulation of manning an Apollo space trip. The game comes on two disks: a video-heavy orientation section, and a the actual simulation training at Johnson Space Center.
Players will be tested on proper commands and sequence, in hopes that they will move on to the actual Apollo 18 launch. Once on the shuttle, the player will spend most of their time staring at the control panels, putting what they've learned to the test. The simulation is broken up by short arcade sequences, but for the most part is occupied by looking at readouts and buttons.
A heavy emphasis is put on correct procedure, as the game shoots for accuracy over flash. Commands must be precisely entered, in sequence. Mission Control will help the player with staying on track, but players will experience bouts of "radio interference" that will require a good memory.

Game.Name: Apollo4x
Game.Overview: Apollo4x is a casual-to-difficult space trading tycoon game, where success is measured in earnings from how efficient your trade routes are in transporting supplies to demands on your planets. Combat is card based, and uses a unique system never before seen.

Game.Name: Apollo Justice: Ace Attorney Trilogy
Game.Overview: Join rookie attorney Apollo Justice and his mentor, the legendary Phoenix Wright, in this collection of 3 games! This title features the 14 episodes of "Apollo Justice: Ace Attorney", "Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney - Dual Destinies", and "Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney - Spirit of Justice", and the 2 previously DLC-only Special Episodes for a total of 16 episodes! Also included is a mountain of extra goodies that's sure to satisfy any Ace Attorney fan!

Game.Name: Apollyon
Game.Overview: Choice-based RPG in a dark fantasy world. Apollyon is narrative-driven, and features occult magic, spirit summoning, a deep universe, playable characters, and story progression alone or in multiplayer!

Game.Name: Apolune 2
Game.Overview: Apolune 2 is a hilarious and shocking resource management game where one player (or more) experience life on an asteroid mining team in deep space. Tethered to a heavy space station, the game evolves as you mine ore for money, trade and upgrade your station, alone or with your friends.

Game.Name: Apopia: Prologue
Game.Overview: APOPIA is a comedic adventure with dark mysteries. Help young girl Mai to find her way home. Progress by solving puzzles and outsmarting enemies in minigames. Make friends and foes with talking animals. Unravel the mystery of Maiâ€™s identity from her dark and blurry memories.

Game.Name: Aporia: Beyond the Valley
Game.Overview: CRYNEGINE Indie Game of 2017. Featuring an incredibly detailed ancient world and a breathtaking soundtrack, Aporia: Beyond the Valley takes open world storytelling to new heights of adventure.

Game.Name: Apostle
Game.Overview: 50 years have passed since the monsters last threatened humanity. In those years, life has returned to normal. However, this peace can't last forever. Play as Rei Yagami as his life is changed forever.

Game.Name: Apothecarium: The Renaissance of Evil: Premium Edition
Game.Overview: During the Middle Ages a terrifying, mysterious disease raged across Italy. It killed thousands of people, whole towns and villages perished together. There were legends of a mythical town of Apothecarium, where the secret to defeating the disease was hidden.

Game.Name: Apotheon
Game.Overview:
Apotheon is a 2D side-scrolling action game with puzzle elements and a visual design based on the Black Figure style of Ancient Greek pottery. The game is set in a world based on Ancient Greek mythology. The gods have abandoned the world and now the sea is without fish, the forest without trees and the earth without sun. Mankind has fallen prey to war to survive. The player controls the young warrior Nikandreos who fights the Olympian gods with the help of Hera.
Nikandreos needs to fight enemies and solve environment based puzzles to progress. He can pick up new weapons in the environment and many parts are destructible, providing new weapons that can be cycled through quickly, health, armour and coins. Coins can be spent to acquire better equipment. Weapons include swords, spears, bows, knives, javelins, stones, axes, hammers, slingshots, fire bombs and explosive traps. In later parts of the game different abilities of weapons often need to be used quickly in succession. For most of the weapons there are improved versions that can be located with additional abilities.
The level path is not linear and it is possible to explore in different directions, akin to an open world where Olympus acts as a central hub. Through a map different types of objectives are presented and these can generally be tackled in any order. The main quest consists of completing several domains, one for each god, split up in multiple smaller levels. Information about the different gods and their motives is often provided through stone steles. There are often side quests and optional objectives. The domains for the different gods include Apollo, Ares, Artemis, Athena, Hades, Poseidon and Zeus while the main locations are the Acropolis, the Agora market and the Olympian Gate. There is no experience system to level up, but a steady increase of weapons proficiency and armour strength through purchases.
The game has three difficulty settings and supports local one-on-one multiplayer where two players fight duels in small environments.

Game.Name: Apotheosis X
Game.Overview: Apotheosis X is a total conversion for Marathon Infinity running on the Aleph One engine. Apotheosis X pushes the boundaries of what's possible aesthetically with the marathon engine whilst retaining its low resolution 90's charm. The campaign features engaging combat that scales with player skill and aggression, with a roster of new enemies and weaponry that compliments the original games' nuance and high skill ceiling.

Game.Name: Apotris
Game.Overview: Apotris is a free multiplatform open-source block stacking game! What sets Apotris apart from other block stacking games is its extensive customization options, complemented by ultra-responsive controls that let you execute your moves with precision. With 14 unique game modes and a plethora of settings, you can tailor the game to your preferences, ensuring a fresh and challenging experience every time you play. Whether you're a casual player or a hardcore enthusiast, Apotris has something for everyone. You can even battle your friends using the Gameboy Advance Link Cable or Wireless Adapters in 2-Player Battle! While Apotris was originally designed for Gameboy Advance, it now supports all kinds of platforms, so between the ports and emulation you can play Apotris on almost anything.

Game.Name: APOX
Game.Overview:
APOX is a real-time strategy game with resource gathering and includes certain aspects of a first-person shooter games, eg. weapon- and ammo-drops, and two-weapon loadout. Adding soldiers with different weapons to vehicles will dynamically create new vehicle types, based on the weapon loadout of the added soldiers.
This game is primarily an online multiplayer game and there is no single-player campaign. There are eight tutorial missions which introduce the gameplay, and 100 scrimmage maps which can be played against the AI or against online opponents.

Game.Name: AppGameKit Classic
Game.Overview: AppGameKit Classic is a powerful game development engine, ideal for Hobbyist and Indie developers. Choose to code in the easy to learn AppGameKit BASIC or use our libraries in C++ & XCode. Write your code once and deploy easily to multiple mobile & desktop platforms.

Game.Name: Apple Pop
Game.Overview:
Apple Pop is a super relaxing, super satisfying Puzzle Popper with powerups, beautiful scenery and major combo's for literally anyone to play to pass the time or to let off some stress. Apple Pop is Inspired by the great ''Peggle'' Games.
Looking for a game to play while you are deciding what to play? or to just relax while watching a good series. Here you go!
Apple Pop takes an interesting twist on the Genre Combing two great mechanics from Peggle and Brick breaker resulting in an absolute beautiful and Unique experience which anyone and their gran-ma can play.
The game uses a tweaked physics system to make sure everything happens as it should while you are getting those super combo breakers!
The game has 45 levels each with a pass grade and a golden pass grade for those who want a challenge!
There are plenty power-ups in the game such as that will change how each level turns out, each power-up when collected changes your next shot dramatically.
Apple Pop aims to be a super relaxing, and at times challenging beautiful game for literally anyone to play to pass the time or to let off some stress.

Game.Name: Appointment With F.E.A.R.
Game.Overview: YOU are Titan City's resident superhero in this interactive graphic novel! Fight crime and solve clues to discover FEAR's fiendish plot!

Game.Name: Apprentice Arriving
Game.Overview: Apprentice Arriving is a 3D-Fantasy RPG where you dive into the role of a sorcerer's disciple, blessed with incredible powers. You are the next Apprentice. Set off on a new adventure with enormous proportions!

Game.Name: Apprentice Knight-Iona
Game.Overview: Take up the mantle of an Apprentice Knight Iona in this Action-RPG game on her quest to be part of the Brave Heroâ€™s Party. Failing the knighthood examination, you must now train with your master to prove yourself worthy.

Game.Name: Approaching Blocks
Game.Overview: Play and study foreign words! Try dodge from blocks. When you loss, showing words in a foreign language. To complete each level hold 100 seconds. First two levels are quite simple, but starting from the third, it will be hard.

Game.Name: A Princess' Tale
Game.Overview: What happens when the fate of the world falls into the hands of the most irresponsible bubblehead to ever trip over royal birth? Play this 16-bit style old-school RPG and find out!

Game.Name: Apsulov: End of Gods
Game.Overview: In this future viking horror you awake in a sanctuary of steel and concrete, built to research and exploit the worlds of Yggdrasil, and to house an artifact, buried in the earth aeons ago.First person with a futuristic Norse mythology story. Horror adventure in the realms of Yggdrasil.

Game.Name: Aquaball
Game.Overview: It's crustacean-crushing action, under the sea! From brilliantly animated seashells, starfish and other marine life to anchors, treasure chests and explosive mines, Aquaball is brimming with wet and wild breakout fun! Unlock five aquatic mini-games as you plunge through 150 spectacular levels! Use the 23 unique bonuses to wreak havoc, including the devastating Aqua-Gun, which fires an expanding ring of water-bullets. So, take a deep breath and begin riding the wave to watery thrills with Aquaball!

Game.Name: Aquabble Avalanche
Game.Overview: Aquabbles are beautiful magic bubbles in 3D. Their avalanche either never stops (Quick mode) or grows gradually (Quiet mode). The action is going on in the breathtaking surrondings - clear pond, reed, fish and dragonflies flying over. You can even see all the pebbles! Great variety of bonuses and features that will be added level by level will not let you get bored and will challenge the spirit of any gamer-explorer. Release the aquabble avalanche!

Game.Name: Aquabble Quest
Game.Overview: Aquabbles are back! On the magical river of Azabelle, the spring rains stir up the water, creating mysterious aquabbles of all types and colors. Pop them all up! Help Timmy get to his mom and pa by clearing bubbles on his way home in Quest game mode. Or take your time, plan your shots and play around with aquabbles in a pond for high score in Casual mode. Enjoy tons of bonuses Timmy can use to help himself solve aquabble puzzles. Featuring: - Over 150 Challenging Levels! - 2 Ways to Play - Quest Mode and Casual Mode! - Beautiful 3D Graphics and Relaxing Music! - Tons of Fun Bonuses and Power-Ups.

Game.Name: Aqua Bubble
Game.Overview: The pressure is on as a churning waterfall of bubbles is falling towards you. Can you launch bubbles fast enough? Match 3 like colors or the cascade of bubbles will overtake you! Featuring a dancing, music playing, aquatic cheerleader, Aqua Bubble is a charming game that is fun for the whole family.

Game.Name: Aqua Bubble II
Game.Overview: Watch out! Aqua bubbles overflow the waterman's kingdom. Can you launch bubbles fast enough? Match 3 like colors or the cascade of bubbles will overtake you! Stifle the rebellion, restore peace, and see Aquatic's belly dance.

Game.Name: Aquacade
Game.Overview: Get into your submarine and go pearl-fishing deep under the sea. You'll meet exotic marine animals, and reveal the secrets of the ocean while making combos out of colorful pearls. Discover mysterious items and use your ship powers wisely to collect as many pearls as you can. - Beautiful underwater environment with brightly colored fish and turtles, beautiful plants and corals and realistic lighting. - Amusing crab character supports you while you are fishing for pearls. - Chargeable recoloring buttons and lots of funny power-ups to enrich your playing experience. - Three game modes: Strategy to test your mind, Arcade to compete with time, Classic for line-making lovers.

Game.Name: Aquaculture Land: Fish Farming Simulation
Game.Overview: Aquaculture Land is a fish farming management game. You will act as a freshwater fish farm manager to nurture different varieties of fish, produce high-quality commodities, and fulfill your customers' needs to grow your business.
Game.Genres: Construction and Management Simulation; Life Simulation

Game.Name: Aquadine
Game.Overview: "Welcome to Aquadine! My name is Ciel, and I'll be your tour guide for today!" A young gondolier works part-time to save money for his mother's hospital bills, but he has a secret. Follow Ciel as he tours people around the beautiful town of Aquadine, where his family and friends bond with him.

Game.Name: Aqua Fish
Game.Overview: The underwater world of Aquafish is waiting for you, build a beautiful aquarium buy winning coins in the classic tile-matching puzzle game mode!

Game.Name: Aqua Kitty: Milk Mine Defender
Game.Overview: Aqua Kitty is a fast paced retro styled submarine arcade shooter with optional 2 player local Co-op.Blast through hordes of mechanical sea monsters in your kitty sub and defend the deep sea milk mining kittens!THE MILK MUST FLOW!

Game.Name: Aqua Kitty UDX
Game.Overview: AQUA KITTY UDX blasts onto PC in this enhanced Ultra Deluxe Edition including the epic Dreadnought game mode!

Game.Name: Aquaman: War of the Water Worlds
Game.Overview:
Aquaman: War of the Water Worlds is an interactive comic based on the animated TV series Aquaman (1968). In fact, most of the content is directly taken from the episode War of the Water Worlds in which Mera, Aquaman's wife, is kidnapped by a war lord who has the power to bewitch people. This game retells the story how Aquaman rescues her.
Gameplay is non-existent: the player is presented with comic panels. Depending on where the player clicks on, the dialogue is voice acted or a short video from the episode is played. There is an auto-play feature and a page selection.

Game.Name: Aquamarine
Game.Overview: A linear narrative adventure about surviving in a hand-drawn alien ocean. Explore a planet reclaimed by nature. Cultivate new life to survive. Discover a lost history. Find your way home.

Game.Name: Aqua Moto Racing Utopia
Game.Overview:
Aqua Moto Racing Utopia is a challenging watercraft racing game which combines extreme speed, stunts and state-of-the art water simulation into a modern action filled gaming experience.
Featuring an extensive career mode with three single player championship campaigns, 4 player split screen racing and also an 8 player Online racing mode, Aqua Moto Racing Utopia offers action fueled fun. Add to that 4 creative party modes for that perfect gaming party.
Aqua Moto Racing Utopia lets you create your your own unique avatar to show off online with its powerful creation tool. The tool also lets you design your own vehicle to stand out from the pack when you push past that last competitor to claim first place in a tight race.
Sharpen your riding skills to perfection in 10 different beautiful environments with different weather and lighting conditions. Learn when to, and not to, push that boost button to pass your competitors through calm water or through huge North Sea waves.

Game.Name: AquaNox
Game.Overview: The water is no longer calm. The undersea world has undergone a transformation from tranquil environment to a place of unspeakable violence, graphic murder and horrific danger.

Game.Name: AquaNox 2: Revelation
Game.Overview: AQUANOX 2: REVELATION is a new story of the underwater world Aqua. In 2666 a young freighter pilot called William Drake sets out to search for the heritage of a mythical ancestor. He is looking for adventure - and finds greed, ruthlessness, merciless hatred â€¦ and also unexpected help.

Game.Name: Aquanox: Deep Descent
Game.Overview: We left the surface of the Earth in ruins, abandoned it and populated the oceans. The sea is now our new home. We call it Aqua. Pilot customized fighter ships and explore a deep sea dystopia torn by the struggle for resources and survival. Enter the unforgiving world of Aquanox Deep Descent.

Game.Name: Aqua Panic!
Game.Overview: After a violent tropical cyclone, the fish, shrimp, octopuses and other sea creatures find themselves flung out of the waterâ€¦ There's not a minute to lose! Use original tools to guide them to freedom! You'll need to think hard and act fast to save them all!

Game.Name: AquaPark
Game.Overview: Fill the AquaPark with colorful and exotic fish in this exciting and original challenge. Click on the swimming fish and they'll become trapped in a bubble and float to the surface where they'll be collected and sent off to the AquaPark. AquaPark includes two thrilling game modes plus a relaxing aquarium mode. The more fish you collect, the more exciting your aquarium will be.

Game.Name: AQUAPAZZA: Aquaplus Dream Match
Game.Overview:
26 characters from across AQUAPLUS's classic franchises clash in this action-packed fighting game! Master your favorite heroes from games and anime including Utawarerumono, To Heart 2, White Album, and more!
Pick from a roster of over a dozen fan favorites. Dominate the battlefield with your character's unique moveset and movement!
Fight hard and make aggressive plays to keep your character in peak form with the Active Emotion System! Finish your opponents off with devastating and powerfully animated Splash Arts! Bring new friends to the couch anytime with the optional Simple control scheme!
You don't just pick one character to control: select one of a dozen more partner characters, then call on them for powerful assists that can change the course of the fight!

Game.Name: Aqua Pearls
Game.Overview:
Aqua Pearls takes you on a fantasy adventure at the ocean bottom. Your mission is to find a stolen necklace that protects four oceans from evil. The game shines with plenty of match-and-pop puzzles, superb visuals, animations and author's music.
40 levels to go in multiple modes. 12 bonuses to spice up the game play. 2 skins for bubbles. A lively character to play with. Nice sound effects and music.

Game.Name: Aquaria
Game.Overview: Aquaria is an award-winning action-adventure game set in a massive underwater world teeming with life and filled with ancient secrets. Join Naija, a lone underwater adventurer, as she travels from hidden caves shrouded in darkness, to beautiful, sunlit oases in search of her past.

Game.Name: Aquarist
Game.Genres: Construction and Management Simulation; Life Simulation

Game.Name: Aquarium
Game.Overview: A simulation video game published by Electronic Arts Square, in which the player creates and controls a sea life aquarium.The player begins with an expanse of empty floor space and the task is to construct a maritime attraction for visitors which must be filled with interesting and appropriate creatures at the same time as dealing with all the attendant challenges of running a profitable business. There are two ways of getting fish and other sea life, either by buying them off sellers or by catching them yourself. Dolphin shows can also be created and serve as the star attraction of the aquarium. Staff must be hired to maintain the aquarium and also to take proper care and attention to the animals.

Game.Name: Aquarium Designer
Game.Overview: Aquarium Designer gives you an opportunity to create the aquarium of your dreams! Become a professional whose job is to design it, build it, and fill it with the various underwater wildlife! All types, all sizes - your creativity is your only limit!

Game.Name: Aquarius
Game.Overview: Aquarius is a 90's style arcade game where you play as a cave diver in search for treasure, guarded by the ocean's fiercest predators and its cuddliest minnows. Navigate through the caves, collect the treasure, and survive!

Game.Name: Aquatico
Game.Overview: Aquatico is a survival city builder set within the depths of the sea. Strategically build an underwater city atop the ocean floor and face the challenges that accompany an oceanic life.

Game.Name: Aquatic of Sherwood
Game.Overview: â€œAquatic of Sherwoodâ€ is a fun quest for the missing bride with a bubble-popup gimmick. Match 3 or more bubbles to pop them up. With its humorous character, 50 levels to go and 9 cool bonuses, the game doesnâ€™t grow stale in a short while. - 50 levels to go in puzzle and arcade modes - 9 bonuses to spice up the game play - 3 skins for bubbles - A lively character to play with - Nice sound effects and music, specially written and recorded for the game

Game.Name: Aqua Words
Game.Overview: A new brilliant version of a word game with a well-known hero - Aquatic! This is the right game for word game fun. Link bubble letters to create bursting words cheering a lovely dancing man! No shooting, no violence, just a little kind Aquatic looking for help! Do you miss the hot summer and dream of Hawaiian Beaches? Then, try this game! Enjoy its unique graphics with 3 different nature backgrounds! Feel free choosing among various difficulty modes.
