Game.Name: A Wave of Lights
Game.Overview:
In a seaside town, Hannah spends her days asleep and her nights wandering the empty beach. Too anxious to hold down a job or go to school, her roommate thinks she's hopeless. Hannah is inclined to agree.
On one of these monotonous nights, a spaceship crashes on the beach! The cute alien inside disrupts Hannah's life... and her entire sense of self.
Update: Version 1.2 adds a Spanish translation courtesy of Dunkelheyt! Version 1.1 resolves all bugs and adds a cute little visual things, courtesy of Valeatory!

Game.Name: Away From Earth: Mars
Game.Overview: What is the line between genius and crazy? Genius people has a opportunity to perform their crazy ideas to real. A Game that you'll see if can you make Elon Musk's Creating Mars Colony dream as real in 2055 or just die as a normal human...

Game.Name: AWAY: Journey to the Unexpected
Game.Overview: In a mood for a little journey to a colourful world full of unexpected events and crazy characters? Jump into a feel-good adventure with rogue-lite elements, where action meets cuteness and powers come with friendship. A love letter to anime and quirkiness from two indie developers.

Game.Name: A Way Out
Game.Overview: A Way Out is an exclusively co-op adventure where you play the role of one of two prisoners making their daring escape from prison.

Game.Name: Awe
Game.Overview: Your feelings and logic are very important in this game. Feel like a detective in a strange and extremely dangerous place. Investigate the loss of people, simultaneously solving puzzles and trying not to fall into the trap.

Game.Name: Awesome Machine
Game.Overview: This is a "Rube Goldberg" style puzzle game inspired on the award winning "The incredible Machine". Discover what it takes to be a scientist and build awesome contraptions with simulated real physics using trampolines, balls, explosives and much more.

Game.Name: Awesome Metal Detecting
Game.Overview: The best treasure hunter game.

Game.Name: Awesome Mix Tape
Game.Overview: Struggle with obsolete tech to load up cracking slices of gaming fun.

Game.Name: Awesomenauts
Game.Overview: Use your power, show your might! Play this Multiplayer Online Battle Arena (MOBA) game for FREE now! AWESOMENAUTS combines 2D platforming with team-based strategy and hero based action. Whether you are a new recruit or an intergalactic legend, play AWESOMENAUTS!

Game.Name: Awesome Pea
Game.Overview: Help the greedy Pea to make his way through a string of levels filled with deadly traps and cute but dangerous enemies and collect all the coins to which he can only reach!

Game.Name: Awesome Pea 2
Game.Overview: Greedy Pea is back in game! Dark dungeons, deadly traps, everything is green, a lot of gold everywhere!

Game.Name: A Whisper in the Twilight: Chapter One
Game.Overview: A Whisper in the Twilight is a first person Mystery/Sci-Fi/Puzzle game. A wholly unique player experience, aiming to reinvent the single-player genre.

Game.Name: A Wild Catgirl Appears!
Game.Overview: A Wild Catgirl Appears is a short romance visual novel featuring multiple routes, different girls to date and of course, catgirls! You follow the story of Ami, a loner at high school, as she joins the school's coding club and sets about making her first video game.

Game.Name: A Winding Path
Game.Overview: A Winding Path is a hand-drawn adventure game about finding the beauty of the world and enjoying the little things. Explore the atmosphere of ancient caverns, enchanting forests and busy settlements, help colorful characters, find the rain and unveil its magic. The Rainmaker awaits!

Game.Name: Awita: Journey of Hope
Game.Overview: Awita: Journey of Hope is a captivating game that follows the remarkable journey of a courageous girl determined to rescue her village from the clutches of a devastating epidemic. This game is a side-scrolling metroidvania adventure that centers around sword combat. Your task is to traverse an expansive kingdom, encounter new friends and enemies, engage in battles with formidable bosses, and enhance your character's abilities through leveling up.

Game.Name: A Wizard's Lizard
Game.Overview: Conquer the forces of Death in A Wizardâ€™s Lizard, an action RPG for Windows, Mac, and Linux. Explore ever-changing dungeons, filled with powerful weapons and items. Battle back the hordes of evil. Rescue villagers to improve your town and increase your power for your next trek into the dungeon.

Game.Name: A Wizard's Lizard: Soul Thief
Game.Overview: A hardcore rogue-lite action RPG where you possess and play as monsters. Narrowly avoid death as you explore challenging, ever-changing dungeons, and possess any body you can to survive!

Game.Name: Awkward Dimensions Redux
Game.Overview: They may be awkward dimensions, but they're my dreams...

Game.Name: A.W.O.L.
Game.Overview:
Are you ready to go A.W.O.L.?
Step into the combat boots of Dwayne Allen, a recently discharged special forces soldier, as he joins his former squad mates on their hunt for their missing C.O.
A.W.O.L. is a first-person, mil-spec shooter developed using the Build engine (Duke Nukem 3D, Ion Fury). Features:
* Command your squad - A.W.O.L. features three A.I. team mates with unique behaviors to support Allen in combat.
* Intelligent enemies - to bring the retro FPS forward in time, A.W.O.L. features sophisticated enemy A.I. for a more modern challenge. Enemies will take cover, hide, ambush, and work together to try and take your team out.
* No procedural generation - 9 uniquely-crafted levels for a tailored, bespoke experience!
* Hand-drawn heroes - Bespoke sprite and texture art with serious retro FPS style!
* Pick your playstyle - Players will be able to choose from "action-movie" style play, or amp up the challenging with more realistic combat modes!

Game.Name: A Wolf in Autumn
Game.Overview: A dark, surreal psychological horror game, in which a young girl finds herself locked in a shed, in the middle of an idyllic autumn forest.

Game.Name: A World, At Peace
Game.Overview:
Explore a relaxing low-poly 3D world with a short narrative.
A World, At Peace began as an exercise in game development using Unreal Engine 4, and 3D modeling in Cinema 4D, for my second-year design studio course at New Jersey Institute of Technology. 3-4 weeks production time, with no prior knowledge of the programs. Additionally, I applied my current experience in music composition for original music and sound. It was exhibited and critiqued on December 21, 2016.
The itch.io version of A World, At Peace has been slightly enhanced to include random spawning between two set collectible patterns, added and edited dialogue, and other minor fixes.

Game.Name: A World of Keflings
Game.Overview:
Keflings may be small, but their kingdom-building adventures are gigantic!
Journey to faraway lands and help your tiny Kefling friends along the way. Harvest resources to create and customize beautiful cities filled with fountains, workshops, castles and more.
Complete quests! Compose music! Build a robot, rescue the princess, make friends with a dragon, and help a creepy witch get even creepier in this exciting, friendly, city-building adventure!

Game.Name: Axanael
Game.Overview:
"Shoot - and your wish will come true. But one of the bullets is real. Pull the trigger if you're ready to risk your life."
Deep below Akihabara, a version of Russian roulette called the Kagome Game is being played on New Yearâ€™s Eve 2010. Six people take turns shooting a gun called Axanael, which has the ability to grant wishes. However, there is a price for equaling the hopes, and it is paid by one of the players' lives.

Game.Name: Axe Cop
Game.Overview:
In 2009, two brothers, Malachai (age 5) and Ethan (age 29) Nicolle, created the comic book, Axe Cop. Over the years, the brothers pitted Axe Cop and his team of strong fighters against the most deadly, disgusting, and horrifying bad guys that their imaginations could come up with. In celebration of over ten years of Axe Cop, we are proud to present the official Axe Cop Game!
Play as Axe Cop and his team in this classic retro RPG! Take on challenging missions against his most devious enemies such as Bad Santa Claus, Dr. Stinkyhead, Dr. Doo doo and more! The Axe Cop Game is great for casual and hardcore RPG gamers alike, offering plenty of strategy, quests and story for any gamer to sink their axe into!
After Axe Cop finds his axe at the scene of the fire, he'll meet up with Flute Cop and his career as the most epic hero begins. Once he recovers a mysterious machine, capable of turning any bad guy into a good guy, he and his team of heroes are convinced that they can stop all bad guys once and for all with it. But they must hunt down three magic gems to power it up. Along the way, Axe Cop will face off against his most diablocal rogues and visit some of the most dangerous locations from his comic book history, a volcano full of dinosaurs, the insides of a giant monster, even London itself! The bad guys are teaming up and will not be making it any easier for Axe Cop to find these magic stones.
COMBAT: Traditional turn-based gameplay. Characters learn moves and power up based on decisions you make with their stats on each level up. ABILITIES: Each hero on Axe Cop's team has a unique ability in the field. Axe Cop can chop and break most cracked items, Flute Cop can interact with magic statues, Sockarang has a remote control sock boomerang. Every character offers something different to every level. CAMEOS: Odds are if Ethan Nicolle drew a character, they are likely in the game. Some of them even he is surprised are in the game, such as the obscure El Fuego (a wrestler who was turned into a potato). STORY: The game is a celebration of every comic the Nicolle brothers made together. Representation from every single published book is featured in the game, whether as full main missions or side content.
Red Triangle Games is an independent game studio from Florida, that has been using the OHR.RPG.CE game making engine for over 20 years. In 2013 we made our debut on the Google Play store with a remastered version of our game Scare Spree. We have been continuously producing games ever since. The team consists of Matthew Edson (programming and game design), James Pandelis/Soda Piggy (battle artwork and music), Ryan McQuinn (sound effects), with minigames and other assistance by Richard Upchurch, James Paige and Ralph Versteegen.

Game.Name: AX:EL Air Xenodawn
Game.Overview: Combining the very best of sci-fi and aerial dogfighting gameplay, AX:EL delivers a totally new gaming experience. Create your very own shape-shifting vehicle and dominate both the sky and the ocean.

Game.Name: Axel & Pixel
Game.Overview: Axel and Pixel are trapped in a beautiful but dangerous dream world. If they plan to get out they must solve its mysteries. Drawn by hand and rendered in full high-definition, Axel & Pixel is a unique journey through an artist's dream.

Game.Name: Axes and Acres
Game.Overview: Axes and Acres is a deep and engaging single-player strategy game designed to create exciting decisions every turn. The rules are easy to learn, but every turn can be played out in many different ways in order to farm, build and survive.

Game.Name: Axes and Arrows
Game.Overview: Axes and Arrows is an intense action-combat platformer inspired by nostalgic and modern couch multiplayer games.

Game.Name: Axe Throw VR
Game.Overview: You've got a VR headset and some cool motion controllers, but what can you really do with them? Throw some virtual axes! In Axe Throw, a virtual axe throwing range becomes your playground.. or you can see how long you can fend off a zombie apocalypse in survival mode!

Game.Name: AXIOM SOCCER
Game.Overview: Axiom Soccer is a high speed evolution of vehicular soccer combining fast-paced driving with tactical shooting mechanics for a new soccer experience. Inspired by real world ball games, go it alone or team up with friends and blast through divisions to pursue Axiom Soccer championship glory.

Game.Name: Axiom Verge
Game.Overview:
Explore and uncover the mystery of a surreal alien world by blasting aliens and glitching your environment in this intense retro side-scrolling action/adventure.
This is the action-adventure youâ€™ve been waiting decades for. After a lab accident, a scientist awakens in a mysterious, alien world. Is this a distant planet? The far future? Or a complex virtual-reality computer simulation?
Plumb the recesses of a large, labyrinthine world in order to learn its secrets and uncover your role within it.
Discover tons of weapons, items, and abilities, each with their own unique behaviors and usage. Youâ€™ll need your wits to find them all.
Combat bizarre biomechanoid constructs, the deadly fallout of an ancient war, and the demons of your own psyche.
And finally, break the game itself by using glitches to corrupt foes and solve puzzles in the environment.
Life. Afterlife. Real. Virtual. Dream. Nightmare. It's a thin line.
It's Axiom Verge.

Game.Name: Axiom Verge 2
Game.Overview:
Explore a sprawling, alien world in the sequel to the award winning Axiom Verge.
You may have played Axiom Verge, or heard it referenced as a benchmark for indie action-exploration games. This long awaited sequel expands on the universe with completely new characters, abilities, and gameplay.
Indra, the billionaire behind the worldwide Globe 3 conglomerate, heads to Antarctica to investigate the disappearance of her daughter, but ultimately finds herself in an entirely different reality, infected by parasitic machines that both aid and confound her. Where is she? Who is the mysterious person goading her from the other end of the computer terminal?
Explore an alternate Earth-like world, replete with the ruins of an ancient, high-tech civilization. Hack machines. Battle monsters. Use your remote drone to enter the Breach, a parallel but connected reality that is filled with its own dangers. Youâ€™ll want to search every inch for the hidden items and upgrades you need to survive.

Game.Name: Axis
Game.Overview:
Axis is a multiplayer first-person shooter with mechs. However, these are not the big and clunky robots usually featured in mech games, but fast machines which have the ability to float for a short amount of time. This means the game speed is more akin to mid-nineties shooters like Quake. The backdrop story is set in the 22th century when multinational companies fight over resources.
The game features overall eight multiplayer modes (e.g. Deathmatch, Rocket Arena or Gladiator) with differences regarding rules and winning conditions, but generally they all involve the player fighting alone against the opposition by running (and floating) around, shooting weapons at other players and picking up power-ups (e.g. armor, shields or damage multiplier) which spawn on the 28 maps. The basic stats of the player's mech, e.g. armor or the boost speed, are determined by the chosen pilot character and the used mech components which can be changed for arms, legs, chassis, head, booster and weapon load-out. All those components have strengths, weaknesses and weight, the latter being the restricting factor.
The game also has a single-player mode, skirmish, which consists of playing multiplayer matches against bots. Playing through the scenarios rewards additional mech components for use in multiplayer.

Game.Name: Axis & Allies 1942 Online
Game.Overview: Play the classic board game, Axis & Allies 1942 2nd Edition! Act as WWII powers in a turn-based strategy game that fits your screen and scheduleâ€” get notified on your turn and command armies at your own pace! Team up with friends, challenge the worldâ€™s top players, or go solo vs. A.I.

Game.Name: Axis & Allies (1998)
Game.Overview:
This is Hasbro's PC version of the popular Milton Bradley boardgame of the same name. Designed for 1-5 players, the game begins in the Spring of 1942, right after America entered World War II.
The 5 nations that you can play are U.S.A. United Kingdom, Russia, Germany, and Japan. The game begins with the same units on the same territories everytime, yet hardcore players of the game still argue what are the best moves and counter moves to begin each game. With the added randomness of the die rolls, each game will eventually turn out different.
The game is very balanced, with the Axis having an upperhand in number of units, but the Allies have an economic advantage.
The PC version has many "house rules" that have evolved over the years that you can choose to play with, as well as a unit editor. There are also in-game cinematics that are nice the first few times you play.
This game supports several multiplayer modes. It can be played in-house, on a LAN, modem-to-modem, or on the MSN Gaming Zone.

Game.Name: Axis & Allies (2004)
Game.Overview:
A real-time strategy game based on the Axis & Allies board game. Play as the United States, Great Britain, Russia, Germany or Japan. Chose from famous Generals & Admirals including Eisenhower, Nimitz, Montgomery, Montbatten, Zhukov, Chuikov, Rommel, Kesselring, Mikawa, Yamamoto and more.
A unique meta game adds an interesting layer to gameplay. Online gameplay is supported.

Game.Name: Axis Football 2015
Game.Overview: Axis Football is a 3D American Football Simulation Game that features a unique aimed passing system. Play in a single match, season mode, or local multiplayer! Offers basic mod support for team rosters.

Game.Name: Axis Football 2017
Game.Overview: Axis Football is an American football simulation featuring massive customization and a complete franchise mode

Game.Name: Axis Football 2018
Game.Overview: Axis Football is an American football simulation featuring a deep Franchise Mode and full customization.

Game.Name: Axis Football 2020
Game.Overview: Axis Football features football gaming's deepest Franchise Mode and massively improved simulation-style gameplay.

Game.Name: AXYOS
Game.Overview: AXYOS is an experimental shooter with some MOBA gameplay elements. Upgrade yourself in the game session to lead your team to win!

Game.Name: AXYOS: Battlecards
Game.Overview: Meet Axyos: Battlecards, the brand new tactical card game! Experience yourself in a role of the commander. Play multiplayer with your friends. Invent and utilize different tactics in a battle!

Game.Name: AxySnake
Game.Overview:
AxySnake is a Snake game much like any other Snake game. You control one of three selectable snakes as they slither about in a playfield filled with hazardous rocks and stumps, trying to eat enough fruit and mushrooms before time runs out. Once the snake is long enough, a key appears which can be picked up to reveal the exit.
The biggest difference between AxySnake and all the others is its 3D perspective that allows you to view the game up close or from a distance. Unlike in other Snake games, in AxySnake the serpent can turn smoothly and move in any direction. Running into the snake's own tail reduces the snake's length, undoing your progress. Eating a rock, colliding with tree stumps or with walls stops the snake for a moment and reduces your score. You also have to avoid the bees and dragonflies that want to ruin your day by stealing your fruit and slowing you down. Moving into the borders of the playfield is dangerous, as it gives hidden monsters an opportunity to catch and devour the snake, costing the player a life. Running out of time causes a monster to come out of the playfield edge and kill your snake.

Game.Name: Ayahuasca
Game.Overview: In the jungle at night, a journey awaits for you... are you ready to embrace the experience? Ayahuasca, the vine of the soul, and how to find your inner space.

Game.Name: Ayakashibito
Game.Overview:
In face of human technological advancement during the Meiji Restoration, the youkai of Japan were forced to make a hard decision: 1) To remain as youkai and watch over the land, 2) To return to the netherworld, 3) Or to give up their power and status as youkai and live amongst humans.
While there were some that chose otherwise, the majority of the youkai decided it was best to become human. It was tough, but as time passed these youkai were able to blend in with the human world and live peacefully amongst them.
However, blood is thicker than water. The offspring of these youkai displayed the powerful abilities of their ancestors in times of great anxiety, often manifesting in horrible and dangerous ways, and were labeled by society as monsters. Officially their condition was named "Acquired Systemic Special Heredity variety Syndrome", or "ASSHS" for short and treated as a non-contagious illness, but the common people began to refer to them as Jinyous (half-youkai) nevertheless.
Of these Jinyous, most were sent to Kamizawa City: an isolated urban area walled off from the rest of Japan to keep all the Jinyous together and away from the human population. However, the ones that were deemed especially dangerous were sent to a medical facility on an uncharted island near the shores of Japan where they would be under constant surveillance.
Takabe Ryouichi was one of those who were sent to said island at the age of five. This is a story about him along with the girl called Suzu, his only friend on the island, escaping to Kamizawa City to live a normal life. What they didnâ€™t expect was that Suzu carried a secret that attracted much unwanted attentionâ€¦

Game.Name: Ayanami ikusei keikaku Puka Puka Rei-chan
Ayasa: Shadows of Silence
Game.Overview: A dark tale of survival and conscience, blending platforming, puzzles, and haunting beauty. Journey through surreal lands where every choice shapes the fate of a world on the edge of ruin will you restore the light or embrace the darkness?

Game.Name: Ayda
Game.Overview:
She won't stop screaming in the dark of night. I visit her grave and ask her to stop, but it never helps.
A short horror game following the mundane tasks of a woman who wakes up in the middle of the night. What she sees or hears might not always be up to par with what she remembers.
Ayda was originally created for the official RPG Maker Birthday Bash Game-Making Challenge. It was developed within a month and is the first game I've publicly released. I hope you all enjoy this brief experience.

Game.Name: A Year of Rain
Game.Overview: A desolate realm, kept in flux by the rhythm of battle. A proving ground for those with great ambition. A Year Of Rain is the ultimate team real-time strategy game. Choose your faction, team up and take control of a legendary hero to lead your armies!

Game.Name: A YEAR OF SPRINGS
Game.Overview:
A Year of Springs is a compilation of the year of springs trilogy:
One Night, Hot Springs Last Day of Spring Spring Leaves No Flowers This compilation also features a chapter called The coming Spring which serves as an epilogue to the stories.
All three games are released on the Playstation 4, Playstation 5, Xbox one, Xbox series and Switch for the first time.

Game.Name: Aye Aye Captain
Game.Overview:
Aye Aye Captain is a game about crewing a ship on the high seas of the 1500 and 1600s. You'll have to manage a crew, provide them with consistent booty, rum, and fight off mutinies, all while pillaging vessels of royal navies, other pirates, and trading companies.
7/17/2020 Version 1.0 is here! If you buy it on Itch.io you'll also receive a Steam Key!

Game.Name: Ayni Fairyland
Game.Overview: Adventure in the fantasy world

Game.Name: Ayo the Clown
Game.Overview: Let's go on an adventure to unite dog and clown!

Game.Name: Ayumu Kasuga's Mail Order Life final
Game.Overview: A fanmade interactive Osaka simulator from hirahira.net for PC. It is from the early 2000s. The game can also work as a screensaver. In Ayumu Kasuga's Mail Order Life, Osaka spends time in her room and occasionally walks out, possibly to a part-time job. Afterwards, she comes back with money used by the player to buy various items that appear on TV along with Chiyo-chichi. If the item is clicked, then Osaka will buy it, otherwise it disappears.

Game.Name: Ayumu Kasuga's Mail Order Life ver.Apr.2003
Game.Overview: A fanmade interactive Osaka simulator from hirahira.net for PC. It is from the early 2000s. The game can also work as a screensaver. In Ayumu Kasuga's Mail Order Life, Osaka from Azumanga Daioh spends time in her room and occasionally walks out, possibly to a part-time job. Afterwards, she comes back with money used by the player to buy various items that appear on TV along with Chiyo-chichi. If the item is clicked, then Osaka will buy it, otherwise it disappears.

Game.Name: Ayumu Kasuga's Mail Order Life ver.Aug.2003
Game.Overview: A fanmade interactive Osaka simulator from hirahira.net for PC. It is from the early 2000s. The game can also work as a screensaver. In Ayumu Kasuga's Mail Order Life, Osaka spends time in her room and occasionally walks out, possibly to a part-time job. Afterwards, she comes back with money used by the player to buy various items that appear on TV along with Chiyo-chichi. If the item is clicked, then Osaka will buy it, otherwise it disappears.

Game.Name: Ayumu Kasuga's Mail Order Life ver.Dec.2003
Game.Overview: A fanmade interactive Osaka simulator from hirahira.net for PC. It is from the early 2000s. The game can also work as a screensaver. In Ayumu Kasuga's Mail Order Life, Osaka spends time in her room and occasionally walks out, possibly to a part-time job. Afterwards, she comes back with money used by the player to buy various items that appear on TV along with Chiyo-chichi. If the item is clicked, then Osaka will buy it, otherwise it disappears.

Game.Name: Ayura Crisis!
Game.Overview:
This is an erotic action game where erotic things happen during battle. Recommended for those who like games with erotic elements included in the system. Animation is all hand-drawn pixel art.
When erotic things happen to Ayura, her Arousal and Pleasure values increase and she may fall into erotic states, leading to changes in dialogue and actions.
Fun Action This game is battle-focused. Players can enjoy an original battle system with firm impact and easy controls. Frequently used keys are Z and Shift. Can be played instinctively. Can also be played using controller. Key configuration is possible. Can also be played with one hand if the Right Shift, Enter and Numpad keys are used well.
This game uses simple controls and fun yet stylish action sequences, but can also be enjoyed as a serious game at higher difficulty levels. Difficulty levels exist from Easy to Very Hard.
Players can choose to take down enemies in a flash with the Easy mode, or engage in hard-core battles with the Hard mode.
In the Bonus Room, players may view the pixel animation gallery freely, as well as battle many enemies, view the database, and even fall into special states... All in all, this game is jam-packed with enjoyable elements.
Current version: 1.18

Game.Name: Azada
Game.Overview: Trapped in a magical puzzle book, the adventurous Titus needs your help to release him from his spell. To do this, you must solve the tricky puzzles of Azadaâ„¢. Crack the series of puzzles and fill in the missing pages of the enchanted book to free Titus from his prison. Loads of unique puzzles to solve.

Game.Name: Azkend
Game.Overview:
Puzzle your way across the scenic landscapes of the Far East in this stimulating matching game that's full of mystery and wonder. The relic your archaeological team uncovered is more powerful than originally thought. For starters, it's cursed! Now it's up to you solve brain-bending puzzles on your quest to reach the Temple of Time and lift the curse.
Use your matching skills to unlock 8 mighty talismans and unleash their powerful help as you make your way to the mysterious temple. Featuring loads of challenging levels, stunning scenery, and two game modes, Azkend is a magical adventure of puzzling fun.

Game.Name: Azkend 2: The World Beneath
Game.Overview: Azkend 2: The World Beneath is a beautifully polished match-three adventure game set in an awe-inspiring underground world. Enjoy superbly smooth casual matching puzzle gameplay, an engaging storyline with voiceovers, and hidden object minigames.

Game.Name: Azrael
Game.Overview: Azrael is a first-person Detective/Horror Game in which you play as a detective capable of reliving crime scenes. Explore different environments, find clues and try to find out who is the serial killer in a murder case among a group of friends.

Game.Name: Aztaka
Game.Overview: Inspired by Aztec legend, this action/rpg side-scroller will casts you into the middle of a war between the Gods and Mankind. As Huitzilo, heir of the Sun God, skilled in both the arts of combat and magic, only you can save your people from the wrath of the Aztec Gods by reuniting the seven phonograms. Accompanied by your faithful companion Ayopha - trapped in the form of a hummingbird by a magical curse â€“ you will overcome the obstacles in you path through a combination of fighting prowess and spiritual magic.

Game.Name: Azteca
Game.Overview:
Azteca is a typical tile matching game. The player is presented with a field full of differently-coloured circles and he can move his mouse cursor to select a combination of three bordering circles. When he clicks these three circles spin around and if three or more same-coloured circles are in a bordering state during the process they vanish and reward points. If this is not the case the circles return to the previous state. To fill up the now open space new (random) circles fall down from the top of the screen. Of course there is a possibility for new combinations emerging during the filling up process; these combos give a lot of extra points.
The main goal of the 150 levels is to cause all circles to vanish which are marked with a letter. Over the course of the game this gets more difficult because of tighter time limits and additional obstacles, e.g stones which have to be broken by falling circles. There are also also power ups which help the player, e.g. by vanishing all bordering circles or all circles directly under and above it.

Game.Name: Aztecalypse
Game.Overview: Action adventure with an apocalyptic touch. In Aztecalypse you explore a newly discovered area with remnants of an ancient culture. If you like First Person Action games set in mystic places, in an Open World with neat places to visit aside the story, you will definitely love this game!

Game.Name: Aztec Ball
Game.Overview: Shatter your brick-busting expectations with this explosive challenge! Climb to the top of a glorious pyramid and blast away brilliantly colored bricks stacked into unique shapes and positions. Use your mouse to guide your Aztec warrior in the destruction of many structures through the use of realistic physics and ball play. With 100 thrilling levels, 24 unique bonuses and stunning 3D graphics, Aztec Ball is the ultimate adventure in brick-busting fun!

Game.Name: Aztech Forgotten Gods
Game.Overview: Aztech Forgotten Gods is the cyber-stone action-adventure following Achtli, a young woman who battles the colossal Forgotten Gods. To uncover the truth behind her far-future Mesoamerican metropolis, she'll have to turn the Gods' power against them, as she soars through the city with power and grace using an ancient artifact, remnant of a time long forgotten.

Game.Name: Aztech's Armory: Campaigns for WarCraft II
Game.Overview: Although not authorized or supported by Blizzard, this add-on features 25 campaigns and thousands of levels for one to eight players. What is most interesting is the Level Manager: it helps organize the different levels, keeps track of which ones were played, etc. Requires full version of WarCraft II to play.

Game.Name: Aztec: The Curse in the Heart of the City of Gold
Game.Overview: 1517. Mexico-Tenochtitlan, the Capital City of the Aztec Empire. You are Little Serpent, a young huntsman. When out hunting one day you come by chance upon the murder of a nobleman who leaves you mysterious information you should never have heard... Wrongly accused of the murder, soldiers have taken your parents hostage to force you to give yourself up. A strange illness is eating away at the country, with clues that link to your own misfortunes. With danger everywhere, you must choose your friends well, solve the clues and unmask the traitors. The fate of Aztec is in your hands. - 3 in-depth game modes: adventure - exploration - encyclopaedia - Puzzles and clues combining thought, skill and action - Detailed exploration with the interactive map - "Omni-Expert" help mode - Use the "codex" to view the key points of the mystery at any time - Stunning 3D reconstruction of the incredible Aztec world

Game.Name: Aztec Wars
Game.Overview:
Aztec Wars is a budget RTS game that takes place in an alternate history 17th century Europe where the â€œRussesâ€ and â€œCathayansâ€ must fight back an invasion from the Atlantic crossing Aztecs (who have already conquered France, Germany, and Spain).
Initially in each mission, the player is in control of several basic houses. Each house produces money (the only resource in the game) and can produce the basic soldiers, but that's all it can do. However, for a large sum of money you can turn a house into a village, a city or a fortress. Each of three types of settlements allows you to build different units and buildings (Note that the three civilizations also have varying units and buildings).
Within a settlement, you can recruit units and construct buildings: mines and farms (that give you money), defense towers that fire at enemies, and facilities that allow the settlement to build a specific unit - e.g. you cannot recruit a war bear until you build a bear's cave.
Units are controlled similarly to other RTS games. After recruiting, they become 'garrison' of the settlement and stay inside to defend it. When you organize some units into a squad, you can instruct them to move around the map and use them to attack the enemy.
The objective of a mission is typically to conquer or destroy all enemy settlements/units. You can capture an enemy settlement by destroying all units and towers that defend it. The settlement then becomes yours and you can control it - which means you can build units normally unique to enemy civilizations.
Apart from a single Russes campaign, Aztec Wars offers fifteen single player missions and an additional thirty multiplayer maps for battles with up to six other players.

Game.Name: Aztez
Game.Overview: Aztez is a highly stylized, brutally satisfying beat 'em up set in the world of the Aztec Empire. Take on the role of an elite close combat unit and undergo missions on behalf of the Empire in the turn-based metagame, and fight against warriors and mythological foes alike using 8 unique weapons in real time combat mode.

Game.Name: AzuFight: Taisen Shiyo
Game.Overview: AzuFight: Taisen Shiyo is a doujin fighting game based on the Azumanga Daioh anime and manga series. Not to be confused with Azumanga The Fighter T-Style, though possibly meant to serve as a sequel or expansion.

Game.Name: Azumanga K Oh in summer
Game.Overview: This is the second Azumanga The Fighting 2D fighting game featuring characters from the popular manga Azumanga Daioh, and continues to be released by the long-established doujin circle Daioujou The number of characters is rather small, that being four: Chiyo-chan, Osaka, Kimura-sensei, and Chiyo-chichi. However, despite of a small number of characters, the personalities of the characters are very strong, and the fighting styles and direction are elaborate.

Game.Name: Azumanga The Fighting T Style
Game.Overview: A doujin fighting game based on the Azumanga Daioh anime and manga series. There are 4 characters: Chiyo, Osaka, Kimura, and Chiyo-chichi.

Game.Name: Azu-Race Taisen Battle He-Cho
Game.Overview: A doujin racing game akin to Mario Kart featuring the cast of Azumanga Daioh.

Game.Name: Azurael's Circle: Chapter 1
Game.Overview: Azurael's Circle: Chapter 1 is a horror-mystery adventure game where you must find the truth about your mother's death. What evils await you in the depths of the Lancaster farmhouse? The further you go, the more strange things get.

Game.Name: Azuraelâ€™s Circle: Chapter 5
Game.Overview: Azurael's Circle is a horror-mystery adventure game. Navigate the manor and piece together the real reason why you're here. Combine items in your inventory to get into locked areas of the house and find other useful tools that can help you uncover the truth while meeting a few familiar faces.

Game.Name: Azuran Tales: Trials
Game.Overview: Azuran Tales: Trials offers challenging combat, beautiful levels and merciless enemies to overcome. Journey across the World of Azuran as you discover its many environments, lore and history in a game that blends platformers with RPG elements.

Game.Name: AZUR BEAM
Game.Overview: AZUR BEAM is a fun arcade game with beautiful music, lots of levels and colorful illustrations of anime girls! In AZUR BEAM you will find 53 extraordinarily beautiful, difficult and interesting levels, after passing which you will open full access to the Gallery.

Game.Name: Azure Reflections
Game.Overview: Azure Reflections is an insane, side-scrolling bullet hell fangame based on one of the hottest shooting game series to come out of Japan, the Touhou Project! Enemies come at you from all directions with a relentless hail of bullets! Fight back with a well-timed Danmaku Rush to tear your way through bullets and enemies alike!

Game.Name: Azure Saga: Pathfinder
Game.Overview: Dive into the world of Azure Saga: Pathfinder and band together to search for the legendary planet that will save humanity. Battle your enemies in JRPG-style turn-based combat, and explore a 2.5D isometric landscape featuring hand-drawn visuals.

Game.Name: Azure Sky Project
Game.Overview: A Tactical 2D Shooter where the player has complete freedom on how to tackle missions. Engage in our 15 hand-built campaign missions or farm up some money in our randomly generated "Freelance Work" missions using the gear and strategies that YOU choose!

Game.Name: Azure Striker Gunvolt
Game.Overview: Azure Striker Gunvolt is a 2D action game featuring a hero with the power of lightning who stands against the evil ambitions of a massive organization. When lightning strikes, a new legend is born. The game features the talents of star creator Keiji Inafune as the Executive Producer and Action Supervisor. With the â€œseptimalâ€ power to create and manipulate lightning, Gunvolt faces off against the massive conglomerate known as the Sumeragi Group. Intense battles unfold against Sumeragi's ultra-powerful adepts (those who possess septimal powers) as Gunvolt fights to keep his nation free. Speedrun Mode - This new mode gives speedrunners around the world the chance to compete for the best time, with pre-determined settings put in place by the Gunvolt team to maximize efficiency for this challenging new mode. Lightning-Based Action - Use your trusty sidearm to tag enemies, then let loose a burst of electricity for massive damage. You can even tag multiple enemies and zap them all simultaneously. Your lightning abilities are not just for defeating enemies, though. Use them to perform various maneuvers such as hovering across hazardous terrain. Do Battle with a Variety of Bosses - Sumeragi's most powerful members, with a wide range of personalities, await you at the end of your missions. Battles get heated as bosses unleash their most powerful skills and techniques. Those for Whom the Muse Sings Shall Turn the Tides of Battle - Even Gunvolt falls in battle sometimes. When this happens, there is a chance that Lumen, aka The Muse, will revive you and grant you a massive power boost. Furthermore, if you manage to amass at least 1000 Kudos during a stage, the BGM will change, and Lumen will sing one of her songs for you for as long as you maintain those Kudos. Your Kudos will reset upon taking damage, so keep that no-damage run going for as long as you can! Japanese Voice Mode - In this long-awaited mode, players will be able to play the original Japanese version of the game, which includes ample mid-stage dialogue, all fully voiced in Japanese with English text. The entire script has been re-translated to coincide with the dialogue of the Japanese version of the game.

Game.Name: Azure Striker Gunvolt 2
Game.Overview:
The ultra-refined 2D side-scrolling action you remember from "Azure Striker Gunvolt" is recharged and better than ever! In Gunvolt 2, series anti-hero Copen joins the fray as a playable character! Copy abilities from defeated boss characters and use them as your own!
The ultra-refined 2D side-scrolling action you remember from "Azure Striker Gunvolt" is recharged and better than ever!
Players take command of Gunvolt and make short work of enemies using his high-speed techniques and command of electricity just like before, but in Gunvolt 2, a new character joins the fray! As Copen, slam into enemies to lock on to them, then unleash a flurry of devastating homing shots to obliterate foes. Copen can also take to the skies using his "Bullit Dash" for extra mobility, and copy the abilities of defeated bosses to expand his arsenal.
The "Story Mode+" system, which showcases interactions between characters during the action, returns alongside over 20 songs performed by the virtual pop star, "The Muse"! To top it off, all of the game's DLC is included!

Game.Name: Azure Striker Gunvolt 3
Game.Overview:
The next installment in the high-speed 2D action Gunvolt series is finally here with Azure Striker Gunvolt 3. Balancing both an involving story and satisfying gameplay, Gunvolt 3 is the most extravagant entry in the series yet!
Play as both new star Kirin and series protagonist Gunvolt as you switch between them on the fly while conquering Gunvolt 3's many stages and bosses. Story Mode+ which keeps the exciting action uninterrupted by the rich story. New to Gunvolt 3 are Image Pulses, collectable summons and equipment called forth from Gunvolt's own memories. Over 150 varieties are available to collect!
â– Satisfying swordplay meets light-speed superpowers! Experience the exhilarating 2D action your own way! Take control of Kirin's stylish sword action or Gunvolt's devastating lightning powers to clear stages with show-stopping abilities!
â– The thrilling near-future dystopian story plays out in real-time with "Story Mode+"! Characters talk and banter without interrupting gameplay thanks to Story Mode+, allowing their personalities to shine and the story to develop without diluting the action experience. Full English voices are available along with the original Japanese!
â– New songs from "The Muse" Lumen heat up the battle! Put on a show with your gameplay to earn "Kudos" points and the virtual pop idol Lumen will start a performance of her own, replacing the stage track with a vocal pop song! 7 brand new songs are included alongside a large selection of classic songs from the series.
â– Kirin and Gunvolt's team-up creates a new power - "Image Pulse"! Collect over 150 types of "Image Pulses," giving form to Gunvolt's memories. Image Pulses allow you to summon comrades and rivals from Gunvolt's past to attack, grant abilities, and more.

Game.Name: Azure Striker Gunvolt Trilogy Enhanced
Game.Overview:
The Azure Striker Gunvolt Trilogy Enhanced is a collection of three traditional 2D action platformers, â€œAzure Striker Gunvoltâ€ (2014), â€œAzure Striker Gunvolt 2â€ (2016), and â€œAzure Striker Gunvolt 3â€ (2022) together in one release, complete with all DLC.
The Gunvolt series boasts a rich story, played out with real-time dialog during missions, and an vast catalog of music, with over 37 songs performed by the games' characters.
Plus, this special Trilogy comes with exclusive features: action revisions from the series director, revised voices and songs, and once Japan-exclusive CD dramas included in the game. This collection strives to be as complete as possible!
â– Azure Striker Gunvolt: Dash through stages at high speed and take down enemies with your "Flashfield" in this satisfying action platformer. Players control Gunvolt, a superhuman (known as an Adept) with the power of lightning who must confront the oppressive Sumeragi Group in a battle for freedom. The Trilogy Enhanced version adds new Skills to Gunvolt's arsenal. Unleash overwhelming power like never before!
â– Azure Striker Gunvolt 2: Gunvolt's rival, Copen, becomes a new star and playable character alongside the Azure Striker. Copen uses his dash to tackle and lock onto enemies before unleashing a devastating homing laser barrage. Master his aerial "Bullit Dash" to gracefully fly through stages and destroy enemies from above, unlocking new weapons from the abilities of defeated bosses. Copen and Lola's voices have been re-recorded for the Trilogy Enhanced edition of the game.
â– Azure Striker Gunvolt 3: A new style of action arrives with the new heroine "Kirin" who can swap with Gunvolt to overcome any situation. Kirin has the power to teleport instantly to strike down enemies with her "Arc Chain" ability for melee action of unprecedented speed. Or switch to Gunvolt, whose tag and electrify style has leveled up to allow him to dash through enemies while striking them down, teleport, and unleash other new "Voltaic Arts". The Image Pulse system brings characters from the series as buffs and attacks, with over 150 varieties to collect.

Game.Name: Azur Lane: Crosswave
Game.Overview: In the middle of each nation's normal training routine, a Joint Military Exercise was enacted. A select few from each nation were chosen to participate in this rigorous event. But, how did this event come to be? Are there other ulterior motives at play?

Game.Name: Azur Ring: Virgin and Slave's Phylacteries
Game.Overview: New Metroidvania + RPG adventure game. Legendary gear! Unique set, a large number of magical equipment to provide you with unlimited possibilities to equip build. Gorgeous and fluent act combo system, give you the operating space to challenge the limit!

Game.Name: b
Game.Overview:
This is a play as you desire game. B free! Flight experience: a newly created undulating meadow in spring / summer with a central big tree and day-night-cycle on every start is the playground of b -- a bumblebee of subgenus gaudium formosum, recognizable by their cheeky :p. Note: no collisions is on purpose. Day and night transitions. Select your own mp3 for day and night. Weather supported. VR support.
This is a simple fly as a bumblebee around a big tree above a hilly grass field experience.

Game.Name: B100X: Auto Dungeon RPG
Game.Overview: Devilishly addictive RPG presented by Nussygame, the developer of "Buriedbornes"!

Game.Name: B-17 Flying Fortress: Bombers in Action
B-17 Flying Fortress: The Mighty 8th
Game.Overview: Feel the power of flying a 10-men crew on a B-17 over occupied Europe in WWII. Plan the mission, choose your men and take action in every post onboard, from pilot to bombardier and machine gunners. Get ready for a high-flying adventure in this all-time classic.

Game.Name: B-17 Flying Fortress: The Mighty 8th Redux
Game.Overview: The missions undertaken by the crews of B-17 bombers during World War II are the stuff of legend. What was it like to fly through relentless anti-aircraft fire over Nazi-occupied Europe? What was it like to have a thin layer of steel between life and death at 15,000 feet? How did it feel to furiously fend off enemy fighters zipping around your plane and then to precisely deliver your payload over enemy targets?

Game.Name: B-17 Gunner: Air War Over Germany
Game.Overview:
B-17 Gunner: Air War Over Germany is basically a rail shooter. The player takes the place of six machine gunners on board on a B-17 Flying Fortress bomber. On the way to the destination the bomber encounters numerous German planes and the gunners have to kill them. When the gunners take too much damage they die, and its get more difficult to protect the B-17. A simple mouse click switches between the turrets.
When approaching the goal, the game switches to a overhead map and the player has to order the bombing by pointing the crosshair over the right building. The game features 25 missions.

Game.Name: B-1LL1
Game.Overview: B-1LL1 is a post-apocalyptic platformer for hardcore gamers. Play as B-1LL1 in the hunt for energy orbs scattered all around you and get through a world destroyed by a catastrophy that you will learn about.

Game.Name: B3
Game.Overview: B3 will be a first-person VR shooter where you have to defend your base from waves of attacking monsters.

Game.Name: Baalbek Reborn: Temples
Game.Overview: Experts of the German Archaeological Institute present the Roman temples in Baalbek, Lebanon, showing you the ruins and a digital reconstruction. Virtual tourism and virtual time travel combine to bring ancient Baalbek back to life so you can appreciate this unique gem of art and architecture.

Game.Name: Baantjer: De Moord in het Royal Amstel
Game.Overview:
One night in November, the young heiress to a business empire is murdered in the Grand Hotel in Amsterdam. There are no obvious suspects. Can you track down the killer in Baantjer: The Murder In The Royal Amstel?
Some traces in Baantjer: De Murder In Het Royal Amstel lead to the Amsterdam jet set, others to very marginal environments. Will uncertainty and old feuds fuel hatred and greed. Behind a web of lies, intrigue and murder lies a terrible truth. It's your job to bring justice in Baantjer: The Murder In The Royal Amstel!
Interrogate suspects and look for clues in Baantjer: The Murder In Het Royal Amstel. In this exciting detective game you are the old Cock and you need all your experience to solve a brutal murder!
Experience your own adventure as Baantjer in Baantjer, The Murder in the Royal Amstel.

Game.Name: Baba Files Taxes
Game.Overview: Baba needs help filing taxes, and the deadline is tonight! Help Baba in order to make it in time.

Game.Name: Baba Is You
Game.Overview:
Baba Is You is a puzzle game where the rules you have to follow are present as blocks you can interact with. By manipulating them, you can change how the game works, repurpose things you find in the levels and cause surprising interactions!
The game has over 200 levels that experiment with the game's mechanics in a multitude of ways, requiring the player to understand and manipulate the rules of the game and figure out devious ways to make the objects in the game world interact.

Game.Name: Babar and the Royal Coin Caper
Game.Overview: Mindscape announced, by royal appointment, the coming of Babar the Elephant King in his very own computer game, Babar's Royal Coin Caper, available for PC and Mac on 9th December. The creation of popular French children's writer, Jean de Brunhoff, Babar the Elephant first arose in 1931 in the classic children's book L'Histoire du Babar. The story outlines the life and times of a young elephant, separated from his mother at an early age by cruel hunters, who finds his way to France and is brought up by an old lady in Paris. Babar eventually returns to his homeland where he is made king, builds his own city and eventually becomes a father himself. After initial literary success, Babar was adapted for an animated television series, where it is now screened daily on Channel 5's children's show Milkshake. Babar is now about to embark on his first interactive escapade as Mindscape launches an original Babar action/adventure title designed to entertain and challenge gamers between the ages three and seven. The game features nine games of logical thinking, musical creativity and problem solving across Barbars's hometown of Celesteville, as players help Babar to find his lost royal coin collection. Each activity has been designed to encourage the imagination, logic, attention, observation and memory skills of fledgling gamers and with two distinct levels of difficulty, will cater for early beginners and Babar experts alike. Babar's coin collecting adventures will leave your pre-schoolers all the richer for the experience this winter! Babar's Royal Coin Caper will be released 9th December for PC and Mac.

Game.Name: BABBDI
Game.Overview:
BABBDI is a short, first person exploration experience with light narrative and platforming elements.
Visit the town of BABBDI, a forsaken district in the outer ring of the megalopolis. Meet its inhabitants and discover how to escape.
You will find various items unlocking special movement abilities, such as the baseball bat, the pickaxe and the motorcycle.
Secret collectible objects can be found all around town.

Game.Name: Babe and Friends: Animated Preschool Adventure
Game.Overview: Babe and Friends: Animated Preschool Adventure is a learning game for preschool children. Babe and his friends plan to run a circus show. 7 different mini games that help with the preparations are included. These games require knowledge about letters and numbers, geometric shapes and logic.

Game.Name: Babel
Game.Overview: You wake up with amnesia in an abandoned research station in the Arctic. As you explore, psychometric visions give you glimpses of the lives of four scientists and the tragedy that befell them. Before you can escape, you'll have to learn your own history. Consistently grim and claustrophobic in tone, with good character development and plenty of suspense. Good detail, with lots of special cases handled. More of a story-game than a puzzle-game, with frequent noninteractive sequences that somehow manage to avoid feeling intrusive, but contains quite a few mechanical puzzles all the same.

Game.Name: Babel: Choice
Game.Overview: Babel: Choice is a 2D action-adventure Roguelike game which combines with the elements of RPG and shooting games. In the game, the player will play the part of Alexander, the son of the evil duke, aiming to break through the perilous and capricious Tower of Evil.

Game.Name: Babel Deluxe
Game.Overview: Travel through time to a land where words have yet to be invented! Test your skills in 25 unique word games from 5 different categories and watch your tower soar. Succeed, and your tower will reach heights never imagined. Stumble, and your tower will fall. Featuring stunning graphics, addictive game play, and hours of word game fun, Babel Deluxe is a towering test of your mental muscle!

Game.Name: Babes in Toyland
Game.Overview:
Babes in Toyland is based on a 1997 film of the same name. Toyland has just manufactured a huge load of toys to be picked up by Santa Claus to fulfill the jolly old elf's Christmas order. Just before Santa is scheduled for pickup, Barnaby the villain and his hench-cat swipe the toys and scatter them about Toyland. It is up to Jack and Jill to recover the toys before St. Nick arrives.
Babes in Toyland is oriented towards young children. The game consists of 9 minigames. The reward for each minigame is the recovery of another toy.1. Old lady in the shoe: The lady in the shoe needs help in locating her copious children. Click around various rooms in order to find where all the kids are hiding.
- Balloon memory: A clown is holding a bunch of balloons. Click on 2 balloons to reveal their animated patterns and find all the matching pairs.
- Train matching: You board a train and are responsible for properly pairing passengers. I.e., the gingerbread man should sit with the gingerbread woman.
- Ducks in the well: Some ducks have fallen into a well and are swimming with the fish. Lower the bucket and recover the ducks, but avoid lifting the fish.
- Haunted forest: Goblins are descending upon you at an alarming rate. Use your flashlight to ward them off. - Humpty Dumpty on the wall: Humpty Dumpty is sitting on his great wall when the naughty cat causes him to fall and shatter. Put Humpty back together in the allotted time.
- Clock tower: March a series of toy soldiers and stack them in a proper column in order to reach a toy that is at the top of a clock tower.
- Toy factory: Repeat a sequence of notes using a giant piano keyboard in order to make the toy factory whistle blow and bring down the stuck toy. As a bonus, you are granted access to the toy factory where you are allowed to change the settings on a toy-making machine for fun.
- Barnaby's lair: First, scale Barnaby's house from the outside while dodging obstacles. Once inside, play a shell game with Barnaby.

Game.Name: Babol the Walking Box
Game.Overview: Begin your adventure with your new friends! Babol the Walking Box Yes, it's game about Box that can walk, nope, just kidding hahaha UwU Explore the amazing world of box, from the wilderness, desert, to super duper cold snowy mountains!

Game.Name: Baby Blues Nightmares: Toddler Horror Game
Baby Blues: Toddler Horror Game
Game.Overview:
Baby Blues is a horror game where the player is placed in the shoes of Tommy The Toddler. Tommy, as all the other children his age loves to play with toys, but the most beloved toys for Tommy are his teddies. The 3-year-old wakes up to a strange noise in the middle of the night with a bright dim light shining in his eyes. Realizing his beloved teddies are missing; He climbs down out of bed and start to look for them..
This game takes place in a house, You play the role of Tommy the 3 year old kid living with his parents. While Tommy never experience anything in his life, this day will come when one day; He wakes up in the middle of the night, he steps off his bed and notice something is missing, his teddies. Tommy goes into the adventure where his only objective is to find his missing teddies and go back to bed, He doesn't care about anything else. While Searching for his teddies, Something strange is happening in the house but Tommy won't give up, not yet.

Game.Name: Baby Einstein: Baby Newton: Fun with Shapes
Game.Overview:
Baby Einstein: Baby Newton - Fun with Shapes is a title based on the DVD video of the same name. It is an educational game that is meant for infants and toddlers so they can learn their shapes. There are five shape "games", along with a interactive book and a Shape Scenes activity. The five shape games show the shape and objects that are the same shape, and lets you click on the objects to interact with them. Some shapes, such as the heart and the circle, let you insert your own image for more interactivity, such as a baby's favorite ball that bounces when clicked.
The interactive book has a read mode and a guess mode. The guess mode lets the player guess which object will appear next, and the read mode reads the book to you. The Shape Scenes activity is like a coloring book, where you must click on certain areas to fill that area in with color. There is also a difficulty setting that parents can change as their baby grows.

Game.Name: Baby Labor
Game.Overview:
An absurd workplace tragedy.
You hire a baby. What can go wrong?
Developed for my thesis on absurd games.
Takes roughly 10 minutes to play.
Baby made in http://www.makehumancommunity.org/
Music by Kevin Macleod
Chicago Skyline photo by Petr Kratochvil

Game.Name: Babylon 2055 Pinball
Game.Overview: Babylon 2055 Pinball is now available on Steam ! Enjoy the feeling of pinball through hours of gameplay.

Game.Name: Babylon 5: Shadow Wars
Game.Overview:
The Babylon 5 Arcade Series Entertainment Utility, "Shadow Wars", is a B5 multimedia collection packaged with a 2D arcade game using some B5 ships. In the tradition of Galaga, you control a Starfury or a Whitestar shooting all enemies in your way.
The multimedia collection, from Season 3 and Season 4 of B5, includes video clips, audio clips, wallpapers, icons, and animated cursors.

Game.Name: Babylonia
Game.Overview: Journey to the ancient land of Babylon as you explore a spellbinding match-three paradise! Match alluring flowers across 150 amazing levels, then test your green thumb as you restore the legendary Hanging Gardens to their former majestic glory! Nurture a bountiful harvest of blossoms to recreate one of the ancient Seven Wonders of the World! But don't neglect your gardens or you may suffer the wrath of the goddess Ishtar!

Game.Name: BABYLON'S FALL
Game.Overview: Experience acclaimed developer PlatinumGames' signature combat in BABYLONâ€™S FALL with up to 3 other players or take on the Tower of Babel alone, in this new cooperative action RPG.

Game.Name: Baby Luv
Game.Overview: Baby Luv will have you falling in love with the cutest babies you'll ever see! Choose from hundreds of different items to create and customize your very own baby! Play tons of mini-games, including hide and seek, jigsaw puzzles, memory match and more to earn money that you can spend at the baby store! Feed, bathe and pamper your baby as you experience the joys of first steps, first words, first laugh and all of the fun of baby's first year!

Game.Name: Baby Shark VR Dancing
Game.Overview: INDULGE YOUR KIDS IN AN UNDERWATER 360Â° ADVENTURE WITH BABY SHARK!

Game.Name: Babysitter Bloodbath
Game.Overview: For 22 years Neokalus Burr has stared at an empty wall in the bowels of Monroe State Mental Hospital. But tonight he's ESCAPED to continue his BLOOD SOAKED murder rampage! It's also your first night babysitting

Game.Name: Baby Steps
Game.Overview:
Play as Nate, an unemployed failson with nothing going for him, until one day he discovers a power he never knew he hadâ€¦ putting one foot in front of the other.
Explore a world shrouded in mist, one step at a time. Hike the serene mountains by placing each footstep yourself, in original physics-based gameplay from the minds behind Ape Out and Getting Over It. Take in the sights, fall in love with the local fauna, and try to find meaning in a wasted life.
Get ready to fall for Nate, in Baby Steps, a literal walking simulator.

Game.Name: Baby Storm
Game.Overview: Watch over unpredictable kids as they unleash chaos in your kindergarten! Make your way through clever and original levels, earn loads of points, unlock new stages and features, and encounter special babies with mysterious powers...
Game.Genres: Action; Construction and Management Simulation; Life Simulation

Game.Name: Babyz
Game.Overview: It's a special delivery for your PC! Living in a virtual house in your computer, these cute, mischievous Babyz need you to play with and take care of them! You'll have hours of fun interacting with Babyz as they learn to walk, talk, and develop their own unique personalities. Entertaining for children, Babyz is also great fun for grownups, too!

Game.Name: Babyz: Your Virtual Bundle of Joy
Game.Overview: The "game" is much like Dogz of Petz from PF Magic, but as the name suggests you adopt human infants. You have a wardrobe of clothes to cover them in, and shelves of toys for them to play with. There are also more babies, toys and clothes that can be downloaded online. The box advertises that each copy comes with its own unique baby, which is true in that no two babies will be the same, as they change in response to your interaction with them as they grow. Voice interaction is an integral part of the game, and it came packaged with a microphone for the purpose. You teach them to recognize you, and can teach them the names of the objects they play with.

Game.Name: Back 4 Blood
Game.Overview:
Back 4 Blood is an online multiplayer first-person shooter game developed by Turtle Rock Studios and published by Warner Bros. Interactive Entertainment. It was released on October 12, 2021, for Windows, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox One and Xbox Series X/S.
The game has been considered the spiritual successor to Left 4 Dead, as it is being developed by the creators of the original game, and features largely identical gameplay. The game was announced at The Game Awards 2020, and came nearly a decade after Turtle Rock Studios split from Valve (who published both Left 4 Dead titles and still owns the rights to the franchise) and re-established itself as an independent studio

Game.Name: Back again
Game.Overview: Can you make it to the end of this punishing 3D platformer or will you be stuck in the void? Back again features: Challenging levels to test your skill and patience, a unique changing soundtrack with a light narrative and creepy atmosphere. Also includes Survival Mode

Game.Name: BACK and BACK to Hell
Game.Overview: BACK and BACK to Hell is a Top Down shooter in which you will have to fight waves of demons that endlessly make their raids on the main character, hoping to finish an absolutely crushing preemptive strike on their ranks.

Game.Name: Backbone
Game.Overview: Backbone is a post-noir narrative adventure. Become raccoon private eye Howard Lotor and explore dystopian Vancouver inhabited by animals as you uncover a deeply personal story of change and transformation.

Game.Name: Backbone: Prologue
Game.Overview: Backbone: Prologue is the first act of a post-noir narrative adventure. Become raccoon private eye Howard Lotor and explore dystopian Vancouver inhabited by animals as you uncover a deeply personal story of change and transformation.

Game.Name: Back Fade
Game.Overview: Back: Fade is a full-motion video (FMV) live-action horror game developed and published by indie studio MYSTERY CROWN. Released on April 30, 2025, for PC, it serves as the second installment in the Back series, continuing the story of protagonist Ren Xing as he navigates a new and unsettling "Otherworld" .

Game.Name: Backfirewall_
Game.Overview: Hello and welcome to Backfirewall_, a first-person tragicomic adventure set inside a smartphone. You are the update assistant. Solve wacky puzzles to counter the update and save the previous operating system from deletion. The fate of the System is in your hands!

Game.Name: Backgammon Blitz
Game.Overview: Loved by millions, played for centuries, backgammon is a two-player strategy game quite unlike any other. The goal is simple: race to get your checkers off the board first. The deceptively deep rules and rhythm of backgammon has secured it as a favourite among casual and veteran players alike.

Game.Name: Back in 1995
Game.Overview: A throwback to the survival horror and mystery games of the original Playstation, Back in 1995 faithfully re-creates everything from this forgotten era of games.

Game.Name: Backpack Battles
Game.Overview: Backpack Battles is a strategy auto-battler where players organize items inside a limited backpack to create powerful builds. Combat is automated, and success depends on smart inventory management, item synergies, and adapting to opponents in asynchronous PvP battles.

Game.Name: BackPacker
Game.Overview: Backpacker is a game about travelling around the world. The objective is to travel around the world as fast as possible, to visit as many cities as possible or to get a certification for as many jobs as possible. To do that the player must answer questions about different cities and jobs.

Game.Name: Backpacker 2
Game.Overview: The sequel to Backpacker. The game is still about travelling around the world, but it also offers some new features. For instance you can now travel not only by flight, but also by train or boat. There are two sorts of hotel in each city, one expensive and one cheaper. The advantage with the expensive one is that it could be easier to get a job. You can also buy souvenirs cheap in one city and sell them in a place where it is more exotic to gain more money. The game also offers play over the Internet.

Game.Name: Backpacker 3
Game.Overview: The third game in the Backpacker series, where you travel around the world by train, plane or boat and work (in the form of quiz and puzzle solving mini-games) to gain money for more traveling. The game features 800 locations in 100 cities around the world, and it is possible to play the game with up to 8 other players on the same computer or online. You navigate the world through a world map, and the locations you visit are shown using combinations of computer rendered images, montages, photographs and comic book style art.

Game.Name: BackPacker Junior
Game.Overview:
BackPacker Junior is a simplified version based on the concept of the original Backpacker games. It aims to teach children about the different countries in Europe. There is more than just the cultural aspect, it also deals with currencies and involves a little strategy as you have to trade, buy and sell items. When you travel to a city, you have to look for a place to stay and find a job in the newspapers to master various skills and earn pocket money.
The different game modes include:Sightseeing*: visit ten European cities - Random route: let the computer design a route at random - DIY mission: play a custom-created mission - Shopping spree: travel through Europe and buy as many expensive things as you can
With the separate DIY tool, you can create your own custom routes through Europe and share them with fellow players.

Game.Name: Backpacker: The Lost Florence Gold Mine
Game.Overview:
You play detective McBlade, who one day receives a mysterious letter and decides to find the sender. He is requested to solve a murder case of 60 years ago. The identity of the murderer was never determined. You have your reasons to assume that this murder is somehow connected to the ancient Indian myth of the Death Cave. In spite of the great danger, you start your investigation.
This is a traditional third-person point & click adventure with an emphasis on dialogue.

Game.Name: Backpack Hero
Game.Overview:
BackpackÂ Hero is a turn-based roguelike strategy game about an adventurer who explores procedurally generated dungeons using an itemâ€‘organising backpack as the core mechanic.
Players arrange items in a backpack grid - placement affects power or abilities - while battling foes and collecting resources. Dungeons are randomized; players choose from five heroes with distinct playstyles and unlock further progression through a townâ€‘building metagame set in Haversack Hill.
Backpack Hero starts each run with an empty backpack grid that expands over time. The player fits weapons, armor, consumables, and resources into the grid; items may rotate or need adjacency rules (e.g., helmets in top rows). Between runs, the town mode allows resource investment in buildings, research, and recruiting, unlocking new heroes and quests.

Game.Name: Backrooms 0
Game.Overview: Backrooms walking simulator. No entities here, just the unnerving emptiness and dream-like isolation of the infinite maze. Feel mounting dread and strange nostalgia as you wander deeper into liminal spaces with your VHS camera.

Game.Name: Backrooms Abyss
Game.Overview: Explore and survive levels based on the popular creepypasta lore. Each level offers various escape routes but also introduces perilous obstacles. Players can immerse themselves in the seemingly boundless and unsettling levels of the backrooms, experiencing the game's eerie and intricate mazes.

Game.Name: Backrooms Break
Game.Overview: Explore and break the environments of the Backrooms and Poolrooms! Utilize Thor's demolition hammer, firearms, and explosives to carve your way through the walls and entities. This isn't just another mundane walking simulator game. Now the entities are the victims.

Game.Name: Backrooms: Escape Together
Game.Overview: Backrooms: Escape Together is a 1-6 player coop horror experience. You are at the mercy of the entities lurking and must do whatever it takes to survive while completing each level's objectives. Multiple new levels will be added each month as we develop the true Backrooms experience.

Game.Name: Backrooms Society
Game.Overview: Backrooms Society is a 1-8 player co-op horror game. Make your way through unique levels of the backrooms while trying to survive and avoid mysterious entities. Scavenge each level for gear and resources, bring it back to The Hub where you can sell valuables and buy/craft new gear.

Game.Name: Backspace Bouken
Game.Overview: Type your way through absurd encounters and mysterious puzzles in this old-school typing dungeon crawler.

Game.Name: Backspin Billiards
Game.Overview:
A simulation of the game of billiards. Includes nine different variations. Includes 8-Ball (Sink all 7 of your balls, then sink the 8-Ball.), 9-Ball (Sink the 9-Ball, but the first ball hit in each shot must be the lowest-numbered ball still on the table.), Cutthroat (3-player game. Be the last player with balls on the table.), Euro 8-Ball (Like 8-Ball, but the pocket doesn't need to be called when sinking the 8-Ball.), 14.1 Continuous (Call a ball and a pocket. Each called ball earns a point. First player to 30 wins.), 3-Ball (Sink all 3 balls in the fewest amount of shots.), Trick Shots (Sink all balls in a single shot. 90 layouts are included.), Time Trial (Sink all balls in the least time possible. 12 layouts are included.), and Golf (Sink all balls in the fewest shots possible. 36 layouts are included.).
Aside from Trick Shots, Time Trial, and Golf, which are single-player affairs, all games can be played against the computer, on five different difficulty levels, or a second player on the same computer. The number of matches in each game is also adjustable, as are some rules. Finally, the appearance of the table, the control scheme, and aiming aids can all be changed.

Game.Name: Backstage Pass
Game.Overview: A visual novel/sim game about life, love, and working in the entertainment industry. Play as makeup artist Sian Goodin as she navigates the world of showbiz. Make friends, forge business relationships, and maybe even find romance!

Game.Name: Backstreet Boys: Puzzles in Motion
Game.Overview:
Did you ever puzzle a video? Just imagine a Backstreet Boys music video that has been cut into little square pieces. The individual squares have been scrambled, rotated or even mirrored. How quickly can you put the video back together? How well do you recognize the music clips with A.J., Brian, Howie D., Kevin and Nick? Test your puzzle and musical skills at the same time! If you succeed in solving the 12 clips on one level you're ready to tackle the 13th tricky video puzzle.
CD-Rom contains clips from some of the most popular Backstreet Boys music videos and the original songs: - We've Got It Goin' On - Anywhere For You - I'll Never Break Your Heart - Everybody (Backstreet's Back) - All I Have To Give -I Wanna Be With You
3 puzzle variations with 3 levels of difficulty offer a total of 117 playing options.

Game.Name: Backstreets of the Mind
Game.Overview: Sometimes we think that if we could change something from our past, our whole life would turn out differently.

Game.Name: Back to Bed
Game.Overview:
Back to Bed is an artistic 3D puzzle game with a surreal twist. Bob is an unlucky narcoleptic who has a tendency of falling asleep in his boring office and then proceeding to sleepwalk into the dangers of the big city. Luckily, Bob has a subconscious guardian named Subob, who protects the sleepwalker and guides him back to the safety of his bed.
The ever-vigilant Subob must lead Bob on a journey through a series of surreal painting-like cityscapes, where the boundary between Bob's dreams and reality have vanished.

Game.Name: Back to the Arcade
Game.Overview:
Play 3D remakes of the following classic arcade games (v0.9) on a fantasy holographic console:
- 1943 - Pacman - Frogger - Asteroids - Pinball Action - Space Invaders - Moon Patrol - Rally-X - Tetris

Game.Name: Back to the Dawn
Game.Overview: Back to the Dawn is a story-rich RPG set in a high-security prison ruled by factions and buried secrets. Investigate two conspiracies from the inside, gather evidence, and outsmart a system designed to silence you. Make friends (or foes) with fellow inmates and with their help, break out of prison.

Game.Name: BACK TO THE EGG! Tower Defense
Game.Overview: Classical tower defense game mixed with rpg elements - Filled with things to do and places to explore.

Game.Name: Back to the Future Ep 1: It's About Time
Game.Overview:
It's About Time! is the first out of five episodes of Back to the Future: The Game.
The year is 1986, and Doc has been missing for a long time by now. Because of all the debts he was having, the city decided to build a parking garage at the place of his house, selling all stuff from it along the way. Marty McFly is trying to save things precious to him, but suddenly the time-traveling car DeLorean appears out of nowhere with the Doc's cry for help! It appears that Doc is stranded in the year 1931, where he was arrested for setting a speakeasy on fire. Marty must travel to the past and rescue his friend before he gets lynched by furious mob.
The adventure game features third-person view with real-time 3D graphics and pre-defined fixed, pivoting or scrolling camera settings. While interaction is performed in classic point-and-click style, the player has to move Marty by direction keys or dragging the character with the mouse. Puzzles are predominantly inventory-based; certain tasks can also be solved by gathering information and selecting the correct dialogue choices.

Game.Name: Back to the Future Ep 2: Get Tannen!
Game.Overview: While keeping an eye on young Doc Brown's proverbial date with scientific destiny, Marty and 1980's Doc must prevent gang boss Kid Tannen from wreaking havoc on Marty's family and erasing his girlfriend from the future.

Game.Name: Back to the Future Ep 3: Citizen Brown
Game.Overview:
Citizen Brown is the third out of five episodes of Back to the Future: The Game.
After reinstating the timeline of Kid Tannen and Grandpa Artie in the previous episode in 1931, Marty McFly and Doc Brown return to 1986, the relative present of the story. But during the leap Doc disappears and the time-machine crashes out of control into a billboard. Once again Marty finds himself in an disturbingly altered present. This time he has to encounter patriarchal Citizen Brown, who has turned Hill Valley into some kind of enfenced compound to make it the most secure, clean and peaceful place. Because the time machine is wrecked, Citizen Brown seems to be the only one who could help Marty. But to get in contact with him Marty has to break quite some rules of the surveillance society.
The adventure game features third-person view with real-time 3D graphics and pre-defined fixed, pivoting or scrolling camera settings. While interaction is performed in classic point-and-click style, the player has to move Marty by direction keys or dragging the character with the mouse. Puzzles are predominantly inventory-based; certain tasks can also be solved by gathering information and selecting the correct dialogue choices.

Game.Name: Back to the Future Ep 4: Double Visions
Game.Overview:
Double Visions is the fourth out of five episodes of Back to the Future: The Game.
Having nearly restored Doc to his real self in the intimidating alternate-reality 1986 in the previous episode, Marty must eliminate the cause of all troubles: Doc's relationship with Edna Strickland, which Marty has inadvertently caused during his stay in the 1930's. Now Marty has to travel back to 1931 and figure out a way to break the relationship, guiding the young Doc to his true passion: science.
The adventure game features third-person view with real-time 3D graphics and pre-defined fixed, pivoting or scrolling camera settings. While interaction is performed in classic point-and-click style, the player has to move Marty by direction keys or dragging the character with the mouse. Puzzles are predominantly inventory-based; certain tasks can also be solved by gathering information and selecting the correct dialogue choices.

Game.Name: Back to the Future Ep 5: Outatime
Game.Overview:
OUTATIME is the fifth and final episode of Back to the Future: The Game.
