Asynchronous Multiplayer: Once you build a realm, it is always available online for others to attack/raid. Attack notifications are delivered each time you launch the game. Replay: Watch replays of attacks on your realm by other players to gain insights on how to improve your defenses or attack strategy.

Game.Name: BAR: Beyond All Reason
Game.Overview: Beyond All Reason (BAR) is a free/open source real-time strategy video game. Powered by the Spring game engine, it was created to uphold the legacy of Total Annihilation. Its gameplay is heavily based on Balanced Annihilation, another game running on Spring Engine, which itself evolved from Absolute Annihilation, a total conversion of Total Annihilation mod Uberhack to the Spring Engine. Beyond all Reason most notably introduces updated graphics, models, sound effects, soundtrack, and user interface, with the original aim to free the game from the proprietary assets of Total Annihilation.

Game.Name: Barbie Adventure: Riding Club
Game.Overview: Barbie gets her very own horse ranch. Designed for the five to nine year old age range, Barbie Adventure: Riding Club lets players care for and ride their own horse. The horse riding is European (aka Equestrian) style as opposed to western, although the game doesn't force the player to take that into account when they're riding. The horse is controlled with simplistic controls to make it jump, steer, and adjust speed. After choosing a horse for Barbie, she can spend some time feeding and grooming it before saddling up and going for a ride. Riding the trails is the bulk of the gameplay. The player can race their horse against several of Barbie's friends. There are also some mini-games that the player comes across while riding. The mini-games involve activities such as arranging flowers in their proper sequence, sorting apples, and frog-hopping.

Game.Name: Barbie and Her Sisters: Puppy Rescue
Game.Overview:
Set in Barbies hometown Willows, and inspired by the upcoming DVD Barbie and her Sisters in the Great Puppy Adventure, players will join Barbie and her sisters - Skipper, Stacie and Chelsea - as they solve clues to find and rescue lost puppies.
Each sister will bring her own unique set of skills and activities to the game. Give puppies a check-up with Skipper at the Roberts Sisters Puppy Rescue, groom the pups at Chelseas Puppy Day Care or teach them new tricks at the Pup Camp with Stacie! Cuddle and play with the puppies until they can go to their fur-ever homes!

Game.Name: Barbie and the Magic of Pegasus
Barbie as Princess Bride
Game.Overview:
Barbie as Princess Bride introduces the player to a young Princess Barbie and her childhood friend, Prince Ken. The two grow up close together, fully intending to wed the day they come of age. One day, Prince Ken is called out to sea on a long journey but promises the princess that he will return to marry her one day.
Years pass and Princess Barbie receives word from a Butterfly Fairy that Ken is finally on his way back home. Ecstatic, Princess Barbie hurries to make wedding preparations. The Butterfly Fairy gives Barbie a magic mirror with 12 jewels around it. The 12 jewels correspond to 12 parts of the game. As Barbie completes more of the activities, the image of her Prince in the mirror becomes more clear.
The 12 parts to the game are as follows: - A matching game where invitations must be matched to envelopes based on the pictures of the woodland animals to whom the invitations will be delivered. - Search for woodland creatures in the forest so that they can be recruited to deliver invitations to their species. - Bake a wedding cake by following the recipe and adding the ingredients in the right order, ingredients such as flour, sugar, eggs, butter, harmony, and the gift of giving. - Pick decorations for the cake from the Butterfly Fairy's magical garden. - Decorate the cake with the chosen decorations. - Not really an activity, but a musical interlude where Princess Barbie sings of how excited she is about her upcoming nuptials. - Princess Barbie sees that the ring bearer has inadvertently dropped a bunch of important wedding items (like the ring) into the well. Use the bucket to fish out each item. - Princess Barbie must meet with the musicians and straighten out their sound by matching sheet music to appropriate instruments and organizing the music pages in the correct order. - Ken's ship has met with some rough seas and Princess Barbie must help navigate the ship home safely. - Toss coins into various levels of a wishing fountain in order to make Princess Barbie's wish come true. - Customize the wedding dress and bouquet for both Barbie and her flower girl. - The wedding has transpired; the only thing left to do is customize the wedding photo.

Game.Name: Barbie as Rapunzel: A Creative Adventure
Game.Overview: Barbie plays Rapunzel. A witch has turned Prince Stefan to stone and destroyed much of the castle, all for the offense of not being invited to the masquerade ball. Rapunzel and her dragon friend, Penelope, set out to restore the castle in time for the ball and find missing magic gems to restore the prince. The player must help Rapunzel restore and redecorate 6 locations in the castle: The grand foyer, the hallway, the bedroom, the throne room, the dining room, and the garden. In each room, the player uses items from the magic toolbox (such as a magic wand or magic paint brush) in order to restore and further customize various pieces of the room. Further, each room has a larger challenge for restoration that allows for a higher level of creativity. For example, in the grand foyer, the player must create a new mosaic for the floor by selecting a pattern, filling in the blocks to the right places, and filling in between the blocks. Once a room has been completely restored, the player is able to use a magical magnifying glass to carefully search the room for 1 of the 6 missing gems. Once all 6 rooms have been restored and all 6 gems have been collected, Rapunzel must conquer the garden hedge maze and use the gems to rescue Prince Stefan. In addition to the active play mode, there is a passive storybook mode. This game teaches early reading skills to young children.

Game.Name: Barbie as Sleeping Beauty
Game.Overview:
Barbie assumes the role of Princess Rose in the classic fairy tale of Sleeping Beauty. When Princess Rose is born, a number of benevolent fairies arrive to bless the child with a bounty of gifts. A wicked fairy, feeling slighted because she wasn't invited, crashes the birthday party and places a curse on the child -- if she pricks her finger on a sewing spindle during her first 15 years, she will fall into a deep slumber for 100 years. Another fairy is able to mitigate this curse with the stipulation that a prince's kiss will wake her in such an eventuality.
The game consists of a series of activities that can either be played at random or in order according to the main storyline. Princess Rose wakes up her woodland friends and invites them to her 16th birthday party, makes a dress and crown, plays hide and seek with the fairies, but then gets tricked by the evil fairy into pricking her finger on a sewing spindle and taking a long nap. At that point, the fairies have to put everyone in the castle to sleep while they work on the problem. Then they recruit a prince who must chop through a maze of thorn brush in order to reach the castle and give the princess a smooch. Princess Rose must then battle the wicked fairy in order to retrieve the magic flute.

Game.Name: Barbie Beach Vacation
Game.Overview:
Barbie Beach Vacation takes her and her friends to the the sands and the waves of a remote island. Like most Barbie titles, it's geared towards 5-9 year olds.
There are plenty of activities to occupy Barbie when she gets tired of soaking up rays. Since this is a Barbie game, of course Barbie can choose her attire from dozens of bathing suits and beach outfits. She can surf or water ski, build a sandcastle, snorkel, photograph marine life and hula dance. You can win prizes for doing well in each activity. Prizes are items like beach umbrellas and tiki torches that can be used to decorate the beach for the final stage of the game - the big beach party.

Game.Name: Barbie Beauty Styler
Game.Overview:
Barbie Beauty Styler is a creative painting / drawing package featuring Barbie and her friends Teresa, Kira and Christie. It is aimed at the younger gamer. There is very little writing, all the icons 'speak' to identify themselves as the mouse passes over them and the game regularly chips in with encouraging comments like 'You're really good at this' and 'Isn't this fun!'.
As the gaming equivalent of dressing up dolls this game's strength lies in its ease of use and the number of possible combinations of model, pose, location, clothes and accessories that can be used to create a picture. Once a picture has been created it can be printed and / or saved in Barbie's Beauty Book.
The game starts by opening Barbie's beauty case, selecting one of the models and whether a full or close-up portrait is going to be used as the starting point. From there the player chooses from one of four locations, Fantasy, Party Fun, Evening Glamour, and Totally Trendy, which will form the background for the picture. Each location has a its own music track and offers five different backgrounds. With these selections made the game displays the model on-screen against the chosen background on the design screen and the real fun begins.
The Design Screen is what this game is all about. Around the screen in two arcs, one on the right the other on the left, are a series of special effects windows. By selecting these the player can use the mouse place sequins on the models dress. This can be done by placing one sequin at a time or my holding down the left mouse button while moving the mouse whole strings of sequins can be used to decorate the dress of any part of the picture.
The arcs that show the available effects can be rotated to bring yet further effects into view. Mistakes can be removed either with the erase icon which restores the picture to its original state, with the undo icon which removes the last placed piece, or any of the three scissors icons which allow parts of a placed adornment to be removed.
Around the edges of the screen are the Styling icons. These change the available effects shown in the design arcs. When the 'Styling Brushes' icon is in use the arcs will show a series of hair effects while the 'Accessories' icon will show sunglasses tiaras etc.
The designer screen also allows player to add animated stamps such as butterflies and raindrops to their picture, change the models outfit and add a friend.

Game.Name: Barbie Cool Looks Fashion Designer
Game.Overview:
In Barbie Cool Looks Fashion Designer the player can select clothes for Barbie Christie, Kira or Teresa. The player selects the clothes from those on display in the girl's room which they can then customise by choosing from eighty-four fabric designs, colouring them from a thirty-five colour palette (though only four colours per design are allowed), and have the girls model the clothes at the mall, office, park, beach or in their bedroom. The player's creations are saved in a wardrobe and can be revisited at any time to be worn by any of the games characters.
Clothes consist of a range of hats, dresses, shirts, skirts, pants, accessories and jackets etc. The player clicks on an item in a girl's room and then scrolls through the available options, at this stage all the clothes are white. Once something pleasing has been found the player then proceeds to the design part of the game where the clothes can be coloured in giving, for example, an all black jacket or a pattern can be selected in which case individual parts of the pattern can be coloured in. Once designed these can be exported and shared with other players who have the same game or they can be printed. The clothing options available vary depending on the location they are going to so, for example, if we're taking Christie to the beach the dress would be replaced with a swimsuit, handbags would be replaced by beach bags, shoes would be replaced by sandals etc.
The print function is an important feature of this game as in-game photos of the girls modelling the new clothes can be printed in colour as gifts, in black and white to be coloured in off live. Patterns for Barbie fashion accessories, both for the player and the doll, can also be printed along with assembly instructions. The tutorial also refers to printing dress patterns on Barbie Fashion Fabric but it is not clear whether this is a print of a plain pattern or the players entire design colours and all.
Within the game all instructions are spoken - there is nothing to read on screen.

Game.Name: Barbie Dreamhouse Party
Game.Overview: Join Barbie and her friends for an adventure that will take fans behind pink doors into the fantastic world of the Dreamhouse. Based on the popular Barbie Life in the Dreamhouse web series, dolls everywhere will get a chance to explore the Dreamhouse and play fabulous mini games.

Game.Name: Barbie Explorer
Game.Overview: Explore the world with Barbie. Travel to Tibet, Egypt, and the African jungle on a mission to find four ancient, jeweled treasures. Run, jump, swing, climb, and dive to avoid obstacles and deadly pitfalls in a race to unlock the secrets of the Mystic Mirror. Travel only with Barbie or bring a friend, as this game supports up to two players.

Game.Name: Barbie: Fashion Designer
Game.Overview:
With this game you can actually create totally new outfits for your Barbie doll using a software to edit the clothes and then printing them to actual fabric, supplied along with the game.
Edit clothes for different occasions (wedding, casual, party, date, work and beach), and then choose accessories, patterns, colors, and much more.
Once you're done you can watch your clothes being shown at the catwalk by Barbie models, or print photos of your creations.

Game.Name: Barbie Fashion Show
Game.Overview:
Design clothing collections in the glamorous world of high fashion as you help Barbie get ready for the biggest event of her career--Fashion Week in Paris! Complete exciting fashion assignments to advance through three different design studios. Create looks for each show by choosing the styles, fabrics, and colors. Pick hairstyles and shoes, too! Plus select the stage, music, and special poses to bring the runway to life! Itâ€™s up to you to create the coolest, most fashionable fashion shows ever!
Features:
Create dazzling fashions in three unique design studios as you prepare for each show! Select patterns and fabrics for styles that sizzle! Then add your special touch with decals, sequins, and more! Dress up Barbie, Teresa, Christie, Lea, and Kayla in style! Add new hairstyles and cool shoes for the perfect look! Set the stage for the ultimate runway shows by choosing the shape, theme, props, and even music! Choose the perfect moves and poses for Barbie and her friends to show off your designs! Models sashay, twirl, and strut down the runway! Complete 10 fashion assignments in all! Collections get bigger and better as you unlock bonuses like new fabrics, patterns, stage sets, music, and more! Snap pictures of your fashions and play back shows for your friends! You can even post your designs at Barbie.com

Game.Name: Barbie Fashion Show: An Eye for Style
Game.Overview: Put your personal mark on the fashion world with Barbie Fashion Show: An Eye for Style. Help Barbie put on a fabulous show that will WOW the fashion world! With plenty of creative and customization options, the possibilities are virtually endless. From concept to catwalk, you will design the outfits and accessories for your very own fashion line.

Game.Name: Barbie: Generation Girl: Gotta Groove: CD-ROM
Game.Overview: Barbie Generation Girl Gotta Groove CD-ROM is a creativity game that offers Barbie fans the opportunity to choose a character (Barbie, Marissa, Nichelle, Susie, Chelsie or Marie), dress her up, choose music and perform her own dances. Girls can train, print cards, and record up to 9 dance sessions. The program can also import pictures from the Barbie Photo Designer digital camera. Barbie Generation Girl Gotta Groove CD-ROM is aimed at ages 5 and up.

Game.Name: Barbie Horse Trails
Game.Overview: Giddy up! Play as Barbie and Barbie in an adventure through Canterbury Trails Park with your horse, Lucky. As a Junior Ranger, youâ€™ll discover stunning wildlife and capture amazing photos. Join friends, find collectibles, and add sparkle to Barbie and Luckyâ€™s looks.

Game.Name: Barbie Magic Genie Bottle
Game.Overview:
You find yourself in possession of an ornate bottle and take it to an antique shop to have the bottle evaluated and appraised. The storekeeper informs you that the bottle is magic and that all you need to do is rub it. Suddenly, Barbie emerges from the bottle in genie form and explains her plight -- an evil genie in the employ of a sinister sultan stole her powers. She requests your help to retrieve her powers and defeat the bad sultan and genie.
Barbie Magic Genie Bottle is a computer game that is packaged with a custom-purpose input peripheral -- an actual genie bottle that attaches to a Windows PC via a standard PC 15-pin joystick port. The bottle is used to invoke special actions during the game and is thus a required component of the gameplay.
Barbie transports the player to the distant land where you will be assisting her. Barbie needs the player to visit 5 different lands and collect 5 different gems. In order to collect the gem in each land, the player must solve a puzzle. Solving the puzzle requires collecting 5 puzzle pieces scattered about the land.
Gameplay involves navigating through a first-person 3D city on foot and via flying carpet, which raises the player up to a higher plane. All the while, Barbie is in tow lending advice. Throughout different cities, the player also has to interact with other people and complete sub-quests that they assign in order to advance the game.

Game.Name: Barbie: Magic Hair Styler
Game.Overview:
Choose either Barbie, Kira, Christie or Teresa and style her just the way you want.
Customize her hair (cut, grow, curl or brush), her make-up (eyeshadow, lipstick, blush or even fun fake tatoos) and choose her clothes and accessories, all according to the party she'll be attending to tonight.
Once you're done styling, watch your chosen model showing off her outfit in 3D, and you can even take pictures, frame them and print them.

Game.Name: Barbie: Mermaid Adventure
Game.Overview: In Barbie Mermaid Adventure, Barbie assumes the role of a specimen of that mythical fish-human hybrid, the mermaid, and plans a party with all of her undersea friends. Unfortunately, a magical light shell in the main palace broke. In order to fix it, Barbie needs to enlist the help of 3 rainbow dolphins. Each rainbow dolphin is hiding in its own area, either in Sunken Ship Cove, Kelp Forest, or the Coral Reef. In order to find the dolphin, Barbie must find 3 musicians in the area so that she can ask them to play at her party; and she must solve 2 minigames in each area. Each area has a maze game where Barbie must collect an accessory that she will be able to wear at the party (necklace, crown, and earrings). Other minigames include a Breakout clone, a matching game, and a puzzle game in which Barbie must rock all of the baby cuddlefish to sleep while not waking others who are already sleeping. Additionally, the game includes activities to decorate the collected accessories as well as the party stage. Finally, the player gets to watch the aquatic celebration.

Game.Name: Barbie: Pet Rescue: CD-ROM
Game.Overview:
Barbie Pet Rescue lets kids play with and care for a variety of domesticated animals. Visit Barbie and her kid sister Stacey at the Pet Rescue Center, where you'll wait for rescue missions, explore in the playrooms, or tend to pets in the Care Center.
Rescue missions come in over the phone or via e-mail; after learning which pet is missing where, travel with Barbie on her scooter to one of three different environments in which to search for one of eight lost pets. In many missions, you'll have to figure out how to entice scared animals to come to you, or how to retrieve pets trapped in trees or other sticky situations. If you get stuck yourself, Barbie will give you hints. With each successful mission, you'll receive a printable Paw & Purr Award that hangs on the Pet Rescue Center wall.
Rescued pets come back to the Pet Rescue Center with you and Barbie to wait for their owners and receive a little TLC. Nurse them back to health in the Care Center, where you'll give recovered pets water, treats, vitamins and grooming. You may also need to bandage a hurt leg or pick burrs from ruffled fur. After creating a file for them in the computer and giving them a name you select from a list of suggestions, the animals go to one of two playrooms to wait for their owners.
In the meantime, you can play with them, plus all the other pets already in the playroom--a kitten, bunny, hamster, puppy, and a turtle. Select which animal you'd like to pet, then use the cursor to stroke an animal's head or back or scratch it under the chin. The animals respond to your attention by licking, rolling over, purring, or barking.
There is a related mini-game for each kind of animal--Kitten Keepaway, Puppy Treat Toss, Hamster Trail, etc.--and if you do well enough, you'll see the animal perform a special trick. A few of the games require the use of logic and spatial aptitude, but for the most part they challenge the players' mouse mastery and hand-eye coordination.

Game.Name: Barbie: Super Sports
Game.Overview:
Check out two of the coolest extreme sports around! With BarbieÂ® Super Sportsâ„¢ CD-ROM, you can show off your sporting skills as you snowboard through obstacle courses and blade through radical racetracks.
Each sport features five different levels of cool competitions, spectacular stunts, special tricks and even secret areas! Earn points in each level as you meet each new challenge. You're ready, set, go for the most incredible sport thrills and spills ever!
Features: -Explore 2 cool sporting worlds in one game! -Enhances hand-eye coordination skills! -Offers challenges as girls race against the clock! -Choose your sport! Snowboarding or in-line skating! -Earn points as you race against the clock, the computer or even your friend! -Get extreme and outrageous obstacle courses and radical racetracks! -Cash in points for new equipment to do even cooler tricks and stunts! Or pick up some cool new clothes in the sport shop!

Game.Name: Barbie: Team Gymnastics
Game.Overview: Kids join Barbie and her friends at the gym to create, practice, and view 3-D gymnastics routines, including exercises for the vault, balance beam, uneven bars, and the floor. Once routines are complete, users compete on the local, sectional, regional, and national levels to try to win a gold medal. With success comes the right to wear special outfits and other rewards. One-, two-, and three-player modes. Select from dozens of awesome gymnastic moves, and practice them on the vault, uneven bars, balance beam and floor exercises. Girls will choreograph an entire gymnastics routine in full 3D. After you've practiced & created a routine, go to compete against other teams. Four levels of competition - Local, Sectional, Regional and National levels - see if you can earn a Gold Medal.

Game.Name: Bardbarian
Game.Overview: You play as Brad the barbarian, who is awoken to the sounds of his town under siege. Today is different though; Brad has grown tired of fighting all the time. The usual grind for XP has grown dull, and he has decided to pursue his dreams of making music instead of shedding blood.

Game.Name: Bard Harder!
Game.Overview: BARD HARDER! is a tabletop-inspired visual novel game about saving your friends from the Big Bad Evil Guy by using your strongest weapon: romance! So brush up on your pick-up lines and prepare some sexy tunesâ€¦whatâ€™s the worst that could happen?

Game.Name: Bard's Gold
Game.Overview: Bard's Gold is a challenging platformer that let's you explore eerie worlds in a quest for a Goblin that stole your gold. Help the Bard to overcome the dungeonâ€™s many dangerous perils and use your new-found treasures to improve your character and to buy new weapons and gear!

Game.Name: Bard to the Future
Game.Overview: Bard to the Future is a side scrolling 2D platformer which follows a medieval battlebard as he finds a time machine, meets two LARPers and ends up in a race against a time travelling cyborg pirate to discover a lost treasure.

Game.Name: Bardysh: Kromeford no Juunintachi
Game.Overview: Bardysh is a roguelike RPG released by Imadio. Adventurers seeking a thrill came to Igis Island in search for the world's oldest heritage, a crystal that is said to make all wishes come true. Everybody is anxious to explore the labyrinth which nobody had reached the end of and the game offers 5 dungeons for the player to explore. Apart from exploring the dungeons, the island offers an arena to test one's strength. The main character can be chosen from 3 different types of species with male and female options. Each species can use different kinds of weapons.

Game.Name: Barista Simulator
Game.Overview: Barista Simulator lets you experience making a wide variety of coffees just like espresso, latte, cappuccino or even your special mix of coffees. While managing your coffee shop, you play as a Barista and make the coffees your customers want. It's up to you to choose how to treat your shoppers.

Game.Name: Barista: Take Away
Game.Overview:
Test your barista skills in this game inspired by Club del CafÃ© in Pontevedra. Try to guess the type of origin coffee for each client and don't forget any ingredient!
In this drag and drop game against the clock, you will experience behind the bar of the emblematic coffee of Pontevedra and you will be able to know the qualities of each of the coffees of origin that are served there, while trying to get the perfect coffee. Check the menu, select the coffee and drag the ingredients to add them to the glass and make your customer leave happy. Oh, and remember to cover it, so not a drop spills out!
Nine different coffee origins, seven different ways to prepare it, a bunch of disparate customers, and a little jazz music to calm your nerves. What score will you be able to get?

Game.Name: Barkanoid
Game.Overview:
Barkanoid is a clone of the game Arkanoid. Although basic gameplay is the same, Barkanoid has 100 levels, 35 collectibles and more monsters.
The Windows 3.x version is played in a window without a DirectX full-screen mode.

Game.Name: Barkley Gaiden 2: The Son of Dark Draker: Barkley Shut Up and Jam: Gaiden, Gaiden Episode 1
Game.Overview:
A long-awaited follow-up to Barkley Shut Up and Jam Gaiden: 3 (The Lost SaGa): Shitpost Edition, this game continues the epic Hoopz SaGa detailed in the earlier Barkley: Shut Up and Jam Gaiden, Barkley Shut Up and Jam Gaiden 2 (Janky Demo Ver), as well as all other canonical forms of Barkley related media. (Space Jam 2 is not canon).
Keyboard and Mouse ARPG controls, with keyboard aim and mouse movement.
Featuring full Al Bhed language support and optional consequences for your actions.

Game.Name: Barkley, Shut Up and Jam: Gaiden
Game.Overview:
The Great B-Ball Purge of 2041, a day so painful to some that it is referred to only as the â€œB-Ballnachtâ€. Thousands upon thousands of the worldâ€™s greatest ballers were massacred in a swath of violence and sports bigotry as the game was outlawed worldwide. The reason: the Chaos Dunk, a jam so powerful its mere existence threatens the balance of chaos and order. Among the few ballers and fans that survived the basketball genocide was Charles Barkley, the man capable of performing the â€œVerboten Jamâ€â€¦
Flash forward 12 years to the post-cyberpocalyptic ruins of Neo New York, 2053. A Chaos Dunk rocks the island of Manhattan, killing 15 million. When the finger is put on the aging Charles Barkley, he must evade the capture of the B-Ball Removal Department, led by former friend and baller Michael Jordan, and disappear into the dangerous underground of the post-cyberpocalypse to clear his name and find out the mysterious truth behind the Chaos Dunk. Joined by allies along the way, including his son Hoopz, Barkley must face the dangers of a life he thought he gave up a long time ago and discover the secrets behind the terrorist organization B.L.O.O.D.M.O.S.E.S.
A tale of zaubers, b-balls, and atonement; brave dangers unheard of, face spectacular challenges that even the greatest ballers could not overcome, and maybeâ€¦ just maybeâ€¦ redeem basketball once and for all in: Tales of Gameâ€™s Studios Presents Chef Boyardeeâ€™s Barkley, Shut Up & Jam: Gaiden, Chapter 1 of the Hoopz Barkley SaGa.

Game.Name: Barney Goes to the Circus
Game.Overview:
Set in a circus, there are 6 activities to explore along with Barney, B.J., and Baby Bop:
Baby Bop's Roller Coaster: Create silly clown faces and learn to connect certain facial expressions with different emotions. BJ's Carousel: Make your own merry-go-round and learn up/down concepts. Professor Tinkerputt's Snack Bar: Create your own pizzas with all sorts of wacky toppings, and learn about simple fractions. Terry's Letter Train: Place letters (upper and lowercase) on the correct train cars, then color pictures of objects that start with particular letters of the alphabet. Hootin' Annie's Musical Big Top: Identify the circus animals, and create silly ones too! Video Ferris Wheel: Watch video clips from the Barney TV show.
Each activity (except the video one, of course) has an Activity Mode with 3 levels of difficulty and an Explore Mode.
In Activity Mode, levels automatically advance as needed, and they can be manually adjusted as well.
In Explore Mode, kids are free to experiment and use their imagination.
Whenever children have completed a picture, they can click on the "Gift" icon to "send" their picture as a present to their parents. Parents of course need to check into the Parent's Room to retrieve them.

Game.Name: Barney: On Location All Around Town
Game.Overview: This game is based on the American television show Barney & Friends, starring the titular anthropomorphic purple dinosaur. The players can explore the world with not only Barney, but with BJ and Baby Bop, accessing locales from the show such as the bakery. It is also possible to play twelve different mini-games and activities witch are complete with lots of magical surprises in store for the player.

Game.Name: Barney's Fun On Imagination Island
Game.Overview: Barney's Fun On Imagination Island is an educational title aimed at pre-school children aged two and upwards. It was compatible with the Barney ActiMate toy via a device known as a PC Pack, for example covering the toy's eyes caused both the toy and the in-game character to play peek-a-boo while squeezing the toy's middle toe caused both Barney's to sing a song related to the current game. The game has keyboard shortcuts that perform the same functions for those who do not have an ActiMate.

Game.Name: Barney Under the Sea
Game.Overview: This is an educational title aimed at pre-school children aged two and upwards. It was compatible with the Barney ActiMate toy via a device known as a PC Pack, for example covering the toy's eyes caused both the toy and the in-game character to play peek-a-boo while squeezing the toy's middle toe caused both Barney's to sing a song related to the current game. The game has keyboard shortcuts that perform the same functions for those who do not have an ActiMate. This game comprises the following six activities: Baby Bop's Mermaid Castle - Here players are shown two scenes each depicting a room in the house. Below these scenes are pictures of everyday items and the player must drag and drop the items into the correct room; BJ's Giant Shell - The player is shown a picture of a person and is asked to click on different parts of the body such as 'arm', 'hand' and 'neck'; Hootin' Annie's Undersea Cave - Here the player is shown a number of animals and has to identify and click on the one specified; Trisha's Treasure Chest - The player is shown a set of animals and must select the odd-one-out; Professor Tinkerputt's Dive Site - The professor gives the player a number and the player must stack that number of shells on top of one another Video Submarine, this contains a collection of short video clips from the television show Barney & Friends. All games can be played in explorer mode where there are no right or wrong answers, this is designed to encourage children to play and experiment. When they do start playing 'seriously' all games have three levels of difficulty which can be quite challenging. For example at level three in Hootin' Annie's Undersea Cave the player is shown a night scene where only the creatures eyes are visible, they must identify the whale, seal, etc by the sound they make when the mouse rolls over them.

Game.Name: Barn Finders
Game.Overview: Search for valuable items stashed in abandoned barns. Take part in storage auctions, bid high and buy yourself a chance to find exclusive items hidden in the past.

Game.Name: BarnFinders: The Pilot
Game.Overview: Search for valuables stashed in abandoned barns. Take part in storage auctions, bid high and buy yourself a chance to find exclusive items hidden in the past.

Game.Name: Barnyard
Game.Overview: Barnyard is an offering from THQ based on the movie of the same name from Nickelodeon. You arrive at the farm as a newbie cow, and must complete quests and earn respect in order to win keys that allow you to advance through the barnyard map. As you play, you need to keep up your stamina, which decreases as you run around the farm. A good sleep is important; you need to be rested to fight off marauding raccoons and coyotes. And do remember not to let the Farmer catch you standing on two feet!

Game.Name: Barnyard Invasion
Game.Overview:
n Barnyard Invasion you take the role of aliens from a distant planet coming to earth to free farm animals from a life of boredom. By moving rows and columns of animals on a board you try to make matches of four or more so you can teleport them away. Your mission will take you to more than 5 different farms around the US, each farm having its own graphics and theme. Between each farm you are treated to snapshots of your alien adventures with the farm animals as you take them on a vacation.
Barnyard Invasion features 60 levels of play in two modes of difficulty. There are many obstacles and powerups that you will uncover as you progress. The game also features two distinct modes of play: one is a campaign mode where you move from farm to farm, and the other is an endless mode where you stay on a single that gets progressively harder.

Game.Name: Barnyard Mahjong 3
Game.Overview: Barnyard Mahjong 3 takes you on a grand adventure around the farm playing challenging mahjong puzzles with farm-inspired animals such as horses, cows and chickens.

Game.Name: Baron Wittard
Game.Overview: Baron Wittard is a single-player horror adventure game by Wax Lyrical Games. Travel to an indoor city constructed by eccentric architect Baron Wittard. Explore its haunted halls and passageways, discover an ancient evil, and solve devious puzzles. Take care traveller, because time is running out...

Game.Name: Baron Wittard: Nemesis of Ragnarok
Game.Overview:
Baron Wittard is a point & click adventure with Myst like gameplay. As a press photographer the player is assigned to a job at a mysterious building called Wittard's Utopia where people have been disappearing lately. Its building process was frozen near completion due to mysterious incidents, leaving the apartment complex abandoned.
The story evolves into a plot involving Norse mythology putting the player at the verge of RagnarÃ¶k, the twilight of the gods. To encounter the evil creature Fenrir the player needs to collect ten rune-stones hidden in Utopia and transform them into energy by a specific device for each one. The transformer devices are also hidden and distributed all over the place and protected by riddles. Same applies for most of the rune-stones, though some are simply hidden. The player is assisted by an amulet, through which Wittard can talk to the player from another dimension.
The game is presented with real-time 3D graphics and features 360 degree panoramic views in the 1st-person perspective, though the player has to proceed from viewpoint to viewpoint by following predefined directions, without the possibility of moving freely. The puzzles are predominantly machine-based, or presented in a board-game's manner. The very few item-combination puzzles are restricted to putting rune-stones into transformers, applying Wittard's amulet and using a camera on one occasion.

Game.Name: Barony
Game.Overview: Barony is the premier first-person roguelike with cooperative play. Cryptic items, brutal traps, and devious monsters await you. Conquer the dungeon alone, or gather a party in co-op with iconic and unusual RPG classes. Get ready to try, and die, and try again with a new dungeon every time you play!

Game.Name: Baroque Shooting
Game.Overview:
Baroque Shooting is an arcade vertical-scrolling shooter spin-off from the post-apocalyptic RPG Baroque.
You play as an angel as you fly through the wastes of the Baroque game-world (urban wastes destroyed by an apocalyptic heat wave) in several stages filled with monsters taken from the game gunning for you.
Hitting flying containers releases helpful "parasites" that can be assimilated into your angel and provide weapon power-ups depending on their unique power (fire, thunder or ice). These parasites can be combined in different ways thus giving your angel different weapons and abilities.

Game.Name: Baroque Typing
Game.Overview:
A typing tutor based on the game-world and characters of Baroque. You select a character from the game and attempt to correctly type the words that appear on screen before a timer runs out. Many words contain bonus items and weapons taken from the game, which grant you extra points if you type them correctly, furthermore you can chain words for extra bonuses.
Besides the single player story mode you can play a Vs match against the CPU or another player via online gameplay, in which the objective is to outscore your opponent in a fixed time period.
Also included is a desktop companion in the form of the game's Archangel who tells your fortune.

Game.Name: Barotrauma
Game.Overview: Barotrauma is a 2D co-op submarine simulator â€“ in space, with survival horror and RPG elements. Steer your submarine, complete missions, fight monsters, fix leaks, operate machinery, man the guns and craft items, and stay alert: danger in Barotrauma doesnâ€™t announce itself!

Game.Name: Barrage
Game.Overview:
Barrage is a 3D shooter in which the player pilots a futuristic aircraft. The purpose of the game is to destroy as many targets as possible within a certain time limit.
This action takes place in five different environments: Prairie, Tunnel, Canyon, Chicago and Ocean. In each environment there is a new weapon added with its own advantages to find and master.
The game supports Internet, modem, serial link and LAN multiplayer for 2 to 8 players in four environments.

Game.Name: Barrage Simulation 296
Game.Overview:
Bullet Barrage Simulation 296 Author: Ciele
----backstory---.
It has been several years since the war between the Republic of Fukuro and the Mikoneko Empire began. ...... The war had reached a stalemate.
"Greetings, trainee pilots!"
The voice of "His Excellency" echoed in front of the pilot trainees of the Republic of Fukuro's Air Force.
You are gathered here today to experience this fighter simulator. ã€€This is a simulator that perfectly recreates the battle against the Mikonenko Empire, which was obtained by our predecessors with their own experiences. ã€€This will allow you to simulate actual combat situations and hone your skills, ã€€Your chances of survival will improve dramatically, and you will be able to break out of this stalemate ...... ã€€In the meantime, you will be the cornerstone of our victory!
...... Upon hearing this, the trainee, that is, you, enter the simulator. The simulator closes its entrance with a small sound and places you inside.
System activation begins! Bullet barrage simulation 296...... is starting!
---Simulation Mode This mode allows you to play short stages in any order, with each element of the shooter extracted. You can learn the basic and applied elements and techniques of the bullet-hell shooting in each stage. Because each stage is accompanied by a "demo play" that will play through the stage, You can learn techniques that are difficult to practice in an easy-to-understand way by actually watching them with explanations. If you complete all stages 17 to 23 of the level ADVANCED, you will receive a ......?
----SUBMODE---. This is a mode in which you play through all three stages with the number of remaining planes and bombs carried over. The final score earned can be kept in the ranking up to 10 in order of highest to lowest. If you clear this mode within one mistake, you will be able to ......?
---Dictionaries---. You can view information about enemies once defeated and data of characters appearing in the game. There are data for all 100, so do your best to fill it in.
----Basic Elements---
---Menu screen--- Z: Decide X: Cancel Esc: Exit game
Key settings are defaults. You can change them in options Please also check the pad settings in the options
--Armed--
Shot (X): Shoots bullets that fly over a wide area. Power is low. Laser (Z): Focuses on a single point in a straight line. Power is high. ã€€ã€€ã€€ã€€ã€€ The speed of the ship is reduced during laser irradiation. Bomb (C): A high-intensity attack that covers the entire screen and renders the ship invincible for a certain period of time. ã€€ã€€ã€€ã€€ã€€ The duration of effect is 180 frames. The duration of invincibility is 240 frames. ã€€ã€€ã€€ã€€ã€€ The number of bombs increases as you acquire more bomb items, up to a maximum of 7 bombs. Pause (Shift): Pauses the simulator *If you press the shot and laser at the same time, the movement speed will be reduced even more than when the laser is normally irradiated
--Self-supporting aircraft type
A-type: Has a forward-focused shot and moves faster. ã€€ã€€ã€€ã€€Transition to laser is a little faster than B-type.
B-type: Has a wide spread shot and moves slower.
--Strong Mode
This is a mode for strengthening your ship that can only be used in the sub-game. It can be selected by holding pause on the ship selection screen. No record will be kept in the rankings when using this mode.
Full Burst (XZ): By pressing shot and laser at the same time, both can be released at once!
Auto Bomb: When hit by a bomb, the player consumes 2 bombs to automatically protect his/her ship. Note that the effect time is shorter than that of a normal bomb. It is activated even if there is only 1 bomb left.

Game.Name: BARRAGE / é“å¹•
Game.Overview: Tired of "Pew-Pew"pistol,Why not try about Bofors 40mm Anti-Aircraft Guns,or Mighty 88mm Flak-cannon?Shatter the sky with your BARRAGE,and ther is nothing like aiming or reloading can distrub you from shooting.

Game.Name: Barrel Mania
Game.Overview: Something has gone terribly wrong at DCAE (Don't Care About Environment) Corp. The mainframe system responsible for safe handling and transport of volatile chemicals is down. There is only one person skillful enough to prevent catastrophe! You decide to get down to the laboratory and pick up some of the high-tech gadgets. Equipped with the latest technology and brains, you confidently enter the Barrel Mania zone!

Game.Name: Barren Depths
Game.Overview: Escape a confusing cave system without being eaten in this short, underwater horror game.

Game.Name: Barrier X
Game.Overview: Dodge! Shoot! Go faster! Break the sound barrier in this unbelievably fast game and go straight for the first place in the leaderboard of BARRIER X!

Game.Name: Barro
Game.Overview: Choose your little car and race!

Game.Name: Barro 2020
Game.Overview: Try not to fall!

Game.Name: Barro F
Game.Overview: Faster and funnier!

Game.Name: Bar Room Games: Gold Edition
Game.Overview:
Bar Room Games: Gold Edition is a collection of bar-themed minigames:
Pool: A one-player game of eight-ball billiards. You control the angle of the cue stick and hold down your mouse to change the strength of the strike. You get 25 points for pocketing a ball in the first round, 24 points in the second round, and so on, down to a minimum of 5 points. If the cue ball falls into the hole, you lose 5 points. The black ball must be pocketed last, otherwise you lose all points and can get no more.
Darts: A one-player game of darts. A crosshair appears at a random spot and to aim, you have to drag it with your mouse to your target before the time runs out.
Bowling: A one-player ten-pin bowling game. You choose where to launch the bowling ball and try to knock down as many pins as possible.
Bartender: You have five glasses. Random drinks appear over the glasses and are poured into them after a time limit runs out. You can switch two adjacent glasses at any time. If a glass gets filled with three drinks that together form a viable cocktail recipe, the glass is emptied and you gain score. Overfilling a glass causes it to break and vanish. Empty glasses sometimes appear in place of the drinks, these can be used to empty a filled glass or replace a broken one. The game is over when all your glasses are broken.

Game.Name: Bar Room Games: Pool
Game.Overview: Bar Room Games: Pool simulates pool billiard for one player. The principle is simple: the table is shown in a top-down perspective and the player positions the cue with the mouse. When pressing the right mouse button he gets a preview of the movement of the white ball and by pressing the left mouse button he starts to build up force. The force of the hit depends on how long he holds the button before releasing it. The goal is to pot all balls.

Game.Name: Barro Racing
Game.Overview: Jump!

Game.Name: Barrow Hill: Curse of the Ancient Circle
Game.Overview: Somewhere deep within the woods of Cornwall, a timeless force is stirring. Unseen beneath the ancient burial mound, known locally as Barrow Hill, a forgotten myth awakens. Use archaeology to discover that the barrow is more than just a collection of forgotten standing stones.

Game.Name: Barrow Hill: The Dark Path
Game.Overview: Follow the Dark Path into a world of Druidic lore and Celtic myths. It is the Autumn Equinox on Barrow Hill, a time of great power, when the ancient standing stones are at their most powerful and dangerous. You have one night to make the offerings, follow the Dark Path and escape Barrow Hill.

Game.Name: Bartender VR Simulator
Game.Overview: ðŸ¸ Bartender VR Simulator offers you a unique combination of a simulator, bartending course and incredible immersive VR game. Developed in cooperation with a six-time Bartending World Champion, Tomek Malek,

Game.Name: Bartlow's Dread Machine
Game.Overview: An artifact from the past returns in Bartlow's Dread Machine, a game from the dawn of the Electric Age. Dread Machine is a dual stick arcade shooter with single player and couch co-op modes, six scintillating game worlds and a cast of improbable monsters and characters.

Game.Name: Basalt Breaker
Game.Overview: Basalt Breaker is a fresh, 3rd person, isometric take on a beloved puzzle game (Minesweeper). Explore classic rooms, perfect your skills on replay-able daily puzzles, or try uniquely shaped custom floors. The perfect comfort game to play while queuing for a match or sitting through a tedious meeting.

Game.Name: Bas de Beer naar Pirateneiland
Game.Overview:
Bas de Beer naar Pirateneiland is the first of the Dutch Bas de Beer games. It is meant for players between the ages of four and ten. The players follow the story of Bas de Beer (Bas the Bear) who finds an old chest called Kraak in an attic. Kraak starts telling the story of a pirate treasure buried on Pirateneiland (Pirate Island) put there by Ã‰Ã©noog (One Eye). Together with his uncle Bob, Bas decides to find the treasure Kraak has told about.
While on the adventure, Bas is unwillingly accompanied by the evil Professor Punthoofd (Pointy Head), who hid inside the ship when it left. When they arrive on the island, they are greeted by the natives, and with their help they start their journey to find the treasure.

Game.Name: Baseball Adventure
Game.Overview: Baseball Adventure is a 2d game designed for the speed and reaction of the player, each blow must be calculated and hit in time, watch the moving objects around and have time to pull out the glove to catch the ball.

Game.Name: Baseball Mogul
Game.Overview:
Baseball Mogul is a managerial baseball simulation and runs on the same engine as Football Mogul. The player takes the role of a General Manager of a Major League Baseball team and is responsible for its athletic and financial success. The game has no MLB license and uses fake team names, but real athlete names. The team names can be edited.
The user interface uses the typical Windows menus to reach the various screens. On the financial side, the player can manage income (ticket prices, concessions and broadcast) and expenses (dividing the available funds - after the fixed costs have been deducted - between the farm system, scouting and medical staff). Team management includes setting the rotation for defense and offense, selecting the lineup and trading athletes. There are also various statistics which can be viewed for analysis; the accuracy of athlete statistics depend on the scouting budget.
The player can choose how long the game should simulate ahead (e.g. only a day, the full season or until a fixed date) and when the period is over, the player takes control again. Matches can be viewed play-by-play, but without options for intervention.

Game.Name: Baseball Mogul 2003
Game.Overview:
You own a major league baseball team, and it is your job to build the team up into a champion team. This not only includes buying players, coaching staff and other staff members, but the stadium, behind the scenes money matters and a whole lot more. In truth you aren't controlling a baseball team, you controlling a company that owns a baseball team, and that company needs leadership.
The latest MLB stats are available in all categories, from player ability to their current salary terms. Every single stat becomes important to the success of your team, like the crowds support and memberships or locker room conditions.
And if you want even more control, you can modify areas of the MLB itself. Move a club from one place to another, re-name them, change their colors, etc, etc.

Game.Name: Baseball Mogul 2007
Game.Overview:
Baseball Mogul 2007 Developed by Sports Mogul. Published by Enlight Software. Released 4 April 2007.
Features:
- Animated play-by-play for all games. - In-game Manager Mode to call plays and make substitutions. - Pitch-by-pitch mode for complete control of the game, with graphical batting and pitching interface to pinpoint each pitch. - Individually researched ratings for each pitcher's arsenal, going back to 1901. Platoon statistics (lefties batting against righties, and vice versa) are accounted for. - A Minor League simulation engine simulates every pitch from AAA to high school for the entire league. - 11-point personality profiles for every player and every team, affecting contract negotiations, on-field performance, and team chemistry. - The game now has MLBPA licensing, while early versions required players to input their own team names and used fake player names. (i.e.: Bill Mueller is Bert Mack and Barry Bonds is Bert Brundage. Players had the same initials as their major league counterparts but different first and last names)
Baseball Mogul 2007 was the best-selling PC baseball game of 2006, selling over 100,000 units according to NPD data.

Game.Name: Baseball Stars 2
Game.Overview: Lace up your cleats, and step onto the diamond with the pros of â€œBASEBALL STARS 2â€ on Steam!

Game.Name: Base Craft: Desolate Survival
Game.Overview: Co-op twin-stick base building survival game.

Game.Name: Basement
Game.Overview: Basement is a strategy game, where you start doing illegal business to fund the development of your dream video game. It won't be easy, so get ready to deal with other gangs, cops, crazy junkies, mysterious investor and even ghosts from the past.

Game.Name: Basement of Hellish
Game.Overview: Basement of Hellish is a survival horror game with zombies in 1st person. Survive and struggle to find a way out in this horror game with tense and dark atmosphere.

Game.Name: Basements n' Basilisks: Storms of Sorcery
Game.Overview: Are you into intriguing, well thought-out, deep and elaborate role-playing experiences? Tough luck, champ!

Game.Name: Base One
Game.Overview: Base One is a base building strategy management game with an RPG twist. After a large wormhole tears the moon apart and causes unprecedented levels of natural disasters, the Earth Global Union create the "Solution" space exploration program in order to explore the wormhole for a new home. As a member of the "Solution" program, it is up to you to expand the fleet, find valuable minerals and new planets to inhabit - and maybe even save the Earth from ecological destruction!

Game.Name: Base Wars
Game.Overview: Base Wars takes the tactical nuance and big picture strategy of Real Time Strategy games and brings it to a Turn Based format. Research new technologies, build an army, expand your territory, and crush the opponent in this simple yet expansive strategy environment!

Game.Name: BASIC ROGUE
Game.Overview: BASIC ROGUE is a turn-based dungeon crawler. You have very limited inventory space, skills, weapons, armor, and stats which all need to be managed while fighting enemies, gathering treasure, and figuring out what your primary objective is. This game will appeal to players looking for a challenge.

Game.Name: Basil and the Isles of Spice
Game.Overview: Join Basil in this 3D platforming adventure as she runs, jumps, and glides through the Isles of Spice on her journey to become the new Shaman of her village. While collecting mystical crystals, she'll meet a colorful cast of characters who help her uncover the secret of the caldera!

Game.Name: Basingstoke
Game.Overview: Basingstoke is a tense rogue-like that mixes stealth and arcade action. Explore the smouldering ruins of Basingstoke, a world of reanimated undead and ferocious alien monsters. Scavenge as you go, crafting equipment to help you in your mission: escape Basingstoke!

Game.Name: Basketball Classics
Game.Overview: 5 on 5 Pro Basketball born from the golden era of sports games. This spiritual successor to the 8-bit ballers bridges the gap between retro and todayâ€™s simulation games. Side-scrolling, sweaty arcade action with simplified 3-button gameplay and retro vibes galore.

Game.Name: Basketball Club Story
Game.Overview:
Basketball Team Management Sim - Coach a custom team and dunk your way to glory!
Make your very own world-class basketball team!
Specialize in one skill? Be a jack-of-all-trades? Or something in between?
Create your own basketball team, recruit a cast of zany players, and compete against other teams. It's up to YOU to coach them to victory!
Plus, build facilities for your clubhouse for your players and visitors to enjoy. Mix, match, and position them however you like!
Sign with sponsors to gain impressive monetary support. Foster them alongside the rest of your team for even more rewards!
Don't forget to connect with your local fans through community outreach. The more they learn about basketball, the more passionate they'll become!
With the help of your players, sponsors, and spectators, you'll create the world's best basketball team!

Game.Name: Basketball Pinball
Game.Overview:
Enjoy Basketball Pinball, jump on the board and prepare to make points to win this match, score slam dunks and three point shots.
Discover all the secrets, complete all the missions and prove that you're the number 1 in the world or the best among your Friends, posting your high score on the online leaderboard.
- Arcade design. - Multiball, Extraball, Skillshot, Jackpots... - Reproduction with all the details, lights and sounds. - 4 different cameras to choose from. - Online Leaderboard.

Game.Name: BasketBelle
Game.Overview:
BasketBelle is an experimental 2D basketball-based platformer. Each Chapter of the game uses the mechanics and idea of basketball in a different way. At one point you might be dribbling inside the intestines of a purple blob creature. At others, you're likely to be dunking above the clouds in front of the Parisian moon.
A dynamic soundtrack and unique cardboard visuals help tell the story of a sister who must be saved through the power of basketball.

Game.Name: Basketing
Game.Overview: Basketing is the youngest sibling of Volleying! Thus, as another physics-based game, it also gives the players more control over their moves, delivering unique matches each round. Invite your friends over or play remotely and enjoy this predictably unpredictable experience!

Game.Name: BASMENT DWELLERS
Game.Overview: BASMENT DWELLERS is an epic, procedurally generated, next-generation CRPG about killing monsters and stealing their treasure.

Game.Name: Bass Avenger
Game.Overview: From the people who brought you Deer Avenger and Panty Raider: From Here to Immaturity ... This parody has you, one bad bass, luring fishermen with lures such as suitcase of money, girlie magazines, and more.

Game.Name: Bassmaster Fishing
Game.Overview:
For the first time ever, compete as or challenge 10 pro anglers from the Elite tour across 8 different real-world venues. Climb the ranks, earn your sponsors, and progress through your B.A.S.S.Â® career to become the Bassmaster ClassicÂ® Champion. Or take to the water and compete with other players in a variety of all-new massive multiplayer modes to conquer the global leader boards.
Key Features: - Career Mode - Compete throughout the College Series, Opens and Elite Series and progress to the Bassmaster Classic to become the champion.
- 10 Pro Anglers â€“ Play as or compete against legends like Scott Martin, Hank Cherry and 8 other official pro anglers.
- Our Largest Multiplayer â€“ Take on the vast Bassmaster Fishing online modes. Climb the global leader boards, jump into cross play modes, or be the champion in Bassmaster Royale.

Game.Name: Bass Masters Classic: Tournament Edition
Game.Overview:
Bass Masters Classic: Tournament Edition is a fishing simulation which, when it was released, billed itself as the only completely 3D fishing game.
There are many different ways to play this game. Apart from the tutorial mode there is the Single Player mode which offers the Amateur game, the Professional game, the Arcade game and the Practice game.* In the Amateur game the player fishes a series of one day tournaments under Bass Fishing rules where only the weight of four fish count.
- The Professional game is the career mode where the player fishes the lakes progressing from tournament to tournament until making it to the B.A.S.S. Master's Classic itself. - The Arcade mode is the fun kind of fishing. Here there's much more action and less simulation. - In the Practice Mode the player can customise the fishing conditions to prepare for what the game may throw at them. - There's also a multiplayer game and a tutorial mode.
The game features videos and advice from four Bass fishing professionals, Shaw E Grigsby Jr, Roland Martin, Paul Ellas and Ken Cook. There are four lakes which can be fished, Lake Fork, Lake Minnetonka, Lake Mead and Lake Logan Martin - the latter is not available in the Amateur mode of the game. It can be played entirely with the keyboard or with the mouse but a force feedback joystick is supported.

Game.Name: Bass Pro Shops: The Strike
Game.Overview: Bass Pro Shops: The Strike is a fishing game developed by Piranha Games and published by XS Games for the Wii, Windows, and Xbox 360 in 2009. A similar title about hunting , Bass Pro Shops: The Hunt ,later followed for Wii & Xbox 360 released on June 1, 2010.

Game.Name: Bastard
Game.Overview: Are you used to being a noble knight in shining armor who protects the weak and punishes the evil ones? Sure, you might answer, everybody wants to see oneself as one - especially in a game. But did you consider which price you would have to pay for it in your real life?

Game.Name: Bastard Bonds
Game.Overview: Bastard Bonds is a mature, fast-paced tactical RPG with high-end pixel art and in-depth character customization.

Game.Name: Bastide
Game.Overview: (Early Access game in alpha.) Bastide is a city-building strategy based in the 13th century where you must guide your village of peasants to thrive and survive against other villages, bandits, hunger, disease, and the cold so that they may grow into a fortified town.

Game.Name: Bastion
Game.Overview:
Bastion is an action role-playing experience that redefines storytelling in games, with a reactive narrator who marks your every move. Explore more than 40 lush hand-painted environments as you discover the secrets of the Calamity, a surreal catastrophe that shattered the world to pieces. Wield a huge arsenal of upgradeable weapons and battle savage beasts adapted to their new habitat. Finish the main story to unlock the New Game Plus mode and continue your journey!
Features: - Action-packed combat rewards playing with finesse - Hours of reactive narration delivers a deep story - Stunning hand-painted artwork in full 1080p resolution -Â Critically-acclaimed original music score -Â Controls custom-tailored to PC plus gamepad support -Â 10+ unique upgradeable weapons to be used - 6 powerful Bastion structures to be discovered - 'New Game Plus' and 'Score Attack' modes unlocked after finishing the story - 'No-Sweat Mode' lets players of any skill level enjoy the story

Game.Name: Batbarian: Testament of the Primordials
Game.Overview:
Batbarian: Testament of the Primordials is a snarky action-adventure puzzle game with a good dose of humor. Explore hundreds of secret-filled rooms, fight big bosses, gather companions for your party and use the powers of Pipâ€”your bat buddyâ€”to solve puzzles and escape the eldritch abyss!
*Crash* ...That was the sound of you landing face first in an abyss filled with monsters, traps, and eldritch secrets. But hey, it's ok barbarian, you are not alone: Pip, your best friendâ€”and mysteriously luminous batâ€”is with you. And it's only by truly working together that you'll be able to solve the abyss' puzzles, fight off its hungry denizens, discover its true purpose and maybe -just maybe- make it out alive with the secrets of the primordials.
â€¢ Gain new skills for your barbarian and elemental powers for Pip, the (magic) bat! â€¢ A narrative-driven metroidvania with dialogue choices and plenty of humor and snark. â€¢ Big numbers! 400+ rooms, 20+ hours of evolving gameplay, 10+ bosses, 60+ minutes of music and almost 30,000 words of text that a barbarian would never bother to read! â€¢ Puzzles. â€¢Â A multitude of assists available to tailor the difficulty to your needs, like slow motion, regen, extra loot & stats! â€¢ RPG elements with a level-up minigame. â€¢ Contains more fruit throwing than probably any other game. â€¢Â Companions that join you in your quest and help you out in fights. â€¢Â Multiple endings based on your choices and actions. â€¢ The thrown fruit are NOT wasted, they are eaten by the bat (who is magic). â€¢ A ton of secrets and hidden loot just about everywhere. â€¢ The (magic) bat has a whopping FIVE different squeaking sounds! â€¢ Fewer repetitive jokes than this description has.

Game.Name: Bat Boy
Game.Overview:
Ryosuke isn't just your regular high-school kid. He and his fellow sports-star friends secretly battle against the evil invading forces of Lord Vicious, hellbent on hosting sinister athletic events for his own amusement! Ryosuke is Bat Boy!
Play as Bat Boy in this 2D side-scrolling action platformer in which the interdimensional mage Lord Vicious has brainwashed Bat Boyâ€™s fellow teammates in order to participate in the Trials of Darkness, a heinously brutal series of athletic events! Itâ€™s up to Bat Boy to team up with the mouthy crow Garou, traversing a hostile world, to free the minds of his sports-hero teammates and learn their skills before they fall victim to the Trials. Along the way, Bat Boy will encounter all manner of characters, some allies, most not, as he fights his way through the bad guys in a variety of levels until reaching the final confrontation with Lord Vicious.
Bat Boy pits the titular hero against the former allies of his sports team, heroes such as Racket Girl, Shinai Guy, Aquaria and Mr. Blitzer, among others as he travels through the many regions beyond Lord Vicious' dimensional gateway!
â–ª A thrilling 2D platforming adventure set against rich, nostalgic 8-bit backdrops. â–ª Swing, deflect, spin and power-hit your way through exciting baseball-style combat! â–ª Explore a vast world of unique and exciting environments, ultimately leading to a showdown with one of Bat Boyâ€™s brainwashed allies! â–ª Take on the powers of each ally as you free them from the influence of Lord Vicious! â–ª Glorious 8-bit visuals, reminiscent of early platformer legends. â–ª High-octane chiptunes from Evader Music, composer for Smelter and Super Sami Roll. â–ª Dozens of enemies, exciting bosses and intriguing companions to encounter! â–ª Baseball-bat-based traversal and environmental puzzle solving! â–ª Hidden secrets, collectibles, unlockable music and more to find!

Game.Name: Baten Kaitos: Eternal Wings and the Lost Ocean
Baten Kaitos I & II HD Remaster
Game.Overview:
Baten Kaitos: Eternal Wings and the Lost Ocean and Baten Kaitos Origins are now on Steam with improved graphics and new features to aid game progression, making them even easier to play! Delve into the world of Baten Kaitos as you strategize with the unique card-based battle system in these two immersive RPG masterpieces. Play as a guardian spirit who guides the colorful cast as they struggle against destiny itself.
A long time ago, there was a great conflict between the evil god and the people. After a fierce battle, the people managed to seal off the evil god, but what was left behind was only a desolate land. The people thus chose to abandon the land and live in the sky. Such fairy tales were passed down as legends. At this time, people had wings called Wings of the Heart and lived a peaceful life. It was an era of long-lasting tranquility. ...But the collapse had quietly begun. When a young man calls your name, the name of the spirit, the story begins to unfold. A story set on a floating continent in the sky, where thoughts and prayers intersect.
In the world of Baten Kaitos, the true essences of all manner of things, including equipment and items, can be extracted and stored inside cards called magnus. A magnus' contents can be released at any time, returning the magna essence sealed inside to its original form. These magnus form the basis of the Baten Kaitos battle system. Battles run in real time, so you'll need to employ quick thinking to select the right magnus for the situation. Strategize against enemies of various elements using elemental magnus of your own, and experiment with mixing and matching different magnus to discover and unlock powerful combo attacks!
The two titles have been fully remastered in HD, including retouched battle backgrounds, character graphics, and UI. Enjoy Baten Kaitos with even more vibrant visuals. ãƒ» Aspect ratio expanded from 4:3 to 16:9 for play on wider screens! ãƒ» Main character and boss graphics have been completely renewed in vivid detail! ãƒ» All-new menu screens! Enjoy smoother gameplay with refreshed menu layouts, newly added sorting features, and more. Pre-existing graphics have been used for in-game maps as well as some screens and character models.
â€¢ New Features for Better Gameplay Along with improved graphics, the features below have been added to make game progression much smoother! ãƒ» Auto-save feature ãƒ» Help menu containing terminology and hints for progressing through the game ãƒ» New Game+ mode, unlocked after clearing the game once, which starts a new game while retaining all magnus, levels, and ranks ãƒ» New Game- mode, a mode with level restrictions for an extra thrilling challenge Six new game system options have now been added, including adjustable game speeds and no-encounter mode. Save your settings as a Custom Set and turn them on or off at any time.

Game.Name: BAT HERO
Game.Overview: Equipped with your favorite weapon of choice, a Bat, embark in a whole new adventure with this brand new arcade action game and defeat the great evil that lurks in the shadows gathering new powers along the way. Ready ? Swing Away !

Game.Name: Bathory: The Bloody Countess
Game.Overview: Stop the blood rite before something darker than the myth itself comes to live in Bathory: The Bloody Countess, a haunted hidden object adventure game.

Game.Name: Batla Shooter
Game.Overview:
Batla is the awesome shooter game about robots, which came to conquer the Earth, but turned to be were too small for that. They had no choice but to capture the kid's room and start fighting there. Sometimes robots go into orbit and fight there for the most valuable resource on the planet - glucose. That's right - the robots fight with each other for stick candies.
The main character is the robot nicknamed â€˜Soldierâ€™. This is a classic representative of the robotsâ€™ race. He shows good efficiency in basic criteria; he possesses standard set of weapons. He is familiar and easy to control. Soldier is an elite assault trooper from Robotsâ€™ Planet.
Fans of classic shooters, such as Quake or Unreal, will like Batla due to its good dynamics, 3 kinds of robots, nice graphics, interesting locations and great mood!

Game.Name: Bat-Man
Game.Overview: A remake that was in the works for a long time and was on-hold a few times. One of the best games for ZX Spectrum ever created, surpassed only by its succesor Head Over Heels, which was also remade by our team. Help BatMan find seven pieces of the BatCraft scattered around the caves, mansion and other places. In the end find the BatCraft and finish this adventure.

Game.Name: Batman: Arkham Asylum
Game.Overview:
Batman: Arkham Asylum is a third-person action game set in Gotham Cityâ€™s infamous psychiatric facility for criminals, Arkham Asylum. The story begins with Batman escorting the Joker back to the institution after his latest capture, only for the Clown Prince of Crime to escape and orchestrate a takeover of the asylum with the help of its inmates. Trapped inside, Batman must restore order, stop the Jokerâ€™s plans, and face some of his most dangerous adversaries, including Harley Quinn, Killer Croc, Poison Ivy, and Scarecrow.
Gameplay blends exploration, stealth, detective work, and free-flowing combat. Players guide Batman across the asylumâ€™s interconnected areas - ranging from cell blocks and medical wings to underground caverns - using acrobatics, gadgets, and detective skills to progress. Combat is based on a rhythmic counter-and-strike system, encouraging fluid chains of attacks against multiple enemies at once. Stealth segments allow Batman to stalk guards from the shadows, using vents, gargoyles, and line-of-sight tricks to silently eliminate threats. Detective vision highlights objects of interest, interactive clues, and enemy awareness, helping players plan their approach.

Game.Name: Batman: Arkham Asylum Game of the Year Edition
Game.Overview:
Batman: Arkham Asylum is a third-person action game set in Gotham Cityâ€™s infamous psychiatric facility for criminals, Arkham Asylum. The story begins with Batman escorting the Joker back to the institution after his latest capture, only for the Clown Prince of Crime to escape and orchestrate a takeover of the asylum with the help of its inmates. Trapped inside, Batman must restore order, stop the Jokerâ€™s plans, and face some of his most dangerous adversaries, including Harley Quinn, Killer Croc, Poison Ivy, and Scarecrow.
The Game of the Year release for Batman: Arkham Asylum contains the full game, plus the Insane Night DLC challenge maps Nocturnal Hunter and Totally Insane, the Crime Alley map from the Collector's Edition, and the Scarecrow platform challenge maps from the GameStop pre-order bonus.

Game.Name: Batman: Arkham City
Game.Overview:
Batman: Arkham City builds upon the intense, atmospheric foundation of Batman: Arkham Asylum, sending players flying through the expansive Arkham City - five times larger than the game world in Batman: Arkham Asylum - the new maximum security "home" for all of Gotham City's thugs, gangsters and insane criminal masterminds. Featuring an incredible Rogues Gallery of Gotham City's most dangerous criminals including Catwoman, The Joker, The Riddler, Two-Face, Harley Quinn, The Penguin, Mr. Freeze and many others, the game allows players to genuinely experience what it feels like to be The Dark Knight delivering justice on the streets of Gotham City.
Batman: Arkham City - Game of the Year Edition packages new gameplay content, seven maps, three playable characters, and 12 skins beyond the original retail release.

Game.Name: Batman: Arkham City: Game of the Year Edition
Game.Overview:
Batman: Arkham City builds upon the intense, atmospheric foundation of Batman: Arkham Asylum, sending players flying through the expansive Arkham City - five times larger than the game world in Batman: Arkham Asylum - the new maximum security "home" for all of Gotham City's thugs, gangsters and insane criminal masterminds. Featuring an incredible Rogues Gallery of Gotham City's most dangerous criminals including Catwoman, The Joker, The Riddler, Two-Face, Harley Quinn, The Penguin, Mr. Freeze and many others, the game allows players to genuinely experience what it feels like to be The Dark Knight delivering justice on the streets of Gotham City.
Batman: Arkham City - Game of the Year Edition packages new gameplay content, seven maps, three playable characters, and 12 skins beyond the original retail release.

Game.Name: Batman: Arkham Knight
Game.Overview:
In the explosive finale to the Arkham series, The Scarecrow returns to unite an impressive roster of super villains, including Penguin, Two-Face and Harley Quinn. Batman: Arkham Knight introduces Rocksteady's Batmobile, which is drivable for the first time in the franchise. This legendary vehicle combined with the acclaimed gameplay of the Batman Arkham series, offers gamers the ultimate Batman experience as they tear through Gotham City.
Introducing the Batmobile â€“ The Batmobile is brought to life with a completely new design featuring a full range of on-board high-tech gadgetry. Designed to be fully drivable throughout the game world and capable of transformation from high speed pursuit mode to military grade battle mode, this legendary vehicle sits at the heart of the gameâ€™s design. The Batmobile augments Batmanâ€™s abilities in every respect, from navigation and forensics to combat and puzzle solving.
Explore the entirety of Gotham City â€“ For the first time, players have the opportunity to explore all of Gotham City in a completely open and free-roaming game world. More than five times that of Batman: Arkham City, Gotham City has been brought to life with the same level of intimate, hand-crafted attention to detail for which the Arkham games are known.
Most Wanted Side Missions â€“ Players can fully immerse themselves in the chaos that is erupting in the streets of Gotham. Encounters with high-profile criminal masterminds are guaranteed while also offering gamers the opportunity to focus on and takedown individual villains or pursue the core narrative path.
New Combat and Gadget Features â€“ Gamers have at their disposal more combat moves and high-tech gadgetry than ever before. The new â€˜gadgets while glidingâ€™ ability allows Batman to deploy gadgets such as batarangs, the grapnel gun or the line launcher mid-glide while Batmanâ€™s utility belt is once again upgraded to include all new gadgets that expand his range of forensic investigation, stealth incursion and combat skills.

Game.Name: Batman: Arkham Origins
Game.Overview:
Batman: Arkham Origins is the next installment in the blockbuster Batman: Arkham videogame franchise. Developed by WB Games MontrÃ©al, the game features an expanded Gotham City and introduces an original prequel storyline set several years before the events of Batman: Arkham Asylum and Batman: Arkham City, the first two critically acclaimed games of the franchise. Taking place before the rise of Gotham Cityâ€™s most dangerous criminals, the game showcases a young and unrefined Batman as he faces a defining moment in his early career as a crime fighter that sets his path to becoming the Dark Knight.
The Arkham Story Begins: Batman: Arkham Origins features a pivotal tale set on Christmas Eve where Batman is hunted by eight of the deadliest assassins from the DC Comics Universe. Players become an early-career Batman as he encounters for the first time many of the characters that shape his future.
Enhanced Detective Mode: Think like Batman with an all-new Case File system that allows players to analyze seemingly impossible-to-solve crime reconstructions in real time. Combining Batmanâ€™s cowl sensors with the Batcomputer, players can digitally recreate crimes and study detailed simulation of the act as it happened.
Lethal New Enemies: Fight new foes such as the Armored Enforcer, the Martial Artist and more â€“ each of which challenge players to approach Batmanâ€™s FreeFlow Combat scenarios in different ways. Classic FreeFlow combat is expanded with every new opponent â€“ and with Batmanâ€™s abilities to engage them.
New Gadgets: Utilize Batmanâ€™s signature gadgets or take advantage of powerful new additions such as the Remote Claw, the Concussion Detonator and more. Use the Remote Claw to create new routes by deploying strategic tightropes or directly attack enemies by stringing them up from vantage points. Ready the Concussion Detonator to stun and disorient groups of opponents in close combat.
New and Familiar Characters: Experience a fresh take on iconic Batman characters including Black Mask, Penguin, Deathstroke, Bane, Deadshot, Anarky, Captain Gordon, The Joker, Copperhead, Firefly and others yet to be revealed.

Game.Name: Batman: Arkham Origins: Blackgate Deluxe Edition
Game.Overview: Batman: Arkham Origins Blackgate - Deluxe Edition amplifies the 2.5-D game developed by Armature Studio with new maps, enemy encounters, difficulty levels, and batsuits, all with enhanced visuals. A companion game to Batman: Arkham Origins, players can continue the storyline of the console version and discover more details of the Dark...

Game.Name: Batman: Arkham Shadow
Game.Overview:
Gotham City is in danger. And youâ€™re the only one who can save it.
Prepare to enter Gotham for a new story set in the Batman: Arkham franchise.

Game.Name: Batman: Arkham VR
Game.Overview: Experience Gotham City through the eyes of the World's Greatest Detective in an all new Arkham mystery.

Game.Name: Batman: Justice Unbalanced
